```dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_flutter/jet_cad_2d_flutter.dart' show SelectionKey;
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_plan/jet_cad_2d_plan.dart';

import '../support/editor_host.dart' show editorPlanJson;
import '../support/mark_kit.dart';
import '../support/notice_kit.dart';

Widget app(PlanController c, Locale locale) => MaterialApp(
    locale: locale,
    supportedLocales: planSupportedLocales,
    localizationsDelegates: planLocalizationsDelegates,
    home: Scaffold(body: PlanEditor(controller: c)));

String status(WidgetTester tester) =>
    tester.widget<Text>(find.byKey(const Key('status-text'))).data!;

Future<PlanController> pump(WidgetTester tester) async {
  final c = PlanController(kits: [markKit(), noteKit], json: editorPlanJson());
  addTearDown(c.dispose);
  await tester.binding.setSurfaceSize(const Size(1440, 900));
  addTearDown(() => tester.binding.setSurfaceSize(null));
  await tester.pumpWidget(app(c, const Locale('en')));
  await tester.pump();
  return c;
}

void main() {
  testWidgets(
      'TN-status the label, the selection, then the notice; no notice, no '
      'dash (M-TN-order)', (tester) async {
    final c = await pump(tester);
    expect(c.selectTool(noteToolId), isTrue);
    await tester.pump();
    expect(status(tester), 'Mark');
    final note = c.toolFor(noteToolId)! as NoteTool;
    note.said.value = busy('Mark 1');
    await tester.pump();
    expect(status(tester), 'Mark — Already marked: Mark 1');
    final marks = c.catalog.objectsOf<MarkCross>(c.document);
    expect(marks, hasLength(2), reason: 'premise: the fixture\'s marks');
    c.selection.replace([for (final h in marks) SelectionKey.root(h)]);
    await tester.pump();
    // M-TN-order: the notice before the selection.
    expect(status(tester), 'Mark — 2 selected — Already marked: Mark 1');
    note.said.value = null;
    await tester.pump();
    expect(status(tester), 'Mark — 2 selected');
  });

  testWidgets(
      'TN-relocale (Review Focus 2) a language switch re-words a shown '
      'notice at once, in the new language, with its name; and back '
      '(M-TN-relocale)', (tester) async {
    final c = await pump(tester);
    expect(c.selectTool(noteToolId), isTrue);
    (c.toolFor(noteToolId)! as NoteTool).said.value = busy('Mark 1');
    await tester.pump();
    expect(status(tester), 'Mark — Already marked: Mark 1');
    await tester.pumpWidget(app(c, const Locale('tr')));
    await tester.pump();
    // M-TN-relocale: the editor words the notice once and keeps the text.
    expect(status(tester), 'İşaret — Zaten işaretli: Mark 1');
    await tester.pumpWidget(app(c, const Locale('en')));
    await tester.pump();
    expect(status(tester), 'Mark — Already marked: Mark 1');
  });
}
```

```dart
  bool _noticeRead = false;
  _GuardedNotice? _notice;

  /// The inner tool's notice when it is a [ToolNotice] (spec 3a C1.2),
  /// through the guard: read once, then the same listenable for the tool's
  /// life. A throwing `notice` getter is one diagnostic and no notice; a
  /// throwing value or listener is one diagnostic, then null.
  ValueListenable<KitText?>? get notice {
    if (!_noticeRead) {
      _noticeRead = true;
      final inner = this.inner;
      if (inner is ToolNotice) {
        try {
          _notice = _GuardedNotice(this, (inner as ToolNotice).notice);
        } catch (e, s) {
          _getterFailed(e, s);
        }
      }
    }
    return _notice;
  }
```

  and after the `GuardedTool` class (after `:479`, before `GuardedGrips`):

```dart
/// A kit tool's notice read at the boundary (spec 3a C1.2): what it throws
/// is its tool's getter failure (one diagnostic after the frame), and from
/// then on it answers null and holds no listener.
final class _GuardedNotice implements ValueListenable<KitText?> {
  _GuardedNotice(this._tool, this._inner);

  final GuardedTool _tool;
  final ValueListenable<KitText?> _inner;
  bool _failed = false;

  void _fail(Object error, StackTrace stack) {
    _failed = true;
    _tool._getterFailed(error, stack);
  }

  @override
  KitText? get value {
    if (_failed) return null;
    try {
      return _inner.value;
    } catch (e, s) {
      _fail(e, s);
      return null;
    }
  }

  @override
  void addListener(VoidCallback listener) {
    if (_failed) return;
    try {
      _inner.addListener(listener);
    } catch (e, s) {
      _fail(e, s);
    }
  }

  @override
  void removeListener(VoidCallback listener) {
    try {
      _inner.removeListener(listener);
    } catch (e, s) {
      _fail(e, s);
    }
  }
}
```

  The imports gain `import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart' show ValueListenable;` before `package:flutter/scheduler.dart` (`:9`): `package:flutter/widgets.dart` exports `VoidCallback` and `ValueNotifier` but not `ValueListenable`. (`ToolNotice` and `KitText` come with the kit barrel. `inner is ToolNotice` on a local: the field is public, so it does not promote; the cast is the promotion.)

```dart
  /// The active tool's notice (spec 3a C1.2), null when it has none: a
  /// word id and its arguments, for [textOf] when the line is read.
  ValueListenable<KitText?> get toolNotice => _toolNotice;

  /// [text] in words (spec 3a C1.2, C1.6): the host's word first, then the
  /// kit's the id names, in the current locale, else English; the id itself
  /// when no one words it; its placeholders filled.
  String textOf(KitText text) {
    final id = text.id;
    final names = _names[kitOfKey(id.substring(id.indexOf(':') + 1))] ??
        _hostWords;
    return fillText(
        names.word(_locale.value.languageCode, id) ?? id, text.args);
  }

  /// Follows the active tool's notice: rebinds when the tool changed,
  /// then copies its value.
  void _rebindNotice() {
    final active = _session.tools.active;
    final next = active is GuardedTool ? active.notice : null;
    if (!identical(next, _noticeSource)) {
      _noticeSource?.removeListener(_copyNotice);
      _noticeSource = next;
      next?.addListener(_copyNotice);
    }
    _copyNotice();
  }

  void _copyNotice() => _toolNotice.value = _noticeSource?.value;
```

**Appendix A rows closed:** D-28, its generic half: `jet_cad_floor_plan/test/new_document_test.dart` ND1's empty, history, millimetre and page lines, ND3's page, unit and byte lines, ND4's "with the page's registration alone" and "with the catalog's registration alone" (ported here, `test/controller/new_plan_test.dart`). D-28's other parts are owned elsewhere: ND1's and ND3's DASHED lines and ND4's "with registerAppComponents: a live page and live walls" need the architecture kit (Task 17, per its scope; Task 9's SC-prepare pins the record on a new plan); ND2 is not ported (plan decision below). The spec's C1.3 and C1.9 land here; Review Focus 1's plan half is PB3-prepare-load.

Plan decisions:
- **Where `prepare` runs.** In the constructor body, before `_open`, when the factory made the document (`json == null`), and in `newPlan`, between `newPlanDocument` and `_replace`. Never inside `_open`, which `load` (and so an import: `PlanPageFlows(load: load)`, `plan_controller.dart:336`) also runs: a loaded plan is never changed (spec C1.3, today's R-3). The prepares run with no parametric system installed and the engine's default permissions (`DraftDocument.empty`), then the history is cleared once after the last: "outside history" holds even for a prepare that executes a command (PB5).
- **A failing prepare.** Caught per kit; one `KitDiagnostic(kitId: <kit id>, subject: 'prepare', code: hookFailed, message: 'prepare: <error>')`; the later kits still run and the plan opens. `hookFailed` is not plan-scoped (`diagnostics_log.dart:14-20`), so `_open`'s `clearPlanScoped` keeps it; a second newPlan with the same failure is deduplicated by the log (one per kit, subject and code), as every other hook's.
- **Where `build` runs.** Inside `_open`, right after `session.runKitFactories(...)`: the session's constructor has installed the parametric system, the unit label system and the lock expander (`session.dart:100-110`), the failure boundary is wired, and the kits' factories have run; the history listener (`session.history`), the change tracker (`_tracker.attach`) and the save point come after it. So the built objects regenerate through the plan's own system, a kit hook failure inside the build goes through the boundary as any edit's, no `PlanChange` is reported for the build's steps (the tracker's baseline is the built plan; listeners hear `PlanReplaced` from `_replace` only), and the dry run (`probeLoaded`) checks the built plan. `_replace` takes `_savedState` and `_unsettled` after `_open`, so the built plan is clean and, made with no locale reported, still unsettled (PB11).
- **A build is the host's construction, not an edit.** It runs under `_unrestricted` (the engine's permissions lifted, as the controller's own settle in `reportLocale` is, `:2203`), so a read-only controller can still be built (PB10). Then `clearHistory()`.
- **A failing build leaves the empty plan.** On a throw, every step still in the history is undone (unrestricted), then the history is cleared, and one `KitDiagnostic(kitId: 'plan', subject: 'build', code: hookFailed, message: 'build: <error>')` is reported (`'plan'` is the plan library's own kit id in the log, as `damagedUnsavable`'s, `:630`). A step that a mid-build lock cleared from the history (a kit's hook failed inside the build and the boundary froze an object) is not undone: the built objects before it stay, locked or not, and the diagnostics say why. A build adds objects by command, as the spec says; it has no other way to change the document that this undo would miss but the tables, which a build has no reason to touch.
- **The build's words.** One `KitNamesWords` for the controller's life over every loaded kit's names folded onto the host's (`_hostWords.merge(k1.names).merge(k2.names)...`: the host's word wins, then the earlier kit's, `KitNames.merge`'s rule), at `_locale` (English until a widget reports one) and with `planStrings.decimalSeparator` as its separator (Task 3's rule for the kits' words).
- **ND2 is not ported.** Its premise is `prepareDocument` (`jet_cad_floor_plan/lib/src/new_document.dart:18-24`), a set-up that adds no page; the plan library has no such step (`newPlanDocument` registers, sets millimetres and attaches the page in one function, `new_plan.dart:23-33`), so its `pageOf(doc), isNull` line has nothing to run on. Its registration and unit lines are ND1's and C1's (`plan_controller_test.dart:29-51`) over `newPlanDocument`. This is a ruling for the controller to confirm (A14: a test not ported needs a reason): "ND2 not ported, premise absent in the plan library".
- **ND4's fixture.** Today's sample flat (ten walls) is the architecture kit's; the generic cases run on two test-kit slabs off the origin, turned, under a page that is not the new plan's (origin `(-3100.5, 820.25)`, 1:100). The fixture's own count premise follows it (`hasLength(2)` slabs for `hasLength(10)` walls); `liveObjectsOf<WallParams>` becomes the test kit catalog's `objectsOf<SlabComponent>` (the engine's live-object rule both read); every other assertion is unchanged.

```dart
// Spec 3a C1.9: a plan a host builds in code.
import 'package:jet_cad_2d/jet_cad_2d.dart' show DraftDocument;

import 'plan_services.dart' show KitWords;

/// Fills a new plan in code (spec 3a C1.9), given to
/// `PlanController(build:)` or `newPlan(build:)`. [document] is the plan
/// library's: set up, prepared by every loaded kit (`PlanKit.prepare`), its
/// parametric system installed. The build adds objects by command; the plan
/// library then clears the history and takes the save point, so the built
/// plan opens clean, with nothing to undo. [words] are every loaded kit's,
/// the host's first, in the controller's locale. A build that throws leaves
/// the empty plan and is reported.
typedef PlanBuild = void Function(DraftDocument document, KitWords words);
```

```dart

  /// constructor's plan without json and every `newPlan`, never a loaded or
  /// imported one, so a plan without what it adds is never changed. Called
  /// once per new document, in kit load order, before any parametric system
  /// is installed; the history is cleared after it. It must be idempotent.
  /// A throw is a `hookFailed` diagnostic and the plan opens. The
  /// separator's DASHED linetype record is its first user.
  final void Function(DraftDocument document)? prepare;
```

```dart
// Spec 3a C1.3, C1.9 (Task 5): a kit's prepare runs on the documents the
// plan library makes (the constructor's plan without json, and newPlan),
// in kit load order, outside history, before the save point; never on a
// loaded plan (Review Focus 1, the plan's half). A host's build fills a
// new plan over the plan's own system, unrestricted, and the plan opens
// clean, still unsettled; a failing prepare or build is one hookFailed
// and the plan opens. Slabs off the origin, turned; a prepare sets the
// page to 1:100.
import 'dart:ui' show Locale;

import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d/jet_cad_2d.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit/jet_cad_2d_kit.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_plan/jet_cad_2d_plan.dart';
import 'package:vector_math/vector_math_64.dart' show Vector2;

import '../support/harness.dart';
import '../support/test_kit.dart';
import '../support/throwing_kit.dart';

/// What a `prep` kit's prepare adds: a linetype on the handle the engine
/// keeps for an application's (`ReservedHandles.dashedLinetype`).
const LinetypeRecord prepRecord = LinetypeRecord(
  handle: ReservedHandles.dashedLinetype,
  name: 'PREPPED',
  description: 'Prepared __ __',
  pattern: DashPattern(dashes: [300, -150], totalLength: 450),
);

/// A kit with no type whose prepare adds [prepRecord] when it is not there
/// (idempotent), and logs `prep` in [log].
PlanKit prepKit({List<String>? log}) => PlanKit(
      id: 'prep',
      version: '1.0.0',
      prepare: (document) {
        log?.add('prep');
        final linetypes = document.tables.linetypes;
        if (!linetypes.contains(prepRecord.handle)) linetypes.add(prepRecord);
      },
    );

/// A kit whose prepare logs whether [prepRecord] is there already.
PlanKit lateKit(List<String> log) => PlanKit(
      id: 'late',
      version: '1.0.0',
      prepare: (document) => log.add(
          'late:${document.tables.linetypes.contains(prepRecord.handle)}'),
    );

bool prepared(DraftDocument d) =>
    d.tables.linetypes[prepRecord.handle] == prepRecord;

/// A build that records its words and adds one slab, 1800 x 900, turned
/// 0.4 rad at (-2600, 1400), by command.
PlanBuild slabBuild(List<KitWords> seen) => (document, words) {
      seen.add(words);
      addObject<SlabComponent>(
          document, SlabComponent(width: 1800, height: 900, angle: 0.4),
          at: Vector2(-2600, 1400));
    };

List<(String, String?, KitDiagnosticCode)> problemsOf(PlanController c) =>
    [for (final d in c.diagnostics.value) (d.kitId, d.subject, d.code)];
```

  5. Right after `newPlan`, add:

```dart
  /// Every loaded kit's `prepare` on [document], a document the plan
  /// library made (spec 3a C1.3): in load order, with no system installed,
  /// then the history cleared, so the plan is prepared outside history. A
  /// prepare that throws is a `hookFailed` diagnostic of its kit (subject
  /// `prepare`); the later kits still run, and the plan opens. Never on a
  /// loaded or imported plan: Open adds nothing (today's R-3).
  void _prepare(DraftDocument document) {
    for (final kit in kits.kits) {
      final prepare = kit.prepare;
      if (prepare == null) continue;
      try {
        prepare(document);
      } catch (error) {
        _diagnostics.add(KitDiagnostic(
            kitId: kit.id,
            subject: 'prepare',
            code: KitDiagnosticCode.hookFailed,
            message: 'prepare: $error',
            error: error));
      }
    }
    document.commands.clearHistory();
  }

  /// A [PlanBuild]'s words (spec 3a C1.9): every loaded kit's, the host's
  /// first (spec 2b S4), then each kit's in load order; at the controller's
  /// locale, read live, with the UI language's separator.
  late final KitWords _buildWords = KitNamesWords(
      kits.kits.fold<KitNames>(
          _hostWords, (names, kit) => names.merge(kit.names)),
      () => _locale.value,
      decimalSeparator: () => planStrings.decimalSeparator);

  /// [build] run on [document] over the plan's own system (spec 3a C1.9),
  /// unrestricted (the host's construction, not an edit), then the history
  /// cleared: the built plan opens with nothing to undo. A build that
  /// throws leaves the empty plan: every step still in the history is
  /// undone, and it is one `hookFailed` (kit `plan`, subject `build`).
  void _runBuild(DraftDocument document, PlanBuild build) {
    final commands = document.commands;
    try {
      _unrestricted(commands, () => build(document, _buildWords));
    } catch (error) {
      _unrestricted(commands, () {
        while (commands.canUndo) {
          commands.undo();
        }
      });
      _diagnostics.add(KitDiagnostic(
          kitId: 'plan',
          subject: 'build',
          code: KitDiagnosticCode.hookFailed,
          message: 'build: $error',
          error: error));
    }
    commands.clearHistory();
  }
```

```dart
// D-28's generic half (spec 3a C1.3, Appendix A): jet_cad_floor_plan's
// test/new_document_test.dart ND1, ND3 and two ND4 cases, ported over the
// plan library's newPlanDocument and the test kit's registration (the

// lines and ND4's "with registerAppComponents: a live page and live

import 'package:jet_cad_2d/jet_cad_2d.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_flutter/jet_cad_2d_flutter.dart'
    show FlutterTextMeasurer;
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_plan/src/controller/new_plan.dart';
import 'package:vector_math/vector_math_64.dart' show Vector2;

import '../support/harness.dart';
import '../support/test_kit.dart';

void main() {
  late FlutterTextMeasurer measurer;
  setUp(() {
    measurer = FlutterTextMeasurer();
    addTearDown(measurer.clear);
  });

  final catalog = catalogOf([testKit()]);
  void register(ComponentRegistry r) => registerPlanComponents(r, catalog);

  PageComponent? pageOf(DraftDocument d) =>
      d.components.get<PageComponent>(d.rootHandle);

  test(
      'ND1 the new document is empty, has no history, is in millimetres, '
      'and its page is the fixed literal (spec 12a D4, T-11)', () {
    final doc = newPlanDocument(measurer, register: register);

    expect(doc.entities.liveCount, 0);
    expect(doc.commands.undoDepth, 0);
    expect(doc.commands.canUndo, isFalse);
    expect(doc.commands.canRedo, isFalse);
    // The header's own default is unitless; the set-up changes it.
    expect(DraftDocument.empty(measurer: measurer).header.units,
        isNot(DrawingUnits.millimeters));
    expect(doc.header.units, DrawingUnits.millimeters);

    // The literal, written out here, not read from `defaultPlanPage`.
    expect(pageOf(doc), PageComponent(originX: -7425, originY: -5250));
    // And what the literal means: the A4 landscape sheet at 1:50, 14,850 x
    // 10,500 world mm, centred on the world origin.
    final sheet = sheetWorldRect(pageOf(doc)!);
    expect([sheet.minX, sheet.minY, sheet.maxX, sheet.maxY],
        [-7425.0, -5250.0, 7425.0, 5250.0]);
  });

  test(
      "ND3 the new document encodes, and decodes with the plan's "
      'registration to the same page, units and bytes (spec 12a D4, D8)', () {
    final doc = newPlanDocument(measurer, register: register);
    final saved = DraftDocumentCodec.encodeToString(doc);

    final loaded = DraftDocumentCodec.decodeString(saved,
        measurer: measurer, registerComponents: register);

    expect(pageOf(loaded), PageComponent(originX: -7425, originY: -5250));
    expect(pageOf(loaded), pageOf(doc));
    expect(loaded.components.unknownOf(loaded.rootHandle), isEmpty);
    expect(loaded.header.units, DrawingUnits.millimeters);
    expect(DraftDocumentCodec.encodeToString(loaded), saved);
  });

  group("ND4 the sample's bytes, decoded (spec 12a D8, S-1)", () {
    late DraftDocument sample;
    late String bytes;
    late List<Handle> sampleSlabs;
    setUp(() {
      sample = planDocument([testKit()], measurer: measurer);
      sample.commands.execute(SetComponentCommand<PageComponent>(
          sample.rootHandle,
          PageComponent(
              originX: -3100.5, originY: 820.25, scaleDenominator: 100)));
      installSystem(sample, [testKit()]);
      addObject<SlabComponent>(sample,
          SlabComponent(width: 1800, height: 900, angle: 0.4),
          at: Vector2(-2600, 1400));
      addObject<SlabComponent>(
          sample, SlabComponent(width: 1200, height: 700, angle: -1.1),
          at: Vector2(2300, 1400));
      bytes = DraftDocumentCodec.encodeToString(sample);
      sampleSlabs = catalog.objectsOf<SlabComponent>(sample);
      // The sample's page is off the world origin: not the new document's
      // page.
      expect(pageOf(sample), isNotNull);
      expect(
          pageOf(sample), isNot(PageComponent(originX: -7425, originY: -5250)));
      expect(sampleSlabs, hasLength(2));
    });

    test("with the page's registration alone: no live slab", () {
      final loaded = DraftDocumentCodec.decodeString(bytes,
          measurer: measurer, registerComponents: PageComponent.register);
      expect(pageOf(loaded), pageOf(sample));
      expect(catalog.objectsOf<SlabComponent>(loaded), isEmpty);
      expect(loaded.components.unknownOf(sampleSlabs.first), isNotEmpty);
    });

    test("with the catalog's registration alone: no live page", () {
      final loaded = DraftDocumentCodec.decodeString(bytes,
          measurer: measurer, registerComponents: catalog.registerComponents);
      expect(catalog.objectsOf<SlabComponent>(loaded), sampleSlabs);
      expect(loaded.components.isRegistered<PageComponent>(), isFalse);
      expect(pageOf(loaded), isNull);
      expect(loaded.components.unknownOf(loaded.rootHandle), isNotEmpty);
    });
  });
}
```

**Appendix A rows closed:** D-40, ruled: `PlanServices.isLocked`, `allows` and a settings listenable are **not added** (spec C1.5: no user in today's behaviour: the wall tool consults no lock, `jet_cad_floor_plan/lib/src/parametric/wall_tool.dart`; the opening tools have no keys; today's tools read their settings per event; a later kit that needs one adds it as an amendment). Recorded in this task and in the results note (Task 29). No old test file.

Plan decisions:
- **The live rule.** `KitServices.liveTypeIdOf(h)` is `null` when `h` is in the current session's frozen set (E2's set, `session.frozen`, which the system's `isFrozen` reads, `session.dart:100`), else the controller catalog's `typeIdOf` over the current document. That one rule gives the spec's three nulls: a frozen object; a missing kit's object, whose component is kept raw and is no registration of the catalog (`typeIdOf`'s doc, `parametric_system.dart:660-673`); anything that is not a root-level group a type names. It does **not** answer null for a locked live object (a frozen object's referent, Task 7): such an object is still regenerated by the system, so a kit that asks agrees with `generate`, which is the spec's purpose.
- **The catalog reaches the services through `ServicesHost`.** `ServicesHost` gains `ParametricCatalog get catalog` (the controller's, one for its life); `_Host` answers `_c.catalog`. `ServicesHost` has no other implementer (`grep -rn "implements ServicesHost"`: `plan_controller.dart:203` only).
- **No existing fake breaks, and none is a drop-in.** The workspace's other `PlanServices` are test fakes over `noSuchMethod` (`jet_cad_2d_kit/test/kit/plan_type_test.dart:32`, Task 2's `test/kit/object_view_test.dart` `_Services`, `jet_cad_2d_plan/test/tools/plan_symbol_tool_test.dart:349`, `test/tools/move_resolver_test.dart:20`, `test/attach/attachment_registry_test.dart:15`): a new abstract member compiles there unchanged. Each one throws on any read on purpose (it proves a factory or a provider reads nothing of the services), so a `FakePlanServices`, which answers, is no drop-in: none is replaced. Step 1 lists them again.
- **`FakePlanServices` mirrors the plan's rules** where a kit's test can see them: `settingsOf` throws `ArgumentError` for a tool without settings or settings that are not an `S` (`services.dart:58-73`); `shared` keeps one per `T`, refuses a `T` asked for while it is made, and disposes the `Disposable` ones last made first (`shared_cache.dart:12-52`); after `dispose`, `shared` throws `StateError`. Its camera is world to screen at `scale` pixels per millimetre, y up, the world origin at the screen origin (`Transform2(scale, 0, 0, -scale, 0, 0)`, the plan camera's flip, `plan_controller.dart:332-333`); `scale` must be positive and finite (`ViewportTransform` inverts it). `objectSnap` is fixed for the fake's life: a test that flips F3 makes a second fake. Per ruling R-P12, `settingsOf` reads the map it was given at each call (no copy), so a test changes a tool's settings between events; `words` is a `KitWords` (a `KitNamesWords`) over `names`, `locale` and `decimalSeparator` (R-P7: `KitWords implements` Task 3's pure `PlanWords` and adds `locale`; nothing here changes for it).

```dart
// Spec 3a C1.11: a PlanServices for a kit's tests, over a given document,
// with the plan library's rules where a kit can see them (settingsOf's
// refusals, shared's one per type and its disposal order).
import 'dart:ui' show Locale;

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart' show ValueListenable, ValueNotifier;
import 'package:jet_cad_2d/jet_cad_2d.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_flutter/jet_cad_2d_flutter.dart'
    show CameraController, ViewportTransform;

import '../kit/attachment.dart';
import '../kit/plan_services.dart';
import '../kit/symbols_state.dart';
import '../model/kit_names.dart';

/// A [PlanServices] over [document] for a kit's tests (spec 3a C1.11):
/// - [index]: a `SpatialIndex` over [document], made here;
/// - [camera]: world to screen at `scale` pixels per unit (positive and
///   finite), y up, the world origin at the screen's;
/// - [objectSnap]: as given, for the fake's life;
/// - [attachments]: the registry given, else one with no kind;
/// - [words]: `names` at `locale`, numbers with `decimalSeparator`;
/// - [settingsOf]: `settings[toolId]`, the map given read at each call
///   (never copied), so a test changes a tool's settings between events;
///   a tool without settings there, or settings that are not an `S`, is
///   an [ArgumentError], as the plan's;
/// - [shared]: one per `T`, the first call's; a `T` asked for while it is
///   made is a [StateError]; the [Disposable] ones are disposed by
///   [dispose], last made first;
/// - [symbolDefinition]: null (no library); [symbolsState]: ready;
/// - [liveTypeIdOf]: `catalog`'s `typeIdOf`, null for a handle in `frozen`
///   and without a catalog.
///
/// [dispose] releases the index, the camera, the state and the shared
/// objects; [document] is the caller's.
final class FakePlanServices implements PlanServices {
  FakePlanServices({
    required this.document,
    ParametricCatalog? catalog,
    Set<Handle> frozen = const {},
    double scale = 1,
    this.objectSnap = true,
    KitNames names = KitNames.empty,
    Locale locale = const Locale('en'),
    String decimalSeparator = '.',
    Map<String, Object> settings = const {},
    AttachmentRegistry? attachments,
  })  : _catalog = catalog,
        _frozen = frozen,
        _settings = settings,
        attachments = attachments ?? const _NoAttachments(),
        index = SpatialIndex(document),
        camera = CameraController(ViewportTransform(
            worldToScreenMatrix: Transform2(scale, 0, 0, -scale, 0, 0))),
        words = KitNamesWords(names, () => locale,
            decimalSeparator: () => decimalSeparator);

  final ParametricCatalog? _catalog;
  final Set<Handle> _frozen;
  final Map<String, Object> _settings;

  @override
  final DraftDocument document;

  @override
  final SpatialIndex index;

  @override
  final CameraController camera;

  @override
  final bool objectSnap;

  @override
  final AttachmentRegistry attachments;

  @override
  final KitWords words;

  final ValueNotifier<SymbolsState> _symbolsState =
      ValueNotifier(SymbolsState.ready);
  final Map<Type, Object> _shared = {};
  final List<Object> _made = [];
  final Set<Type> _making = {};
  bool _disposed = false;

  @override
  S settingsOf<S extends Object>(String toolId) {
    final value = _settings[toolId];
    if (value == null) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(toolId, 'toolId', 'has no settings here');
    }
    if (value is! S) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
          toolId, 'toolId', 'has settings of ${value.runtimeType}, not $S');
    }
    return value;
  }

  @override
  T shared<T extends Object>(T Function(PlanServices) create) {
    if (_disposed) throw StateError('shared<$T> after dispose');
    final found = _shared[T];
    if (found != null) return found as T;
    if (!_making.add(T)) {
      throw StateError('shared<$T> asked for itself while being made');
    }
    try {
      final made = create(this);
      _shared[T] = made;
      _made.add(made);
      return made;
    } finally {
      _making.remove(T);
    }
  }

  @override
  SymbolDefinitionRef? symbolDefinition(String key) => null;

  @override
  ValueListenable<SymbolsState> get symbolsState => _symbolsState;

  @override
  String? liveTypeIdOf(Handle handle) =>
      _frozen.contains(handle) ? null : _catalog?.typeIdOf(document, handle);

  /// Disposes the shared [Disposable]s, last made first, then the index,
  /// the camera and the state. Once only.
  void dispose() {
    if (_disposed) return;
    _disposed = true;
    for (final value in _made.reversed) {
      if (value is Disposable) value.dispose();
    }
    _made.clear();
    _shared.clear();
    index.dispose();
    camera.dispose();
    _symbolsState.dispose();
  }
}

/// No kind, no attachment.
final class _NoAttachments implements AttachmentRegistry {
  const _NoAttachments();

  @override
  Set<String> get kinds => const {};

  @override
  Attachment? attach(List<String> kinds, AttachmentQuery query) => null;
}
```

```dart
// answer liveTypeIdOf: a live object's type id, and null for a frozen
// object (E2), whose id the catalog's typeIdOf still answers, for a
// missing kit's object, and for anything that is no object. Squares and a
// disc off the origin, turned.
import 'package:flutter/material.dart' show Icons;
import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d/jet_cad_2d.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit/jet_cad_2d_kit.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_plan/jet_cad_2d_plan.dart';
import 'package:vector_math/vector_math_64.dart' show Vector2;

import '../support/box_kit.dart';

/// The box kit's square, and a tool whose factory hands [see] the kit's
/// services (a factory runs once per document; the services are the kit's
/// for the controller's life).
PlanKit seeingKit(Switches sw, void Function(PlanServices services) see) =>
    PlanKit(
      id: 'box',
      version: '1.4.0',
      types: [
        PlanType<SquareParams>(
            id: SquareParams.id,
            fromJson: SquareParams.fromJson,
            parametric: SquareType(sw)),
      ],
      tools: [
        PlanTool(
            id: 'box.stamp',
            icon: Icons.crop_square,
            create: (services) {
              see(services);
              return StampTool();
            }),
      ],
      names: const KitNames({
        'en': {'type:box.square': 'Square', 'tool:box.stamp': 'Stamp'},
      }),
    );

void main() {
  TestWidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized();

  test(
      'LS-frozen liveTypeIdOf: a live square\'s id; null for a frozen square '
      "(the catalog's typeIdOf still answers it), a missing kit's disc, a "
      'line, the root and a handle that names nothing', () {
    final sw = Switches();
    // A plan holding a disc of the ring kit, opened below without it.
    final withRing = PlanController(kits: [seeingKit(sw, (_) {}), ringKit(sw)]);
    addTearDown(withRing.dispose);
    final disc = addObject(withRing.document,
        nearSquare(-2500.5, 1800.25, 0.7), const DiscParams(radius: 400));
    final json = withRing.save();

    PlanServices? seen;
    final c = PlanController(kits: [seeingKit(sw, (s) => seen = s)], json: json);
    addTearDown(c.dispose);
    final s = seen!;
    final d = c.document;
    expect(c.locked.value, {disc}, reason: "premise: the missing kit's disc");
    final broken = addObject(
        d, atSquare, const SquareParams(side: 1200, poisoned: true));
    final healthy = addObject(
        d, nearSquare(4000, -500, 0.25), const SquareParams(side: 500));
    final line = addLine(d, Vector2(6100.5, 2950.25), Vector2(7400.75, 3600.5));
    expect(s.liveTypeIdOf(broken), SquareParams.id,
        reason: 'premise: live until its code fails');
    sw.failing.add('reach');
    expect(
        c.execute(TransformNodeCommand(broken, nearSquare(100.5, 50.25, 0))),
        isFalse);
    expect(c.frozen, {broken}, reason: 'premise: frozen');
    // M-LS-1: `KitServices.liveTypeIdOf` without its frozen test.
    expect(s.liveTypeIdOf(broken), isNull);
    expect(c.typeOf(broken)?.id, SquareParams.id,
        reason: "the catalog's typeIdOf still answers a frozen object");
    expect(s.liveTypeIdOf(healthy), SquareParams.id);
    expect(s.liveTypeIdOf(disc), isNull);
    expect(s.liveTypeIdOf(line), isNull);
    expect(s.liveTypeIdOf(d.rootHandle), isNull);
    expect(s.liveTypeIdOf(const Handle(0x7FFF1)), isNull);
  });
}
```

### Task 7: Grip refusals; a frozen object's references locked (spec C1.8, C1.10)

**Files:**
- Create (`packages/jet_cad_2d_plan/`): `test/kits/grip_refusal_test.dart`, `test/kits/frozen_references_test.dart`
- Modify (`packages/jet_cad_2d_plan/`): `lib/src/kits/guard.dart` (`GuardedGrips.drag`/`preview`, `GuardedTool.refusal`, `FailureBoundary.referencesOf`), `lib/src/controller/plan_controller.dart` (`execute` over a new `_refusal`, `_guardTool`, `_referencesOf`, the two boundaries' wiring), `lib/src/service/service_session.dart` (`referencesOf` passed to its boundary), `lib/src/kits/locks.dart` (docs only), `test/kits/locks_test.dart` (L-11's mutation comments only)
- Modify: `docs/kits.md` (§10.8), `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-14-plan-library-design-mode-design.md` (two lines in Task 2's `## Amendments` section)

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes:
  - Plan library today: `GuardedGrips` (`kits/guard.dart:485-560`), `GuardedTool` and `_failed` (`:253-321`), `FailureBoundary` and `_freeze` (`:585-621`), `LockSet.addBroken` (`kits/locks.dart:125-129`), `_LockCheck._first` and `_isRefusal` (`:289-320`), `PlanController.execute` (`controller/plan_controller.dart:793-817`), `_guardTool` (`:837-845`), `typeOf` (`:848-851`), `_open`'s boundary (`:1523-1530`), `_buildService` (`:1708-1720`), `ServiceSession`'s boundary (`service/service_session.dart:92-99`); the box kit (`test/support/box_kit.dart`: `Switches`, `SquareParams` with `partner`, `SquareType`, `boxKit`, `addObject`, `kids`, `canon`, `atSquare`, `nearSquare`), `test/support/tool_events.dart` (`useTestCamera`, `eventAt`).
  - Flutter layer (unchanged): `SelectTool.onPointerUp` executes the drop through `ctx.execute` and rethrows (`select_tool.dart:528-548`); `ToolContext.execute` is `document.commands.execute` (`tool.dart:108`); `GripDrag.command` asks the provider's `drag` at the drop's point (`grip_drag.dart:295-318`).
  - Engine: `ComponentRegistry.snapshotOf` (`document/component.dart:162`), `PermissionDeniedError` (`document/command.dart:72`), `RemoveEntityCommand`, `RemoveNodeCommand`.
- Produces: no new public name (Shared interfaces: "Task 7 (C1.8, C1.10): no new public names; LockSet locks the live references of frozen objects"). Internal: `GuardedTool({..., bool Function(Object error)? refusal})`, `FailureBoundary({..., Set<Handle> Function(DraftDocument document, Handle object)? referencesOf})`, `ServiceSession({..., Set<Handle> Function(DraftDocument document, Handle object)? referencesOf})`.

**Appendix A rows closed:** D-43, both items: `GuardedTool._failed`'s rethrow for a `plan.select` grip drop is retired (C1.8 (2), GR-drop-refuse), and the `_first` catch-all's probe is ruled (below). No old test file.

Plan decisions:
- **C1.8 (1), during the drag.** `GuardedGrips.drag` and `preview` catch `ArgumentError` (subclasses included, `RangeError`) before the catch-all: no move for that event (`drag` null, `preview` empty), the group not added to `_failed`, nothing reported. `gripsOf` and `movable` keep 2a's rule, as the spec names only the drag. Anything else `drag` or `preview` throws keeps 2a's rule (F-B1, `guard_boundaries_test.dart:78-117`, stays green).
- **C1.8 (2), at the drop: how "through `controller.execute`" is done.** `SelectTool` (jet_cad_2d_flutter, untouchable, A12) executes its one command through `ToolContext.execute`, which is `document.commands.execute` (`tool.dart:108`, a `final class` with no seam), and rethrows. So the plan library cannot route the drop through `PlanController.execute` itself; it gives the drop the same answer: `execute`'s refusal rule becomes one private function, `_refusal(Object error)` (the hint for `PlanLocked`; `DanglingReferenceError`, `PermissionDeniedError`, `ArgumentError`; a `KitHookFailure` reported once), which `execute` uses and which `_guardTool` gives to `plan.select`'s `GuardedTool` as its `refusal`. `GuardedTool._failed` asks it after its own `PlanLocked`/`DanglingReferenceError` branch (unchanged, so the hint is set as today for those) and before the rest: a refusal cancels the gesture, no exception, no `onFailed`. A `StateError` (`NonLiveWriteError` on an uncovered handle, `PartialMutationError`, any other) is not a refusal: `plan.select` rethrows it, as today (F-T4 stays green). Every other tool has no `refusal`, so its behaviour is unchanged (F-T1 to F-T3). This is the same outcome the spec asks for; see the interface problem below.
- **The ruling on `_first`'s catch-all (D-43's second item).** `_LockCheck._first` (`locks.dart:289-309`) sends any error that is neither a `KitHookFailure` nor a refusal (`_isRefusal`) to `onRefusedEdit` (`FailureBoundary.recoverRefused`), which probes every live kit object once (`_probeAll`, O(objects) `system.probe` calls). **Ruling: kept as it is.** The path is an error path (the engine's planner refusing a `generate`'s output, 2a final review I2); C1.8 (1)'s refused points never reach it (the guard answers null before any command exists); a drop whose command fails on an `ArgumentError` reaches it once, which is its purpose (a broken object found and frozen, the drop retried); and GR-drop-refuse pins that a drop no probe cures costs that one probe and then cancels quietly, with no diagnostic. Its cost is recorded, not changed: one probe of every live kit object per such failed edit.
- **C1.10, where the lock is taken.** Every freeze goes through `FailureBoundary._freeze` (`recover`, `recoverRefused`, `probeLoaded`, `reportUnreadable`), which adds the objects to the frozen set and calls `lock` (the controller's `lockBroken`, or `_lockFromCopy` in service). It now locks, with the frozen objects, the objects each one references, read by a callback the controller gives (`referencesOf`): the frozen object's type (`kits.typeOf(catalog.typeIdOf(d, h))`, which answers a frozen object's id), called on its component as stored (`snapshotOf(h).components`, the pair whose type id is the type's, so the call keeps the type's own `T`), keeping each referent the catalog names (a live object). A `references` that throws gives no referent: its type already failed and the object is frozen for it, with its diagnostic. An unreadable component (E4) is kept raw, names no type and gives none. `lockBroken` itself (an `@internal` test seam that locks without freezing) is unchanged: a locked object that is not frozen stays in every survey, so an edit of its referent already regenerates it and meets the lock.
- **What a locked referent refuses.** As any lock (2a P4): every edit that touches it, a delete included, on commit (`PlanLocked`, the hint) and up front (no grips, the gates shut). So an edit of another object whose regeneration would change the referent (a wall joined to a frozen door's host) is refused as well: it would change what the frozen object was drawn against. The referents are in `locked` (they join the lock set's broken roots); they are not frozen: they regenerate, and `liveTypeIdOf` (Task 6) still answers them.
- **Review Focus 3's "the drop commits that state".** The plan library's half is GR-drag-refuse: a refused point mid-drag gives no preview for that event and keeps the grips, the drop at an accepted point commits that point in one undo step, and a drop **at** a refused point commits nothing (the provider's `drag` is asked at the drop's point and refuses it, `grip_drag.dart:310-313`), with no exception and no diagnostic. "The last accepted state" at a refused drop is the kit's own to keep: see the interface problem.
- **The CHANGELOG** is written in Task 29.

```dart
// Spec 3a C1.8 (Task 7), Review Focus 3's contract half: a kit grip fails
// in two places. During the drag, an ArgumentError from the kit's `drag` or
// `preview` is that point refused: no move for that event, nothing
// reported, the grips kept (anything else keeps 2a's rule, F-B1). At the
// drop, plan.select's command is refused as the controller's execute
// refuses an edit: the drag cancelled, no exception; a StateError still
// goes on (F-T4). The square sits off the origin, turned 30 degrees, on a
// 1:50 page without grid snap; the camera is turned, flipped, 0.25 px/mm.
import 'package:flutter/gestures.dart' show kPrimaryButton;
import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d/jet_cad_2d.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_flutter/jet_cad_2d_flutter.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit/jet_cad_2d_kit.dart';

    show DiagnosticsLog, GuardedGrips;
import 'package:vector_math/vector_math_64.dart' show Vector2;

import '../support/box_kit.dart';
import '../support/tool_events.dart';

/// The shortest side the square's grip accepts.
const double kShortest = 400;

/// The square's one stretch grip, at the middle of its right edge: a drag
/// sets the side to twice the drop's distance along the square's own x
/// axis. A side below [kShortest] is refused with an ArgumentError, in
/// `drag` and in `preview` alike, as a wall-end grip refuses a wall too
/// short to join. [drop], when set, replaces the command `drag` answers.
final class _SideGrips implements ObjectGripProvider {
  DraftCommand Function(Handle group, SquareParams next)? drop;
  int refusals = 0;

  static Transform2 _toWorld(DraftDocument d, Handle group) =>
      (d.tree[group]! as GroupNode).transform;

  SquareParams _next(DraftDocument d, Handle group, Vector2 world) {
    final p = d.components.get<SquareParams>(group)!;
    final side = 2 * _toWorld(d, group).invert().transformPoint(world).x;
    if (side < kShortest) {
      refusals++;
      throw ArgumentError.value(side, 'side', 'is below $kShortest');
    }
    return p.copyWith(side: side);
  }

  @override
  List<Grip> gripsOf(DraftDocument d, Handle group) {
    final p = d.components.get<SquareParams>(group);
    if (p == null) return const [];
    final g = _toWorld(d, group).transformPoint(Vector2(p.side / 2, 0));
    return [Grip(GripRole.stretch, 0, g.x, g.y)];
  }

  @override
  DraftCommand? drag(DraftDocument d, Handle group, Grip grip, Vector2 world) {
    final next = _next(d, group, world);
    return drop?.call(group, next) ??
        SetComponentCommand<SquareParams>(group, next);
  }

  @override
  List<(EntityKind, GeometryPayload)> preview(
      DraftDocument d, Handle group, Grip grip, Vector2 world) {
    final h = _next(d, group, world).side / 2;
    final t = _toWorld(d, group);
    return [
      (
        EntityKind.line,
        linePayload(t.transformPoint(Vector2(h, -h)),
            t.transformPoint(Vector2(h, h)))
      ),
    ];
  }

  @override
  bool movable(DraftDocument d, Handle group) => true;
}

/// A command whose `apply` throws [error] before it touches anything.
final class _Refusing extends DraftCommand {
  _Refusing(this.error);
  final Object error;
  @override
  Capability get capability => Capability.components;
  @override
  String get label => 'Refusing';
  @override
  CommandResult apply(CommandTarget target) => throw error;
}

/// An inner grip provider throwing [error] from every call while it is
/// set.
final class _Throwing implements ObjectGripProvider {
  _Throwing(this.error);
  Object? error;

  void _maybe() {
    final e = error;
    if (e != null) throw e;
  }

  @override
  List<Grip> gripsOf(DraftDocument d, Handle group) {
    _maybe();
    return const [Grip(GripRole.stretch, 0, 7010, 3020)];
  }

  @override
  DraftCommand? drag(DraftDocument d, Handle group, Grip grip, Vector2 world) {
    _maybe();
    return TransformNodeCommand(
        group, Transform2.translation(world.x, world.y));
  }

  @override
  List<(EntityKind, GeometryPayload)> preview(
      DraftDocument d, Handle group, Grip grip, Vector2 world) {
    _maybe();
    return [(EntityKind.line, linePayload(Vector2(7010, 3020), world))];
  }

  @override
  bool movable(DraftDocument d, Handle group) => true;
}

/// A controller over the square with [_SideGrips], grid snap off, the
/// square selected, the test camera.
({PlanController c, Handle square, _SideGrips grips}) scene() {
  final grips = _SideGrips();
  final c = PlanController(kits: [
    PlanKit(
      id: 'box',
      version: '1.4.0',
      types: [
        PlanType<SquareParams>(
            id: SquareParams.id,
            fromJson: SquareParams.fromJson,
            parametric: SquareType(Switches()),
            grips: (services) => grips),
      ],
      names: const KitNames({
        'en': {'type:box.square': 'Square'},
      }),
    ),
  ]);
  addTearDown(c.dispose);
  final d = c.document;
  final page = d.components.get<PageComponent>(d.rootHandle)!;
  expect(
      c.execute(SetComponentCommand<PageComponent>(
          d.rootHandle, page.copyWith(snapToGrid: false))),
      isTrue);
  final square = addObject(d, atSquare, const SquareParams(side: 1200));
  useTestCamera(c);
  c.selection.replace([SelectionKey.root(square)]);
  return (c: c, square: square, grips: grips);
}

/// The world point of the grip of a square of [side] at [atSquare].
Vector2 at(double side) => atSquare.transformPoint(Vector2(side / 2, 0));

double sideOf(PlanController c, Handle h) =>
    c.document.components.get<SquareParams>(h)!.side;

/// A primary press at [points]' first, a move to each later one, a release
/// at the last, to the active tool.
void dragThrough(PlanController c, List<Vector2> points) {
  final tools = c.toolController;
  tools.active.onPointerMove(eventAt(c, points.first), tools.context);
  tools.active.onPointerDown(
      eventAt(c, points.first, buttons: kPrimaryButton), tools.context);
  for (final p in points.skip(1)) {
    tools.active
        .onPointerMove(eventAt(c, p, buttons: kPrimaryButton), tools.context);
  }
  tools.active.onPointerUp(eventAt(c, points.last), tools.context);
}
```

```dart
// Spec 3a C1.10 (Task 7), decision 6: a frozen object's live referents are
// locked with it. A frozen square references a healthy square (its
// cascade partner, as a frozen opening references its host wall): the
// partner can be neither edited nor deleted, up front or on commit, with

import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';

/// A host square, a poisoned square referencing it, and a third square;
/// the poisoned one frozen by one refused move (its reach throws); the
/// hint cleared.
({PlanController c, Handle host, Handle referrer, Handle other, String before})
    frozenReferrer() {
  final sw = Switches();

      d, nearSquare(2600.5, -900.25, 0.4), const SquareParams(side: 900));
  final referrer = addObject(
      d, atSquare, SquareParams(side: 1200, poisoned: true, partner: host));

      d, nearSquare(-3100.75, 1800.5, -0.6), const SquareParams(side: 700));
  sw.failing.add('reach');
  expect(
      c.execute(TransformNodeCommand(referrer, nearSquare(100.5, 50.25, 0))),
      isFalse);
  expect(c.frozen, {referrer}, reason: 'fixture: the referrer is frozen');
  c.lockHint.value = false;
  return (
    c: c,
    host: host,
    referrer: referrer,
    other: other,
    before: canon(d)
  );
}
```

```dart
  bool execute(DraftCommand command) {
    if (_service != null) return false;
    _pendingDefinitions.clear();
    try {
      document.commands.execute(command);
      return true;
    } catch (error) {
      if (_refusal(error)) return false;
      rethrow;
    }
  }

  /// Whether [error], thrown by an edit of the design, is a refusal: what
  /// [execute] answers false for, and what cancels plan.select's drop
  /// (spec 3a C1.8). [PlanLocked] ([lockHint] set), `DanglingReferenceError`,
  /// `PermissionDeniedError`, `ArgumentError`, and a [KitHookFailure] the
  /// retry did not cure (one diagnostic). Anything else, a `StateError`
  /// (`PartialMutationError` included) above all, is the caller's.
  bool _refusal(Object error) {
    switch (error) {
      case PlanLocked():
        lockHint.value = true;
        return true;
      case DanglingReferenceError() ||
            PermissionDeniedError() ||
            ArgumentError():
        return true;
      case final KitHookFailure failure:
        _reportFailure(failure);
        return true;
    }
    return false;
  }
```

  3. After `typeOf` (`:848-851`) add:

```dart

  /// The live objects [object] references in [d] (spec 3a C1.10): its
  /// type's `references`, called on its component as stored (the pair of
  /// its snapshot whose type id is the type's, so the call keeps the
  /// type's own `T`), each one a loaded kit's object in [d]. Empty when no
  /// loaded type names [object] (a missing kit's, an unreadable one's), and
  /// when `references` throws: the type already failed, and the object is
  /// frozen for it, with its diagnostic.
  Set<Handle> _referencesOf(DraftDocument d, Handle object) {
    final typeId = catalog.typeIdOf(d, object);
    final type = typeId == null ? null : kits.typeOf(typeId);
    if (type == null) return const {};
    for (final (id, component) in d.components.snapshotOf(object).components) {
      if (id != typeId) continue;
      try {
        return {
          for (final h in type.parametric.references(component))
            if (catalog.typeIdOf(d, h) != null) h,
        };
      } catch (_) {
        return const {};
      }
    }
    return const {};
  }
```

#### Interface problem

1. **C1.8 (2) "plan.select executes the drop command through `controller.execute`" cannot be done literally.** The drop is executed by `SelectTool.onPointerUp` (`packages/jet_cad_2d_flutter/lib/src/select_tool.dart:528-548`) through `ctx.execute(command)`, and `ToolContext` is a `final class` whose `execute` is `document.commands.execute(command)` (`packages/jet_cad_2d_flutter/lib/src/tool.dart:82-109`); jet_cad_2d_flutter may not change (Global Constraints, A12). **Proposed fix (taken in this task, no public name):** `execute`'s refusal rule becomes one function, `_refusal`, used by `execute` and given to plan.select's `GuardedTool` as `refusal`; the drop then gets exactly `execute`'s answer (a refusal cancels the drag, a `StateError` goes on). The 3a spec's C1.8 wording may want "is refused as `controller.execute` refuses it" in its next revision.
2. **(Resolved by rulings R-P15 and R-P17: a drop at a refused point commits nothing; the preview there is empty, today's.)** **Review Focus 3's "the drop commits that state" (the last accepted one) is not the plan library's to give.** At the drop, `GripDrag.command` asks the provider's `drag` at the drop's own point (`packages/jet_cad_2d_flutter/lib/src/grip_drag.dart:303-313`); a point the kit refuses there gives no command, so the plan commits nothing (GR-drag-refuse). Today's wall grips do the same: `WallGrips.drag` answers null for a wall no longer than `wallJoin.linear` (`packages/jet_cad_floor_plan/lib/src/parametric/wall_grips.dart:60-63, 198`), so today's drop at a too-short point commits nothing either. **Proposed fix:** Review Focus 3's expectation reads "a refused event shows no preview and reports nothing; a drop at an accepted point commits it in one undo step; a drop at a refused point commits nothing; the grips stay usable" unless Task 12's oracle (today's `wall_grips_test`) shows otherwise; if the human wants "the last accepted state" at a refused drop, that is the kit's wall grips keeping it (a kit-side behaviour change, against A12), to be ruled before Task 12.

Plan decisions:
- **D-44, the cause.** A `PlanShortcuts` remounted on the same controller (a new key, a new parent) gets a new `State`: the new one's `initState` closes the idle keys during the build, and the old one's `dispose` runs later, at the frame's `finalizeTree`, and reopens them (`plan_shortcuts.dart:89-100`). KB-14 (`plan_shortcuts_test.dart:417-440`) pins a controller swap and a removal, not this. **The fix:** each controller's mounted shortcuts states are kept in mount order (a static `Expando<List<_PlanShortcutsState>>` keyed by the controller); the last mounted speaks for its controller's idle keys; a state that leaves (disposed, or its controller swapped out) hands the say to the one before it, or, with none left, gives the keys back (today's rule). KB-14 keeps passing: a swap leaves the old controller with no state (keys back), a removal likewise.
- **D-45, the registry.** Both untested behaviours exist (`attachment_registry.dart:31-33`: the `kind` read inside the factory's try; `:101-111`: one provider's dispose that throws is reported and the others still disposed): pinned by PN-kind and PN-dispose, each with its mutation. No code change.
- **D-45, the move resolver** (2a `task-14-review.md:51-57`, item 3):
  - the scaled instance: MV-2 already fails when `if (!isOrthonormal(t)) return null;` is deleted (its scaled instance is then asked, and `expect(scaled.edge.queries, isEmpty)` fails); only the mutation was unnamed: M-PN-ortho, named in MV-2's comment and run here;
  - the non-symbol arm: MV-2's line case is an entity, refused by `n is! InstanceNode`, whose deletion does not compile (`n.parent` and `n.definition` read an `InstanceNode`): a positive control. The parent check (`n.parent != doc.rootHandle`) had no case: PN-MV-nested (an instance of the same attaching definition inside a root group);
  - the node reset (`_sync`'s `_last = null` on a new node within one state): PN-MV-node;
  - the definition's box against the entry's: MV-4 cannot tell them apart (the leaves are unedited); PN-MV-live edits the definition's outline between two asks in one drag's life and expects the live box (`_sync` clears `_boxes` on a new state).
- **D-45, `_open`'s report.** AT-16 cannot see `_open`'s `_reportUnofferedKinds()`: after `newPlan()` the same kind is deduplicated by the log. PN-open makes the new document's providers offer another kind, so `_open` has a new kind to report (the libraries load once, in the constructor, `plan_controller.dart:366`: after `newPlan`, `_open`'s call is the only report).
- **SE8 (C7).** 2b's placement tests pin the copy's unit (`symbol_placer_test.dart` SP-1, M-SP1a) on a quarter-turned, mirrored, off-origin placement, but not SE8's other two lines: the unit survives a save, and one undo step takes it away with the definition. So SE8 is ported, over the plan's placer and a library written as the test kit's unit library is (a `Catalog` of kit `test` with a `CatalogUnit`, `test/support/test_kit.dart:759-818`), with SE8's own table (600 x 400 top, one 300 x 300 seat, base `(300, 500)`, three seats) so its numbers stay. Changes: the key `test.table` → `test.table.plain` (C7 class 1: K2 needs two segments after the kit); `jetcad.seating` → the contract's `jetcad.unit` (2b's successor, 2b spec S2: `SeatingComponent(seats: 3)` → `UnitComponent(kind: UnitKinds.table, capacity: 3)`, the same three seats); `registerAppComponents` → `registerKitComponents`. The component's rename is C7 class 1 by ruling R-P16 (2b's `SeatingComponent` → `UnitComponent(kind: table, capacity: n)` counts as an id change).

- [ ] **Step 3: The D-44 fix.** `packages/jet_cad_2d_plan/lib/src/shortcuts/plan_shortcuts.dart`, `_PlanShortcutsState` (`:63-107`): `initState`, `didUpdateWidget`, `dispose`, `_restoreIdleKeys` and `_applyIdleKeys` become:

```dart
class _PlanShortcutsState extends State<PlanShortcuts> {
  /// Each controller's mounted shortcuts, in mount order: the last one
  /// speaks for the controller's idle keys. A remount mounts the new state
  /// before the old one is disposed (D-44), so the old one's leaving must
  /// not undo the new one's say.
  static final Expando<List<_PlanShortcutsState>> _speakers =
      Expando<List<_PlanShortcutsState>>('plan shortcuts');

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _join(widget.controller);
    widget.controller.addListener(_applyIdleKeys);
    _applyIdleKeys();
  }

  @override
  void didChangeDependencies() {
    super.didChangeDependencies();
    PlanLocaleScope.push(context, widget.controller);
  }

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(PlanShortcuts oldWidget) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);
    if (!identical(oldWidget.controller, widget.controller)) {
      oldWidget.controller.removeListener(_applyIdleKeys);
      _leave(oldWidget.controller);
      _join(widget.controller);
      widget.controller.addListener(_applyIdleKeys);
      PlanLocaleScope.push(context, widget.controller);
    }
    _applyIdleKeys();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    widget.controller.removeListener(_applyIdleKeys);
    _leave(widget.controller);
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _join(PlanController c) =>
      (_speakers[c] ??= <_PlanShortcutsState>[]).add(this);

  /// This state no longer speaks for [c]: the shortcuts mounted before it
  /// speak again; with none left, [c]'s select tool gets its idle keys
  /// back (final review), so a removed `shortcuts: false` leaves Delete
  /// and Escape working in the canvas.
  void _leave(PlanController c) {
    final speakers = _speakers[c];
    speakers?.remove(this);
    if (speakers == null || speakers.isEmpty) {
      _speakers[c] = null;
      if (!c.isDisposed) c.selectGates.idleKeys = true;
      return;
    }
    speakers.last._applyIdleKeys();
  }

  /// The select tool's idle keys are the shortcuts (S-16), set by the
  /// shortcuts that speak for the controller (mounted last). The gates
  /// are per document, so this runs again after a swap (the controller
  /// notifies).
  void _applyIdleKeys() {
    final c = widget.controller;
    if (c.isDisposed || !identical(_speakers[c]?.last, this)) return;
    c.selectGates.idleKeys = widget.shortcuts;
  }
```

```dart
// D-17's SE8 (spec 3a C7, C1.12; Task 8): jet_cad_floor_plan's
// test/symbols/seating_test.dart SE8, ported over the plan library's
// placer. 2b's SP-1 (symbol_placer_test.dart) pins the copy's unit; SE8
// also pins that it survives a save and goes with the definition in one
// undo step. The library is written as the test kit's unit library is (a
// Catalog of kit "test" with a CatalogUnit), with SE8's own table. 2b
// replaced jetcad.seating with the contract's jetcad.unit (2b spec S2):
// SeatingComponent(seats: 3) is UnitComponent(kind: table, capacity: 3);
// the key test.table is test.table.plain (K2).
import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d/jet_cad_2d.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit/authoring.dart'
    show Catalog, CatalogPolyline, CatalogSymbol, CatalogUnit, encodeLibrary;
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit/jet_cad_2d_kit.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_plan/src/symbols/symbol_placer.dart';
import 'package:vector_math/vector_math_64.dart' show Vector2;

/// A 600 x 400 table with one 300 x 300 seat below it, its base point at
/// the top's centre (off the origin); three seats.
SymbolEntry table() => SymbolLibrary.decode(encodeLibrary(Catalog(
      kit: 'test',
      symbols: [
        CatalogSymbol(
          key: 'test.table.plain',
          name: 'Test table',
          category: 'Tests',
          tags: const ['table', 'test'],
          unit: const CatalogUnit(kind: UnitKinds.table, capacity: 3),
          base: (300, 500),
          shapes: const [
            CatalogPolyline([(0, 300), (600, 300), (600, 700), (0, 700)],
                closed: true),
            CatalogPolyline([(150, 0), (450, 0), (450, 300), (150, 300)],
                closed: true),
          ],
        ),
      ],
    ))).entries.single;

DraftDocument plan() {
  final doc = DraftDocument.empty();
  registerKitComponents(doc.components);
  doc.header.units = DrawingUnits.millimeters;
  return doc;
}

Handle definitionOfOnlyInstance(DraftDocument doc) =>
    doc.tree.nodes.whereType<InstanceNode>().single.definition;

void main() {
  test(
      'SE8 a quarter-turned, mirrored, off-origin placement copies the '
      'seats with the definition, and they survive a save (M-14s-3)', () {
    final entry = table();
    final doc = plan();
    doc.commands.execute(placeSymbol(doc, entry,
        at: Vector2(12345, -6789), quarterTurns: 3, mirrored: true));
    final def = definitionOfOnlyInstance(doc);
    expect(doc.components.get<UnitComponent>(def),
        UnitComponent(kind: UnitKinds.table, capacity: 3));
    final reloaded = DraftDocumentCodec.decodeString(
        DraftDocumentCodec.encodeToString(doc),
        registerComponents: registerKitComponents);
    expect(reloaded.components.get<UnitComponent>(def),
        UnitComponent(kind: UnitKinds.table, capacity: 3));
    // One undo step takes it away with the definition.
    doc.commands.undo();
    expect(doc.components.get<UnitComponent>(def), isNull);
  });
}
```

- D-47, the words half: the kit validates and conformance holds German and Turkish complete over every code-side word (SC-conformance); the catalog half is Task 23's.
- D-28, the hook half: the kit's `prepare` writes the DASHED record on the plans the plan library makes (SC-prepare); `new_document_test`'s DASHED lines are Task 17's.

Plan decisions and rulings:
- **The words.** Today's strings (`jet_cad_floor_plan/lib/src/l10n/strings_en.dart:61, :76-97, :190-250, :304-308, :416, :422-437`; `strings_de.dart:61, :76-97, :190-250, :304-308, :420, :426-441`; `strings_tr.dart:60, :75-96, :189-249, :303-307, :414, :420-435`) under the plan's ids. A parameterised member becomes a template (`roomName(n)` → `'Room {n}'`; `endOnWall(wall, atStart, side)` → `'Wall {wall}, {end}, {side}'` with `end-start`/`end-end` as the two words of today's `atStart ? 'start' : 'end'`). New words, which no string carries today (the specs add them, C2 "Words"): `type:architecture.opening` (`Opening`/`Wandöffnung`/`Açıklık`: the German `Öffnung` is today's Gap tool's), `property:architecture.wall.justification` (`Justification`/`Ausrichtung`/`Hizalama`: today's segmented button has no label, `selection_panel.dart:1313-1331`), `property:architecture.dimension.kind` (`Kind`/`Art`/`Tür`), `property:architecture.dimension.axes` (`Axes`/`Achsen`/`Eksenler`), and `text:architecture.dimension-value` (`{value}` in every language: today's notice is the value alone, `'Dimension — 4.69'`). Type words otherwise repeat the tool words (today's section titles are the tool strings, `selection_panel.dart:1304, 1309, 1378, 945`).
- **German words equal to English** (`Position`, `Name`, `Horizontal`) are listed in `architectureSameAsEnglish`, which conformance takes as `sameAsEnglish`; `text:architecture.dimension-value` is listed too, for `de` and `tr`: Task 3's conformance holds every English `text:` word to the declared locales, `wordUntranslated` included, and a lone `{value}` is the same in every language.
- **SC-conformance runs over the empty catalog** (spec C2 "The conformance test checks every locale complete"; `builder_test.dart` B7 pins that an empty catalog builds). Its code ids are the words' own `type:`, `tool:` and `property:` ids joined with the descriptor's (`architectureKit.types`, `.tools`, `.propertyIds`), so every later type task is held to the table without editing this test, and a property id a task adds without a word fails here.
- **`analysis_options.yaml` (plan decision, Global Constraints):** each new package's is a copy of `packages/jet_cad_2d_plan/analysis_options.yaml`, created and committed once, here, by explicit path. Step 1 checks that the human confirmed it.
- **Dependencies:** the kit lists `meta` and `vector_math` besides the four Global Constraints name, and the integration package lists the engine, the Flutter layer, the contract and `vector_math` directly: see "Interface problem".
- **`tool/ci`:** SC16 (`scripts_test.dart:333-347`) already requires every `packages/*` directory in the CI matrix, so it goes red the moment the two packages exist without their entries; SC20c pins the integration package's `--enable-vmservice` (as SC20b does the plan library's, `:437-447`). `dependency_lines_test.dart`'s list (`:12-23`) is the old line's pubspecs (2a and 2b did not add theirs) and is not changed; `readmes_test.dart` checks only the README probes it names (`:12-16`) and the kit's README carries no Dart block.
- **The integration package's entry sits before `jet_cad_floor_plan` in the matrix:** SC20b and SC20c read up to the next `- package: ` line, which the last entry of the matrix does not have.

```markdown
# jet_cad_2d_kit_architecture

The architecture kit of jet_cad_2d plans: walls, doors, windows and gaps,
room separators, rooms, dimensions, boxes, a furniture library and the
```

```markdown
# jet_cad_2d_integration

Not published. The tests that run the architecture kit
(`jet_cad_2d_kit_architecture`) inside the plan library's widgets
(`jet_cad_2d_plan`): the kit's tools on the canvas, its property sections,
the layer rules for its objects, its grips through the select tool, the
wall attachment end to end, and the export of rooms and separators.

A kit may not name the plan library (umbrella A1,
`tool/ci/check_kit_deps.dart`), and the plan library's own tests stay free
of any domain, so these tests live here, in a package that imports both
through their public libraries only, as a host does (spec 3a C6). `lib/`
holds the fixtures, `test/` the tests.

Run with `flutter test --enable-vmservice`: the paint-allocation invariant
reads the VM's allocation profiler.
```

  3. Create `packages/jet_cad_2d_kit_architecture/test/scaffold/live_test.dart`:

```dart
// Spec 3a C1.5: the kit asks "is this a live T" of the plan's services,
// never of a catalog of its own. Two test types in a catalog of their own,
// groups far off the origin and turned by 0.3 + 0.7k rad, one of them
// frozen.
import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d/jet_cad_2d.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit/testing.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit_architecture/src/live.dart';

final class Peg implements Component {
  const Peg();

  static const String id = 'architecture.peg';

  @override
  String get typeId => id;

  @override
  Map<String, Object?> toJson() => const {};

  static Peg fromJson(Map<String, Object?> json) => const Peg();
}

final class Pin implements Component {
  const Pin();

  static const String id = 'architecture.pin';

  @override
  String get typeId => id;

  @override
  Map<String, Object?> toJson() => const {};

  static Pin fromJson(Map<String, Object?> json) => const Pin();
}

/// A type that draws nothing: only the naming rule is under test.
final class Inert<T extends Component> extends ParametricType<T> {
  const Inert();

  @override
  Capability get editCapability => Capability.geometry;

  @override
  Aabb2 reach(T params, Transform2 toWorld) => Aabb2.empty();

  @override
  List<Generated> generate(ParametricView view, Handle self) => const [];
}

Handle add<T extends Component>(DraftDocument doc, int h, T value, double k) {
  final handle = Handle(h);
  doc.commands.execute(CompoundCommand([
    AddNodeCommand(GroupNode(
        handle: handle,
        parent: doc.rootHandle,
        transform: Transform2.translation(4500000 + 311.5 * k, -173.25 * k)
            .multiply(Transform2.rotation(0.3 + 0.7 * k)),
        children: const [])),
    SetComponentCommand<T>(handle, value),
  ], label: 'Add'));
  return handle;
}

void main() {
  test(
      'SC-live liveTypesOf answers the services\' live type id; isLiveOf and '
      'liveObjectsOf read it: a frozen object is in neither, while the '
      'catalog still names it', () {
    final doc = DraftDocument.empty();
    addTearDown(doc.dispose);
    final catalog = ParametricCatalog()
      ..register<Peg>(Peg.id, Peg.fromJson, const Inert<Peg>())
      ..register<Pin>(Pin.id, Pin.fromJson, const Inert<Pin>());
    catalog.registerComponents(doc.components);
    final frozen = add(doc, 4050, const Peg(), 1);
    final a = add(doc, 4100, const Peg(), 2);
    final b = add(doc, 4200, const Pin(), 3);
    final c = add(doc, 4300, const Peg(), 4);
    final services = FakePlanServices(
        document: doc, catalog: catalog, frozen: {frozen});
    addTearDown(services.dispose);
    expect(catalog.typeIdOf(doc, frozen), Peg.id,
        reason: 'premise: the catalog names a frozen object');

    final live = liveTypesOf(services);
    // M-SC-live-3: liveTypesOf answering null for everything.
    expect(live(a), Peg.id);
    expect(live(b), Pin.id);
    expect(live(frozen), isNull);
    expect(live(doc.rootHandle), isNull);
    // M-SC-live-2: isLiveOf asking only "is it live".
    expect(isLiveOf(live, a, Peg.id), isTrue);
    expect(isLiveOf(live, b, Peg.id), isFalse);
    expect(isLiveOf(live, frozen, Peg.id), isFalse);
    // M-SC-live-1: liveObjectsOf without its filter.
    expect(liveObjectsOf<Peg>(doc, live, Peg.id), [a, c]);
    expect(liveObjectsOf<Pin>(doc, live, Pin.id), [b]);
  });
}
```

```dart
// its global parametricCatalog.
import 'package:jet_cad_2d/jet_cad_2d.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit/jet_cad_2d_kit.dart' show PlanServices;

/// The type id of [handle]'s live object, or null: a frozen object, one of
/// a missing kit, and anything that is not a live object answer null.
typedef LiveTypeOf = String? Function(Handle handle);

/// The plan's answer: `PlanServices.liveTypeIdOf`.
LiveTypeOf liveTypesOf(PlanServices services) => services.liveTypeIdOf;

/// Whether [handle] is a live object of [typeId].
bool isLiveOf(LiveTypeOf live, Handle handle, String typeId) =>
    live(handle) == typeId;

/// Every live object of [typeId] carrying a `T` in [document], ascending by
/// handle value (`ComponentRegistry.withComponent` is ascending; the filter
/// keeps it): today's `liveObjectsOf<T>(doc)`. A fresh list.
///
/// Cost: O(k) calls of [live] for k holders of a `T`.
List<Handle> liveObjectsOf<T extends Component>(
        DraftDocument document, LiveTypeOf live, String typeId) =>
    [
      for (final h in document.components.withComponent<T>())
        if (live(h) == typeId) h,
    ];
```

  7. `example/main.dart`:

```dart
// The architecture kit as a host sees it. A host passes `architectureKit` to
// the plan library -- `PlanController(kits: [architectureKit])`, and a
// `PlanEditor` over it (the plan library's package) -- which this package
// does not depend on, nor does its example (umbrella A1). What the example shows
// is the descriptor itself, and the one hook a new plan runs: `prepare`,
// which gives a document the separators' DASHED linetype.
//
// The kit is a Flutter library (its tools draw with Flutter's icons): the
// example is analysed with the package, and test/example_test.dart runs it.
import 'dart:async' show unawaited;

import 'package:jet_cad_2d/jet_cad_2d.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit_architecture/jet_cad_2d_kit_architecture.dart';

/// The kit's descriptor, line by line: its id and version, its types, its
/// tools with their letters, what `validate` finds, and what `prepare`
/// writes into a bare engine document.
List<String> describeArchitectureKit() {
  final kit = architectureKit;
  final problems = kit.validate();
  final doc = DraftDocument.empty();
  kit.prepare?.call(doc);
  final dashed = doc.tables.linetypes[ReservedHandles.dashedLinetype];
  unawaited(doc.dispose());
  return [
    '${kit.id} ${kit.version}: ${kit.types.length} types, '
        '${kit.tools.length} tools',
    for (final type in kit.types)
      '${type.id}${type.exported ? '' : ' (not exported)'}',
    for (final tool in kit.tools) '${tool.id} (${tool.letter})',
    problems.isEmpty
        ? 'validate: no problems'
        : 'validate: ${problems.length} problems',
    dashed == null
        ? 'prepare: no DASHED record'
        : 'prepare: ${dashed.name} at handle ${dashed.handle.value}',
  ];
}

void main() {
  for (final line in describeArchitectureKit()) {
    print(line);
  }
}
```

```dart
// The integration tests' editor rig (spec 3a C6): PlanEditor over a
// controller in planEditorApp, at 1440 x 900, under a zoomed, turned,
// non-reflecting camera; the status line, a key press, a world point's
// global position and the active tool; a plan holding only a page; the kit's
// types in an engine catalog; a controller's live objects of one type. Its
// own copies of the plan library's test fixtures (canvas_fixture.dart's
// pumpDraw and globalOf, design_harness.dart's status and press), which
// another package cannot import, over the public libraries only.
import 'dart:async' show unawaited;

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter/services.dart' show LogicalKeyboardKey;
import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d/jet_cad_2d.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_flutter/jet_cad_2d_flutter.dart'
    show InteractionLayer, Tool, ViewportTransform;
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_integration/jet_cad_2d_integration.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit_architecture/jet_cad_2d_kit_architecture.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_plan/jet_cad_2d_plan.dart';
import 'package:vector_math/vector_math_64.dart' show Vector2;

/// Pumps [c]'s editor in [locale] at 1440 x 900 (reset after the test).
/// With [centre], then sets a camera turned by [turn] at [scale] px/mm,
/// **non-reflecting** (a reflection's `b == c` hides a transposition),
/// with [centre] in the middle of the drawing area: the plan library's
/// `pumpDraw` (canvas_fixture.dart:427-443) over PlanEditor. [wrap], when
/// given, wraps the app (a capture boundary, Task 14's RD1).
Future<void> pumpEditor(WidgetTester tester, PlanController c,
    {Locale locale = const Locale('en'),
    Vector2? centre,
    double scale = 2,
    double turn = 0.35,
    Widget Function(Widget app)? wrap}) async {
  await tester.binding.setSurfaceSize(const Size(1440, 900));
  addTearDown(() => tester.binding.setSurfaceSize(null));
  final app = planEditorApp(c, locale: locale);
  await tester.pumpWidget(wrap == null ? app : wrap(app));
  await tester.pump();
  if (centre == null) return;
  final size = tester.getSize(find.byType(InteractionLayer));
  final linear =
      Transform2.rotation(turn).multiply(Transform2.scale(scale, scale));
  final mid = linear.transformPoint(centre);
  c.camera.value = ViewportTransform(
      worldToScreenMatrix: Transform2.translation(
              size.width / 2 - mid.x, size.height / 2 - mid.y)
          .multiply(linear));
  await tester.pump();
}

/// World ([x], [y])'s global position under [c]'s camera.
Offset globalOf(WidgetTester tester, PlanController c, double x, double y) {
  final s = c.camera.value.worldToScreen(Vector2(x, y));
  return tester.getTopLeft(find.byType(InteractionLayer)) + Offset(s.x, s.y);
}

/// World [p]'s global position ([globalOf] over a point).
Offset globalAt(WidgetTester tester, PlanController c, Vector2 p) =>
    globalOf(tester, c, p.x, p.y);

/// The editor's status line (`status-text`).
String status(WidgetTester tester) =>
    tester.widget<Text>(find.byKey(const Key('status-text'))).data!;

/// Sends [key], then a pump: whether a handler took it.
Future<bool> press(WidgetTester tester, LogicalKeyboardKey key) async {
  final handled = await tester.sendKeyEvent(key);
  await tester.pump();
  return handled;
}

/// The canvas's active tool, as its interaction layer holds it: a kit's
/// tool in the plan library's guard, which forwards `isMidShape`.
Tool activeTool(WidgetTester tester) =>
    tester.widget<InteractionLayer>(find.byType(InteractionLayer)).tools.active;

/// A plan holding [page] and nothing else (no manifest kit, no DASHED
/// record): `jet_cad_floor_plan/test/support/box_rig.dart:16-28`'s
/// `boxDoc`, as the text a controller opens.
String pagePlanJson(PageComponent page) {
  final doc = DraftDocument.empty();
  PageComponent.register(doc.components);
  doc.commands
      .execute(SetComponentCommand<PageComponent>(doc.rootHandle, page));
  doc.commands.clearHistory();
  final json = ensureManifest(DraftDocumentCodec.encodeToString(doc));
  unawaited(doc.dispose());
  return json;
}

/// The kit's types (`architectureKit.types`) in an engine catalog of their
/// own, unguarded: for `ParametricSystem(c.document, kitCatalog()).drift()`.
ParametricCatalog kitCatalog() {
  final catalog = ParametricCatalog();
  for (final type in architectureKit.types) {
    type.registerInto(catalog);
  }
  return catalog;
}

/// [c]'s live objects of [typeId] carrying a `T`, ascending: today's
/// `liveObjectsOf<T>(doc)` through the controller's `typeOf` (E1).
List<Handle> liveOf<T extends Component>(PlanController c, String typeId) => [
      for (final h in c.document.components.withComponent<T>())
        if (c.typeOf(h)?.id == typeId) h,
    ];
```
