```dart
// Spec 3a C1.3, C3.4; Review Focus 1, the kit half (the plan half is Task
// 5's PB3-prepare-load): a plan the library makes holds the separators'
// DASHED record at handle 6, clean and with nothing to undo; a loaded file
// without it opens, and saves back, without it (today's R-3).
import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d/jet_cad_2d.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_integration/jet_cad_2d_integration.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_plan/jet_cad_2d_plan.dart';

/// The kit's kDashedLinetypeRecord, written out (it is not exported):
/// jet_cad_floor_plan/lib/src/parametric/separator.dart:128-133.
const LinetypeRecord dashed = LinetypeRecord(
  handle: ReservedHandles.dashedLinetype,
  name: 'DASHED',
  description: 'Dashed __ __ __',
  pattern: DashPattern(dashes: [200, -100], totalLength: 300),
);

void main() {
  testWidgets(
      'SC-prepare a new plan holds DASHED at handle 6, clean, with nothing to '
      'undo, and so does newPlan; a loaded file without it opens and saves '
      'back without it', (tester) async {
    final c = architectureController();
    addTearDown(c.dispose);
    // M-SC-1 (no prepare) and M-SC-2 (another pattern).
    expect(c.document.tables.linetypes[ReservedHandles.dashedLinetype], dashed);
    expect(c.dirty.value, isFalse);
    expect(c.canUndo.value, isFalse);
    expect(c.document.commands.undoDepth, 0);

    c.newPlan(decimalSeparator: ',');
    expect(c.document.tables.linetypes[ReservedHandles.dashedLinetype], dashed);
    expect(c.dirty.value, isFalse);
    expect(c.canUndo.value, isFalse);

    // A plan with no kit, so no prepare: no record.
    final bare = PlanController(kits: const []);
    addTearDown(bare.dispose);
    expect(
        bare.document.tables.linetypes
            .contains(ReservedHandles.dashedLinetype),
        isFalse,
        reason: 'premise: no kit, no record');
    final file = bare.save();

    final opened = architectureController(json: file);
    addTearDown(opened.dispose);
    expect(
        opened.document.tables.linetypes
            .contains(ReservedHandles.dashedLinetype),
        isFalse,
        reason: 'open adds nothing');
    expect(opened.document.tables.linetypes.byName('DASHED'), isNull);
    expect(opened.dirty.value, isFalse);
    expect(opened.save(), file, reason: 'byte-identical');

    c.load(file);
    expect(
        c.document.tables.linetypes.contains(ReservedHandles.dashedLinetype),
        isFalse,
        reason: 'a load adds nothing either');
    expect(c.save(), file);
  });
}
```

Plan decisions and rulings:
- **The strict bound lives in `write`** (spec C1.1, C3.1): today's panel commits a box side when `value.isFinite && value > 0` (`jet_cad_floor_plan/lib/src/selection_panel.dart:415-417`); the field already refuses a value that is not finite (`properties.dart:376-379`), and `write` throws `ArgumentError` for the rest, which the panel takes as a silent refusal (`jet_cad_2d_plan/lib/src/panels/plan_property_panel.dart:497-525`). No constant `min`: an inclusive `min: 0` would accept 0.
- **The gate is `reshape`**: today a box side is editable only with the host's `reshape` (`selection_panel.dart:384-390`, `_capable`), plus the `components` permission and the type's `editCapability`, which the plan library checks for every field.
- **No grips, no colour, no section, exported** (today's: `ObjectGrips._of` has no box branch, `object_grips.dart:80-86`; `pickedColors` lists rooms and tables only).
- **The tool's icon** is `Icons.crop_din` (today's palette has text rows only, `planner_shell.dart:546-552`; the plan's box stand-in uses this icon, `panel_kits.dart:316`).
- **The integration fixture's grid snap is on** (BX1-BX6): under the editor's turned camera a click's world point does not come back exactly (the plan library measured 120 × 69.99999999999955 for BX4's first box, `jet_cad_2d_plan/test/panels/selection_panel_test.dart:38-43`, and turned the grid on there); the grid gives the clicks today's exact corners. final Transform2 atA = Transform2.translation(7010.5, 3020.25)

```dart
// The box as the kit declares it (spec 3a C3.1): its PlanType, whose two
// properties are lengths above zero (today's panel rule,
// jet_cad_floor_plan/lib/src/selection_panel.dart:415-417), refused in
// write and gated by reshape (:384-390); and its PlanTool, B (today's
// palette entry, planner_shell.dart:546-552). No grips, as today.
import 'package:flutter/material.dart' show Icons;
import 'package:jet_cad_2d/jet_cad_2d.dart' show Capability;
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit/jet_cad_2d_kit.dart';

import '../ids.dart';
import 'box.dart';
import 'box_tool.dart';

/// [v] when it is above zero; otherwise an [ArgumentError], which the
/// property panel takes as a silent refusal (the field shows the stored
/// value). The field has already refused a value that is not finite.
double _positive(double v) =>
    v > 0 ? v : throw ArgumentError.value(v, 'length', 'must be above 0');

/// The box's type: width and height, each a length above zero.
final PlanType<BoxParams> boxPlanType = PlanType<BoxParams>(
  id: ArchitectureTypes.box,
  fromJson: BoxParams.fromJson,
  parametric: const BoxType(),
  properties: [
    LengthProperty<BoxParams>(
        id: 'width',
        read: (p) => p.width,
        write: (p, v) => p.copyWith(width: _positive(v)),
        gate: PlanGate.reshape),
    LengthProperty<BoxParams>(
        id: 'height',
        read: (p) => p.height,
        write: (p, v) => p.copyWith(height: _positive(v)),
        gate: PlanGate.reshape),
  ],
);

/// The Box tool: two opposite corners, one box.
final PlanTool boxPlanTool = PlanTool(
  id: ArchitectureTools.box,
  icon: Icons.crop_din,
  letter: 'B',
  needs: const {
    Capability.structure,
    Capability.components,
    Capability.geometry,
  },
  create: (_) => BoxTool(),
);
```

So this task's `WallType` has **no cut** (`wall.dart:199` and `:203`'s `_cut` line, `:215-238`'s `_cut`) and **no place hooks** (`:172-189`: `contributesPlace`, `placeBox`, `placeInput`); Task 13 adds the cut back, Task 16 the place hooks, each from today's lines. Until then a wall regenerates exactly as today's wall with no opening and no room reading it: none of this task's ported cases builds an opening or a room (checked: the four files import only `wall.dart`, `wall_geometry.dart`, `wall_bands.dart`, `box.dart`, `catalog.dart` and `startup_plan.dart`, the last for WR9's sample line only).

They move into `wall_geometry.dart`; Task 13 does not copy them again (its R13-1 says so). `wallsInDocument` takes the live answer as a positional `LiveTypeOf` (R-P8; Task 13's text), and asks it for the host and for every other holder: today's `isLiveObject<WallParams>`/`liveObjectsOf<WallParams>` over the global catalog (`opening_geometry.dart:714, :720`) become `live(h) == ArchitectureTypes.wall`, so a frozen wall is no wall (C1.5).

```dart
    (h) => frozen.contains(h) ? null : testCatalog().typeIdOf(doc, h);
```

```dart
// 3a Task 11 (spec C1.5, C2): the walls' caches and the document adapter
// decide "a live wall" through a LiveTypeOf, never through a catalog of
// their own, so a frozen wall is absent from them exactly as it is absent
// from every regeneration. The walls sit at the far origin in their own
// turned groups; the stray WallParams sits on a nested group inside a
// turned and mirrored one.
import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d/jet_cad_2d.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit/testing.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit_architecture/src/wall/wall.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit_architecture/src/wall/wall_bands.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit_architecture/src/wall/wall_geometry.dart';
import 'package:vector_math/vector_math_64.dart' show Vector2;

import '../support/wall_fixture.dart';

const Handle a = Handle(1300), b = Handle(2600), f = Handle(3900);
const Handle outer = Handle(5000), nested = Handle(5100);

/// An L of A (200, left) and B (115, centre); F (150, right) apart from it;
/// and a stray `WallParams` from the L's corner on [nested], a group inside
/// the turned and mirrored root group [outer], as only a file brings one.
DraftDocument liveDoc() {
  final doc = wallDoc();
  final corner = plan(1800, 300);
  doc.commands.execute(
      addWall(doc, a, plan(-1200, 300), corner, 200, Justification.left));
  doc.commands.execute(addWall(doc, b, corner, polar(corner, 23 + 105, 2400),
      115, Justification.centre));
  doc.commands.execute(addWall(
      doc, f, plan(-1200, 2300), plan(1800, 2700), 150, Justification.right));
  doc.commands.execute(CompoundCommand([
    AddNodeCommand(GroupNode(
        handle: outer,
        parent: doc.rootHandle,
        transform: Transform2.translation(ox + 640.5, oy - 410.25)
            .multiply(Transform2.rotation(0.7))
            .multiply(Transform2.scale(-1, 1)),
        children: const [])),
    AddNodeCommand(GroupNode(
        handle: nested,
        parent: outer,
        transform: Transform2.translation(-120.5, 330.75)
            .multiply(Transform2.rotation(-0.45)),
        children: const [])),
  ], label: 'Add groups'));
  final toNested = doc.tree.accumulatedTransform(nested).invert();
  final s = toNested.transformPoint(corner);
  final e = toNested.transformPoint(polar(corner, 23 - 40, 1700));
  doc.components.attach<WallParams>(
      nested, WallParams(s.x, s.y, e.x, e.y, 90, Justification.left));
  return doc;
}

/// A point in the middle of [h]'s band, 40% along it.
Vector2 inBand(DraftDocument doc, Handle h) {
  final w = worldWallOf(doc, h);
  final (l, r) = w.offsets;
  return w.s + (w.e - w.s) * 0.4 + Vector2(-w.d.y, w.d.x) * ((l + r) / 2);
}

void main() {
  test(
      'WL1 a frozen wall has no band: the band cache neither hosts nor joins '
      'at it and liveWalls leaves it out; the live walls keep theirs', () {
    final doc = liveDoc();
    final bands = WallBands(liveOf(doc, frozen: {f}));
    addTearDown(bands.dispose);
    expect(bands.liveWalls(doc), [a, b]);
    for (final (h, host) in [(a, a), (b, b), (f, null)]) {
      final p = inBand(doc, h);
      expect(bands.hostAt(doc, p.x, p.y), host, reason: h.toHex());
      final out = Vector2(7, 7);
      expect(bands.joinInto(doc, p.x, p.y, out), host != null,
          reason: h.toHex());
    }
    // The control: nothing frozen, F is a wall with a band.
    final all = WallBands(liveOf(doc));
    addTearDown(all.dispose);
    expect(all.liveWalls(doc), [a, b, f]);
    final p = inBand(doc, f);
    expect(all.hostAt(doc, p.x, p.y), f);
  });

  test(
      'WL2 the document adapter: a frozen wall and a stray WallParams are no '
      "walls and no host's others; a live host sees the live walls, "
      'ascending, bitwise as WorldWall builds them, and moved stands in', () {
    final doc = liveDoc();
    final live = liveOf(doc, frozen: {f});
    expect(
        doc.components.withComponent<WallParams>().toList(), [a, b, f, nested],
        reason: 'premise: four holders of WallParams');
    expect(wallsInDocument(doc, f, live), isNull);
    expect(wallsInDocument(doc, nested, live), isNull);
    final w = wallsInDocument(doc, a, live)!;
    expect(w.host.handle, a);
    expect([for (final o in w.walls) o.handle], [b]);
    final want = worldWallOf(doc, a);
    expect([w.host.s.x, w.host.s.y, w.host.e.x, w.host.e.y],
        [want.s.x, want.s.y, want.e.x, want.e.y]);
    final pb = doc.components.get<WallParams>(b)!;
    final moved = WorldWall(b, pb.copyWith(end: Vector2(-310.5, 920.25)),
        doc.tree.accumulatedTransform(b));
    expect(
        identical(
            wallsInDocument(doc, a, live, moved: {b: moved})!.walls.single,
            moved),
        isTrue);
    // The control: nothing frozen, F is one of A's others.
    expect(
        [for (final o in wallsInDocument(doc, a, liveOf(doc))!.walls) o.handle],
        [b, f]);
  });

  test(
      "WL3 wallBandsOf: the kit's one WallBands per services, over their "
      'live walls (a frozen one has no band), disposed with them: a change '
      'after the dispose no longer reaches it', () async {
    final doc = liveDoc();
    final services =
        FakePlanServices(document: doc, catalog: testCatalog(), frozen: {f});
    final bands = wallBandsOf(services);
    expect(identical(wallBandsOf(services), bands), isTrue);
    expect(bands.liveWalls(doc), [a, b]);
    // The control: a change reaches the live cache.
    final g0 = bands.generation;
    doc.commands.execute(addWall(doc, const Handle(7000), plan(-900, -800),
        plan(2100, -400), 150, Justification.centre));
    await pumpEventQueue();
    expect(bands.generation, greaterThan(g0));
    services.dispose();
    final g1 = bands.generation;
    doc.commands.execute(addWall(doc, const Handle(7100), plan(-900, -1800),
        plan(2100, -1400), 150, Justification.centre));
    await pumpEventQueue();
    expect(bands.generation, g1, reason: 'disposed with its services');
  });
}
```

```dart

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// The two adapters (Ruling 08-8), moved here from opening_geometry.dart
// (:600-616, :698-725), because the wall's own outline and grips read them
// before the opening lands (3a R-P8); every type task reads the walls
// around a host through them.

/// The walls a regeneration sees around [host] (the **view adapter**,
/// Ruling 08-8): [host] as a [WorldWall], and every neighbour of it in
/// [view] carrying `WallParams`, as 07's outline reads them. Null when
/// [host] is not a live wall.
({WorldWall host, List<WorldWall> walls})? wallsInView(
    ParametricView view, Handle host) {
  final p = view.paramsOf<WallParams>(host);
  if (p == null) return null;
  return (
    host: WorldWall(host, p, view.toWorld(host)),
    walls: [
      for (final n in view.neighbours(host))
        if (view.paramsOf<WallParams>(n) case final q?)
          WorldWall(n, q, view.toWorld(n)),
    ],
  );
}

/// The walls the tools, the grips and the panel see around [host] (the
/// **document adapter**, Ruling 08-8): [host] as a [WorldWall], and every
/// other live wall of [doc] ([live] names it `ArchitectureTypes.wall`; a
/// frozen one is not live, spec 3a C1.5), ascending by handle. The view
/// adapter ([wallsInView]) sees only [host]'s neighbours; [classify], [cap]
/// and the openings' obstacles ignore a wall that does not join [host], so
/// the extra walls change nothing. Null when [host] is not a live wall.
///
/// [moved] stands in for the walls it names (an end drag's walls before it
/// is executed, spec 08 D13): each is read from it instead of [doc].
({WorldWall host, List<WorldWall> walls})? wallsInDocument(
    DraftDocument doc, Handle host, LiveTypeOf live,
    {Map<Handle, WorldWall> moved = const {}}) {
  if (live(host) != ArchitectureTypes.wall) return null;
  final p = doc.components.get<WallParams>(host)!;
  return (
    host:
        moved[host] ?? WorldWall(host, p, doc.tree.accumulatedTransform(host)),
    walls: [
      for (final h in doc.components.withComponent<WallParams>())
        if (h != host && live(h) == ArchitectureTypes.wall)
          moved[h] ??
              WorldWall(h, doc.components.get<WallParams>(h)!,
                  doc.tree.accumulatedTransform(h)),
    ],
  );
}
```

Plan decisions and rulings:
- **R-P8 (no 08 D13 here).** Today's `WallGrips.drag` appends `_keptPut` (`wall_grips.dart:63-66, 69-127`): the openings of a wall whose start moved keep their distance from its end. It names `OpeningParams`, `layoutInDocument`, `placeCut` and `storedCentreOf` (Task 13). This task ports `WallGrips` without `_keptPut`/`_seated` and without their bullet in the class doc (`:27-33`); Task 14 adds them back from these lines with `opening_end_drag_test`. No case of EG1-EG6 builds an opening, so none of them sees the difference.
- **The live rule (C1.5).** `WallGrips` takes `{required LiveTypeOf live}` (Task 13's part, R-P8) and reads the walls through Task 11's `wallsInDocument(d, group, _live)` (`:51`, `:159`); `_endsAt` becomes an instance method for it. A frozen wall offers no grips and does not follow a joined end (WT-frozen).
- **The tool reads its settings per event, over the services.** Today's `WallTool(ValueNotifier<WallSettings> settings, {WallBands? bands})` (`wall_tool.dart:69-75`) read `settings.value` at each commit (`:216`) and paint (`:263-264`); the shell owned the notifier and the panel wrote it. In the kit: `WallTool(WallSettings Function() settings, WallBands bands)`, `wallPlanTool.create` passes `() => services.settingsOf<WallSettings>(ArchitectureTools.wall)` and `wallBandsOf(services)`; the plan's store holds the settings and its property panel writes them while the tool is active (spec C3.2; 2a P3). The band cache is the kit's shared one, so the tool never disposes it (today's `_ownsBands` and `dispose` override, `:70-71, :89, :240-244`, go). The kit's direct cases (WT10-WT20) build the same tool over a local `ValueNotifier<WallSettings>`, so `rig.tool.settings.value = ...` becomes `rig.settings.value = ...` (a name; assertions unchanged).
- **The fields.** `wallPlanType`: `thickness` a `LengthProperty` whose `write` throws `ArgumentError` unless `isWallThickness` (strict at `wallJoin.linear`, at most `kWallMaxThickness`: today's `selection_panel.dart:412-414`; spec C3.2 "strict, in `write`"), `justification` a `ChoiceProperty` over `Justification.values`; both `gate: PlanGate.reshape` (today's `_capable`, `selection_panel.dart:380-389`: an object's own field needs `reshape`). `wallPlanTool.settings`: the same two specs over `WallSettings`, ungated (today a tool's settings are always editable, `:388`), so the tool's word ids are the type's (`property:architecture.wall.*`: "the tool shares the type's id", Shared interfaces). Today's `SegmentedButton` (`selection_panel.dart:1313-1331`) is the panel's dropdown (C7 class 3: finders change, values do not; WS1-WS11 are Task 27's).
- **The palette.** `tools: [boxPlanTool, wallPlanTool]`, `types: [boxPlanType, wallPlanType]`: today's palette order (box, wall, door, ... `planner_shell.dart:547-561`) and registration order (`catalog.dart:28-31`). The icon is `Icons.maximize` (today's palette has no icons). The tool consults no lock and no layer (today's; spec C3.2).
- **R-P1, the integration package imports public libraries only.** The ported shell cases keep every assertion; where one reads a kit internal:
  - `wallTool(tester).isPending` → `activeTool(tester).isMidShape` (the rig's; the guard forwards `isMidShape`, `guard.dart:363-366`, and `PlacementTool.isMidShape` is `isPending`, `placement_tool.dart:76`). The Wall tool is the active tool at each of those lines.

Ruling R12-1: the user's path to the same value (`plan_property_panel.dart:700-745`); the settings section shows while the Wall tool is active.
  - `classify(...)` (WT3: `:303`, `:342-343`, `:365-366` and `expectTee`'s `:142-143`; WT9: `:544-545`) is the kit's geometry: those lines are deleted from the shell cases, each leaving `// classify: WT3-k (the kit).`, and run unchanged in the kit's companions WT3-k and WT9-k, which replay each chain through the Wall tool at the points the shell resolves (a tick's end exactly; the grid point `snapToGrid(p, 10, page)` of a click that no object snap catches, as WT3 itself asserts at `:299-302`) with the case's settings. Ruling R12-2 (R-P1's "split").
  - `WallGrips()` called directly (EG1 `:270-272`, EG3 `:334-371`, EG4 `:411-421`, EG6 `:549-579`) is a kit internal: each tail runs in the kit as EG1-k, EG3-k, EG4-k, EG6-k over its case's fixture, since each shell part ends undone or refused (`canon(doc) == before` is asserted just above), so the tail's document is the fixture's. Ruling R12-3 (R-P1's "split").
  - `WorldWall`, `wallJoin` (fixture reads of world ends and the join tolerance) are reproduced in the integration fixture over the public `WallParams` (`toWorld.transformPoint(p.start)`, bit for bit `wall_geometry.dart:19-62`; `Tolerance(linear: 1e-6, angular: 1e-9)`, `wall.dart:19`): a test-local fixture (R-P1).

- **The integration plans.** Today's fixtures built a `DraftDocument` and pumped `PlannerShell(document: doc)`. Here `wallPlanJson(page, build)` makes `architectureController()`, gives its document the case's page, runs `build` (the kit's system regenerates the walls), and returns `c.save()`; the case opens it with `architectureController(json: ...)`, so it has no undo history (today's `clearHistory`) and its manifest names the kit. A case that wrote stray components straight into the store before pumping (EG6: `:503-506`) does the same on `ctrl.document` before `pumpEditor`, today's order. Task 9's `pagePlanJson` builds a page-only plan without the kit's system; walls need the kit's, so this helper is the wall support's own (not a copy of a rig helper, R-P14).
- **R-P15 (WG-refuse-short).** Today, a wall-end grip on a point where the wall would be no longer than `wallJoin.linear` has an empty preview (`wall_grips.dart:137-138`) and, released there, no command (`grip_drag.dart:303-313` asks `drag` at the drop point; `wall_grips.dart:198` answers null); nothing is reported (no throw reaches the guard) and the grips stay usable. WG-refuse-short asserts exactly what a host sees: a drag through the refused point to an accepted one commits that point in one undo step; a drop on the refused point commits nothing; no diagnostic at any time; a later drag commits. The preview half is pinned by EG1-k (`preview(...)` at the refused point `isEmpty`), see "Interface problem".

```dart
// Ported from jet_cad_floor_plan/test/wall_tool_test.dart (3a Task 12):
// the cases that drive the Wall tool directly (WT10-WT13, WT15-WT18,
// WT20), assertions unchanged. The shell cases (WT1-WT9, WT14, RF2, WT19)
// run in jet_cad_2d_integration. The rig reads the tool's settings through
// a function, as the plan's services give them, and builds the band cache
// over the kit tests' catalog.
import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart' show ValueNotifier;
import 'package:flutter/gestures.dart' show kPrimaryButton;
import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d/jet_cad_2d.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_flutter/jet_cad_2d_flutter.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit_architecture/src/wall/wall.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit_architecture/src/wall/wall_bands.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit_architecture/src/wall/wall_tool.dart';
import 'package:vector_math/vector_math_64.dart' show Vector2;

import '../support/wall_fixture.dart';
import '../support/wall_shell.dart';

typedef Rig = ({
  WallTool tool,
  ToolContext ctx,
  ValueNotifier<WallSettings> settings
});

/// The Wall tool driven directly, wired as the plan wires it, over [doc]:
/// its settings read through [Rig.settings], its own band cache over the
/// kit tests' catalog, a unit camera (a 10 mm aperture), object snap on, no
/// page (no grid). Today's `directRig` (wall_tool_test.dart:168-189).
Rig directRig(DraftDocument doc) {
  final index = SpatialIndex(doc);
  final camera = CameraController(
      ViewportTransform(worldToScreenMatrix: Transform2.identity()));
  final selection = SelectionController(doc);
  final settings = ValueNotifier<WallSettings>(const WallSettings());
  final bands = WallBands(liveOf(doc));
  final tool = WallTool(() => settings.value, bands);
  addTearDown(() {
    tool.dispose();
    bands.dispose();
    settings.dispose();
    selection.dispose();
    camera.dispose();
    index.dispose();
  });
  return (
    tool: tool,
    ctx: ToolContext(
        document: doc, index: index, camera: camera, selection: selection),
    settings: settings,
  );
}
```

```dart
// Ported from jet_cad_floor_plan/test/wall_grips_test.dart (3a Task 12,
// R-P1): the provider-direct tails of EG1, EG3, EG4 and EG6, whose
// WallGrips is a kit internal, assertions unchanged, each over its case's
// fixture as the shell case leaves it there (the shell part ends undone or
// refused, so the document is the fixture's). The shell parts run in

// rotated group (`groupAt`, or a spoke's group at its hub).
import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d/jet_cad_2d.dart';

/// The walls [build] adds to an empty document with the kit tests' system,
/// with no undo history (wall_grips_test.dart:36-56's `gripDoc`, without
/// the page, which only the shell's snap reads).
DraftDocument gripDoc(void Function(DraftDocument doc) build) {
  final doc = wallDoc();
  build(doc);
  doc.commands.clearHistory();
  return doc;
}

/// The shell case's grid point nearest [p]: its 1:20 page near the far
/// origin, grid at 10 mm (wall_grips_test.dart:42-49, 119-121).
Vector2 gridOf(Vector2 p) => snapToGrid(
    p,
    10,
    PageComponent(
        scaleDenominator: 20,
        originX: ox - 2000,
        originY: oy - 2000,
        gridStepMm: 10));

/// Wall [h]'s end [k] in world.
Vector2 endOf(DraftDocument doc, Handle h, int k) =>
    worldWallOf(doc, h).endpoint(k);
```

```dart
// 3a Task 12, R-P1: the joint-kind assertions of today's shell cases WT3
// and WT9 (jet_cad_floor_plan/test/wall_tool_test.dart:273-386, :499-524),
// whose `classify` is a kit internal the integration package cannot import.
// Each companion replays its case's chains through the Wall tool, at the
// points the shell resolves them to (a tick's end, exactly; a grid point of
// the case's 1:20 page, `snapToGrid`), with the case's settings; its
// assertions are the case's `classify` lines, unchanged. The shell halves
// (WT3, WT9) run in jet_cad_2d_integration with every other assertion.
import 'package:flutter/gestures.dart' show kPrimaryButton;
import 'package:flutter/services.dart'
    show KeyDownEvent, LogicalKeyboardKey, PhysicalKeyboardKey;
import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d/jet_cad_2d.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_flutter/jet_cad_2d_flutter.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit_architecture/src/wall/wall.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit_architecture/src/wall/wall_bands.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit_architecture/src/wall/wall_geometry.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit_architecture/src/wall/wall_tool.dart';
import 'package:vector_math/vector_math_64.dart' show Vector2;

import '../support/wall_fixture.dart';
import '../support/wall_shell.dart';

// The room of WR12, turned 23° about the far origin (wall_tool_test.dart:
// 20-27).
final Vector2 c0 = plan(0, 0), c1 = plan(4000, 300);
final Vector2 c2 = plan(3600, 3100), c3 = plan(-200, 2700);
final Vector2 s0 = plan(1300, 1900);

/// The shell cases' page: 1:20 near the far origin, grid at 10 mm.
final PageComponent page = PageComponent(
    scaleDenominator: 20,
    originX: ox - 2000,
    originY: oy - 2000,
    gridStepMm: 10);

/// The grid point the shell's click at [p] resolves to.
Vector2 grid(Vector2 p) => snapToGrid(p, 10, page);

/// The unit left normal of the line from [a] to [b].
Vector2 leftOf(Vector2 a, Vector2 b) {
  final d = (b - a).normalized();
  return Vector2(-d.y, d.x);
}

/// The Wall tool over [doc] with [settings], its own band cache, a unit
/// camera and [snap] (null: object snap on); one chain per [draw].
final class Chains {
  Chains(this.doc, {SnapSettings? snap}) {
    tool = WallTool(() => settings, bands);
    ctx = ToolContext(
        document: doc,
        index: index,
        camera: camera,
        selection: selection,
        snap: snap);
    addTearDown(() {
      tool.dispose();
      bands.dispose();
      selection.dispose();
      camera.dispose();
      index.dispose();
    });
  }

  final DraftDocument doc;
  WallSettings settings = const WallSettings();
  late final WallBands bands = WallBands(liveOf(doc));
  late final SpatialIndex index = SpatialIndex(doc);
  late final CameraController camera = CameraController(
      ViewportTransform(worldToScreenMatrix: Transform2.identity()));
  late final SelectionController selection = SelectionController(doc);
  late final WallTool tool;
  late final ToolContext ctx;

  void _press(Vector2 world) => tool.onPointerDown(
      ToolPointerEvent(
          screen: Offset.zero,
          world: world,
          pointer: 1,
          buttons: kPrimaryButton,
          shift: false,
          control: false,
          meta: false,
          alt: false,
          pickRadiusWorld: 1),
      ctx);

  /// One wall from [a] to [b], then Enter: the new wall.
  Handle draw(Vector2 a, Vector2 b) {
    _press(a);
    _press(b);
    tool.onKey(
        const KeyDownEvent(
            physicalKey: PhysicalKeyboardKey.enter,
            logicalKey: LogicalKeyboardKey.enter,
            timeStamp: Duration.zero),
        ctx);
    return walls(doc).last;
  }
}

void main() {
  test(
      "WT3-k WT3's joint kinds: a click on a centreline body makes a T, one "
      'within a thickness of its end a node, one outside the band nothing',
      () {
    final doc = wallDoc();
    final k = Chains(doc);
    final h = k.draw(c0, c1);
    k.settings =
        const WallSettings(thickness: 115, justification: Justification.left);
    final foot = c0 + (c1 - c0) * 0.35;
    final side = (s0 - project(s0, c0, c1)).normalized();
    final s = k.draw(s0, grid(foot + side * 20));
    expect(classify(worldWallOf(doc, s), 1, [worldWallOf(doc, h)]), isA<Tee>());

    k.settings = const WallSettings();
    final nH = leftOf(c0, c1);
    final inSign = nH.dot(s0 - c0) > 0 ? 1.0 : -1.0;
    final t1 = k.draw(grid(plan(2300, 1000)),
        grid(c0 + (c1 - c0) * 0.6 + nH * (90 * inSign)));
    expect(classify(worldWallOf(doc, t1), 1, [worldWallOf(doc, h)]),
        isA<Tee>(),
        reason: t1.toHex());
    final t2 = k.draw(grid(plan(3100, -1300)),
        grid(c0 + (c1 - c0) * 0.8 - nH * (60 * inSign)));
    expect(classify(worldWallOf(doc, t2), 1, [worldWallOf(doc, h)]),
        isA<Tee>(),
        reason: t2.toHex());
    final len = c0.distanceTo(c1);
    final n = k.draw(
        grid(c0 + (c1 - c0) * ((len - 120) / len) + nH * (70 * inSign)),
        grid(plan(5200, 1100)));
    expect(classify(worldWallOf(doc, n), 0, [worldWallOf(doc, h)]),
        isA<NodeJoint>());

    k.settings =
        const WallSettings(thickness: 240, justification: Justification.left);
    final h2 = k.draw(c3, c2);
    final nH2 = leftOf(c3, c2);
    k.settings = const WallSettings();
    final t3 = k.draw(
        grid(plan(1500, 2200)), grid(c3 + (c2 - c3) * 0.4 + nH2 * 180));
    expect(classify(worldWallOf(doc, t3), 1, [worldWallOf(doc, h2)]),
        isA<Tee>(),
        reason: t3.toHex());
    final t4 = k.draw(
        grid(plan(2500, 2100)), grid(c3 + (c2 - c3) * 0.7 - nH2 * 150));
    expect(
        classify(worldWallOf(doc, t4), 1, [worldWallOf(doc, h2)]), isA<Free>());
  });

  test(
      "WT9-k WT9's joint kind: with object snap off, a click in a wall's "
      'band joins nothing', () {
    final doc = wallDoc();
    final h = Chains(doc).draw(c0, c1);
    final k = Chains(doc, snap: SnapSettings(objectSnap: false));
    final nH = leftOf(c0, c1);
    final inSign = nH.dot(s0 - c0) > 0 ? 1.0 : -1.0;
    final t = k.draw(grid(plan(2300, 1000)),
        grid(c0 + (c1 - c0) * 0.6 + nH * (90 * inSign)));
    expect(classify(worldWallOf(doc, t), 1, [worldWallOf(doc, h)]),
        isNot(isA<Tee>()));
  });
}
```

```dart
ToolPointerEvent pressEvent(Vector2 world) => ToolPointerEvent(

ToolContext contextOf(DraftDocument doc) {

      ViewportTransform(worldToScreenMatrix: Transform2.identity()));
```

```dart
// The wall as the kit declares it (spec 3a C3.2): its plan type (the
// engine type, its grips, its thickness and justification fields) and its
// tool (letter W, the settings the panel edits while the tool is active).
import 'package:flutter/material.dart' show Icons;
import 'package:jet_cad_2d/jet_cad_2d.dart' show Capability;
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit/jet_cad_2d_kit.dart';

import '../ids.dart';
import '../live.dart';
import 'wall.dart';
import 'wall_bands.dart';
import 'wall_grips.dart';
import 'wall_tool.dart';

/// [t], when a wall may have it ([isWallThickness]: strict above
/// `wallJoin.linear`, at most [kWallMaxThickness]); else an
/// [ArgumentError], which the panel takes as a refusal (today's
/// `selection_panel.dart:412-414`).
double _thickness(double t) => isWallThickness(t)
    ? t
    : throw ArgumentError.value(t, 'thickness', 'is not a wall thickness');

/// The wall's plan type: thickness and justification, each needing the
/// `reshape` permission (today's `_capable`, `selection_panel.dart:380-389`).
final PlanType<WallParams> wallPlanType = PlanType<WallParams>(
  id: ArchitectureTypes.wall,
  fromJson: WallParams.fromJson,
  parametric: const WallType(),
  grips: (services) => WallGrips(live: liveTypesOf(services)),
  properties: [
    LengthProperty<WallParams>(
        id: 'thickness',
        read: (p) => p.thickness,
        write: (p, t) => p.copyWith(thickness: _thickness(t)),
        gate: PlanGate.reshape),
    ChoiceProperty<WallParams, Justification>(
        id: 'justification',
        values: Justification.values,
        read: (p) => p.justification,
        write: (p, j) => p.copyWith(justification: j),
        gate: PlanGate.reshape),
  ],
);

/// The Wall tool, W: a chain of walls drawn with its settings, which the
/// panel edits while it is active (no gate: a tool's settings are always
/// editable, today's `_capable`). It consults no lock and no layer rule
/// (today's).
final PlanTool wallPlanTool = PlanTool(
  id: ArchitectureTools.wall,
  icon: Icons.maximize,
  letter: 'W',
  needs: const {
    Capability.structure,
    Capability.components,
    Capability.geometry,
  },
  settings: PlanToolSettings<WallSettings>(
    initial: const WallSettings(),
    specs: [
      LengthProperty<WallSettings>(
          id: 'thickness',
          read: (s) => s.thickness,
          write: (s, t) => s.copyWith(thickness: _thickness(t))),
      ChoiceProperty<WallSettings, Justification>(
          id: 'justification',
          values: Justification.values,
          read: (s) => s.justification,
          write: (s, j) => s.copyWith(justification: j)),
    ],
  ),
  create: (services) => WallTool(
      () => services.settingsOf<WallSettings>(ArchitectureTools.wall),
      wallBandsOf(services)),
);
```

```dart
// The wall fixture of jet_cad_floor_plan/test/support/wall_fixture.dart and
// wall_shell.dart (3a Task 12), for the integration package's wall tests:
// public libraries only (R-P1), so `WorldWall` and `wallJoin` are
// reproduced over the public `WallParams`, the catalog is the rig's
// `kitCatalog` (R-P14), and the helpers that need the kit's geometry
// (`ringOf`, `worldWall`, `spoke`, `triangulates`, `wallDoc`, `reload`)
// stay in the kit's own copy.
import 'dart:convert';
import 'dart:math' as math;
import 'dart:typed_data';

import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d/jet_cad_2d.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit_architecture/jet_cad_2d_kit_architecture.dart';
import 'package:vector_math/vector_math_64.dart' show Vector2;

import 'editor_rig.dart' show kitCatalog;

/// Every "do these join" decision for walls, as the kit's `wallJoin`
/// (jet_cad_floor_plan/lib/src/parametric/wall.dart:19), reproduced: the
/// kit does not export it (R-P1).
const Tolerance wallJoin = Tolerance(linear: 1e-6, angular: 1e-9);

/// A wall in world space, as the kit's `WorldWall` builds one
/// (wall_geometry.dart:19-62), reproduced over the public [WallParams]
/// (R-P1): its world ends are the stored ends through the group's
/// transform, bit for bit.
final class WorldWall {
  WorldWall(this.handle, WallParams p, this.toWorld)
      : params = p,
        s = toWorld.transformPoint(p.start),
        e = toWorld.transformPoint(p.end),
        t = p.thickness,
        j = p.justification;

  final Handle handle;
  final WallParams params;
  final Transform2 toWorld;
  final Vector2 s, e;
  final double t;
  final Justification j;

  /// The unit direction from start to end.
  late final Vector2 d = (e - s).normalized();

  /// The left and right face offsets along the left normal.
  (double, double) get offsets => switch (j) {
        Justification.centre => (t / 2, -t / 2),
        Justification.left => (t, 0),
        Justification.right => (0, -t),
      };

  /// The start for `k == 0`, the end otherwise.
  Vector2 endpoint(int k) => k == 0 ? s : e;
}
```

```dart
// The wall cases' shell harness (jet_cad_floor_plan/test/wall_tool_test.dart
// :37-118 and wall_grips_test.dart:36-121), over the editor rig (R-P14:
// pumpEditor, globalOf, globalAt, status, press are the rig's): a plan of the
// architecture kit built in a new plan's document and saved, so the
// controller opens it as a file with no undo history; the pointer and key
// gestures of today's cases; the Wall tool's settings set through the
// property panel's settings fields. Public libraries only (R-P1).
import 'package:flutter/gestures.dart' show PointerDeviceKind, kPrimaryButton;
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter/services.dart' show LogicalKeyboardKey;
import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d/jet_cad_2d.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_flutter/jet_cad_2d_flutter.dart' show SelectionKey;
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_integration/jet_cad_2d_integration.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit_architecture/jet_cad_2d_kit_architecture.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_plan/jet_cad_2d_plan.dart';
import 'package:vector_math/vector_math_64.dart' show Vector2;

import 'editor_rig.dart';
import 'wall_fixture.dart';

/// The pages' fixed grid step (wall_tool_test.dart:34,
/// wall_grips_test.dart:35).
const double gridStep = 10;

/// Today's 1:20 page near the far origin, grid snap on at [gridStep].
PageComponent wallPage() => PageComponent(
    scaleDenominator: 20,
    originX: ox - 2000,
    originY: oy - 2000,
    gridStepMm: gridStep);

/// A plan of the architecture kit as a file: a new plan's document given
/// [page], then [build] run on it (the kit's system regenerates what it
/// adds), saved through the controller (its manifest names the kit).
/// Opened, it has no undo history (today's fixtures' `clearHistory`).
String wallPlanJson(
    PageComponent page, void Function(DraftDocument doc) build) {
  final c = architectureController();
  try {
    c.document.commands.execute(
        SetComponentCommand<PageComponent>(c.document.rootHandle, page));
    build(c.document);
    return c.save();
  } finally {
    c.dispose();
  }
}

/// A controller over [plan], disposed at tear-down.
PlanController wallController(String plan) {
  final c = architectureController(json: plan);
  addTearDown(c.dispose);
  return c;
}

/// A primary click at world [p] plus the raw offset `(dx, dy)` in mm.
Future<void> clickAt(WidgetTester tester, PlanController c, Vector2 p,
    [double dx = 0, double dy = 0]) async {
  await tester.tapAt(globalAt(tester, c, Vector2(p.x + dx, p.y + dy)));
  await tester.pump();
}

/// A click near [p]: 12 mm and -9 mm off, well inside the aperture.
Future<void> clickNear(WidgetTester tester, PlanController c, Vector2 p) =>
    clickAt(tester, c, p, 12, -9);

Future<void> undoKey(WidgetTester tester) async {
  await tester.sendKeyDownEvent(LogicalKeyboardKey.meta);
  await press(tester, LogicalKeyboardKey.keyZ);
  await tester.sendKeyUpEvent(LogicalKeyboardKey.meta);
  await tester.pump();
}

/// The page grid's point nearest [p], as the drag chain computes it.
Vector2 gridOf(DraftDocument doc, Vector2 p) => snapToGrid(
    p, gridStep, doc.components.get<PageComponent>(doc.rootHandle)!);

/// Sets the active Wall tool's settings through the property panel's
/// settings fields, as today's cases set the tool's notifier
/// (`wallTool(tester).settings.value = ...`, ruling R12-1): [thickness]
/// typed and committed with Enter (which hands the focus back to the
/// canvas), then [justification] picked from its menu.
Future<void> setWallSettings(WidgetTester tester,
    {required String thickness, required Justification justification}) async {
  await tester.enterText(find.byKey(const Key('setting-thickness')), thickness);
  await tester.testTextInput.receiveAction(TextInputAction.done);
  await tester.pump();
  await tester.tap(find.byKey(const Key('setting-justification')));
  await tester.pumpAndSettle();
  await tester.tap(
      find.byKey(Key('setting-justification-${justification.name}')).last);
  await tester.pumpAndSettle();
}

/// Selects wall [h] with a click in the middle of its band, 40% along it,
/// away from both of its grips (wall_grips_test.dart:84-93).
Future<void> selectWall(
    WidgetTester tester, PlanController c, Handle h) async {
  final w = worldWallOf(c.document, h);
  final n = Vector2(-w.d.y, w.d.x);
  final (l, r) = facesOf(c.document.components.get<WallParams>(h)!);
  await tester.tapAt(
      globalAt(tester, c, w.s + (w.e - w.s) * 0.4 + n * ((l + r) / 2)));
  await tester.pump();
  expect(c.activeSelection.keys, [SelectionKey.root(h)]);
}

/// A mouse drag from world [from] to world [to], past the slop at once.
Future<void> dragWorld(WidgetTester tester, PlanController c, Vector2 from,
    Vector2 to) async {
  final a = globalAt(tester, c, from), b = globalAt(tester, c, to);
  final gesture = await tester.createGesture(
      kind: PointerDeviceKind.mouse, buttons: kPrimaryButton);
  await gesture.down(a);
  await gesture.moveTo(a + const Offset(12, 0));
  await gesture.moveTo(b);
  await gesture.up();
  await gesture.removePointer();
  await tester.pump();
}

/// Wall [h]'s end [k] in world.
Vector2 endOf(DraftDocument doc, Handle h, int k) =>
    worldWallOf(doc, h).endpoint(k);
```

```dart
  testWidgets(
      'WG-refuse-short (Review Focus 3, spec 3a C1.8) a wall-end grip dragged '
      "onto the wall's other end, where the wall would be no longer than the "
      'join tolerance: a drop there commits nothing and reports nothing; a '
      'drag that passes it and ends on an accepted point commits that point '
      'in one undo step; the grips stay usable', (tester) async {
    final ctrl = wallController(gripPlan((doc) {
      doc.commands.execute(addWall(
          doc, wa, plan(0, 0), plan(3000, 400), 200, Justification.left));
    }));
    final doc = ctrl.document;
    await pumpEditor(tester, ctrl, centre: plan(1500, 400), scale: 0.15);
    final before = canon(doc);
    final reports = ctrl.diagnostics.value.length;
    await selectWall(tester, ctrl, wa);

    // Through the start (object snap puts the pointer on it: the wall
    // would be degenerate there) to an accepted grid point: one step.
    final q = gridOf(doc, plan(3400, 1300));
    final from = globalAt(tester, ctrl, endOf(doc, wa, 1));
    final gesture = await tester.createGesture(
        kind: PointerDeviceKind.mouse, buttons: kPrimaryButton);
    await gesture.down(from);
    await gesture.moveTo(from + const Offset(12, 0));
    await gesture
        .moveTo(globalAt(tester, ctrl, endOf(doc, wa, 0) + Vector2(4, -3)));
    await tester.pump();
    await gesture.moveTo(globalAt(tester, ctrl, q));
    await gesture.up();
    await gesture.removePointer();
    await tester.pump();
    expect(tester.takeException(), isNull);
    expect(doc.commands.undoDepth, 1);
    expect((endOf(doc, wa, 1) - q).length, lessThan(1e-6));
    expect(ctrl.diagnostics.value, hasLength(reports));

    // Dropped on the start: refused; nothing committed, nothing reported.
    final moved = canon(doc);
    await dragWorld(
        tester, ctrl, endOf(doc, wa, 1), endOf(doc, wa, 0) + Vector2(4, -3));
    expect(tester.takeException(), isNull);
    expect(doc.commands.undoDepth, 1);
    expect(canon(doc), moved);
    expect(ctrl.diagnostics.value, hasLength(reports));

    // The grips stay usable: the next drag lands, one more step.
    final r = gridOf(doc, plan(2600, -700));
    await dragWorld(tester, ctrl, endOf(doc, wa, 1), r);
    expect(doc.commands.undoDepth, 2);
    expect((endOf(doc, wa, 1) - r).length, lessThan(1e-6));
    expect(ctrl.diagnostics.value, hasLength(reports));
    await undoKey(tester);
    await undoKey(tester);
    expect(canon(doc), before);
  });
```

#### Interface problem

- **(Resolved by ruling R-P17: the preview at a refused point is empty, today's.)** **R-P15's preview clause is not today's.** R-P15 says "the preview keeps the last accepted state". Today the preview is **empty** while the pointer is on a refused point: `WallGrips.preview` returns `const []` when `_moved` refuses (`jet_cad_floor_plan/lib/src/parametric/wall_grips.dart:137-138`), and the plan's `GripDrag.moveTo` stores that list as the preview (`jet_cad_2d_flutter/lib/src/grip_drag.dart:262-263`); EG1 asserts it (`wall_grips_test.dart:272`: `preview(...)` at the refused point `isEmpty`), ported unchanged as EG1-k. The preview is not public, so WG-refuse-short asserts the rest of R-P15 (no commit at a refused drop, no diagnostic, grips usable, a later drag in one step). Proposed fix: Review Focus 3 reads "the preview is empty while the pointer is on the refused point (today's), a drop there commits nothing, nothing is reported, the grips stay usable and a later drag commits in one undo step"; keeping the last accepted state would be a behaviour change needing the human's word.
- **(Resolved by ruling R-P17: positional `live`; R-P6's named form struck.)** **R-P6 against R-P8 on `wallsInDocument`.** R-P6 gives `{required LiveTypeOf live}`, R-P8 and Task 13's part the positional `wallsInDocument(doc, host, LiveTypeOf live, {moved})`. Tasks 11 and 12 use the positional form; Task 15's part (`wallsInDocument(doc, host, _live)`) and Task 14's agree. Proposed: strike R-P6's form.

**Plan rulings (this task):**
- **R13-1 (C1.5, the document adapter's live rule).** Today's document adapters ask the global catalog (`live_objects.dart`: `isLiveObject`, `liveObjectsOf`). In the kit they take a `LiveTypeOf` (the plan's `PlanServices.liveTypeIdOf` through `liveTypesOf`, or a test's): a handle is a live wall when `live(h) == ArchitectureTypes.wall`, a live opening when `live(h) == ArchitectureTypes.opening`, and the candidates are `doc.components.withComponent<T>()` (ascending by contract, as `ParametricCatalog.objectsOf` reads them). A frozen object (`live(h) == null`) is then absent from the adapters exactly as it is from `generate` (spec C1.5). The view adapter (`wallsInView`, `openingsInView`, `hostCutsInView`) reads the engine's view and needs no live answer: a view relates live objects only.
- **R13-2 (C7, placement).** Every case ported here uses only the kit's, the engine's and the Flutter layer's names (`SpatialIndex.pickInto` in OG8, `FlutterTextMeasurer` in the kink fixture): all run in the kit.
- **R13-3 (order).** KJ3 (the Window tool on the canvas), KJ4 (a window's slide grip on the canvas), KJ5 (a wall end grip on the canvas) and OR8 (a click selecting a gap on the canvas) pump today's `PlannerShell`: they are C6 cases and need the opening's `PlanType` (Task 14) or its tools (Task 15) in `architectureKit`. They are not ported here, and not dropped: Tasks 14 and 15 port them, assertions unchanged.
- **R13-4 (the cut lives in the wall).** Today the wall's `generate` reads its openings as referrers through `hostCutsInView` (`opening_geometry.dart:645-653, :677-697`, called from `wall.dart:226-239`). Task 11 cannot name `opening_geometry.dart` (it does not exist yet), so its `WallType.generate` is today's without the `_cut` branch (see "Interface problem"); this task adds the branch back, unchanged, so a wall with openings is cut from here on.
- **R13-5 (kit tests' system).** Today's tests regenerate through the floor planner's global catalog (`wallDoc`, `reload`, `driftOf`, `diagnosticsOf`, `installParametric`). The kit's tests use `testCatalog()` (the raw kit types, no plan guard), as Task 11's support does; a test that called `installParametric(doc)` keeps the call, now `test/support/catalog.dart`'s over `testCatalog()` (R-P13; re-exported by both fixtures).

```dart
// Spec 3a C1.5, C3.3: the opening's document adapters ask the live answer
// they are handed (the plan's `PlanServices.liveTypeIdOf`), never a catalog
// of their own. A wall the plan has frozen (spec 2a E2) is neither a host
// nor an obstacle there, and a frozen opening is not among its host's
// openings, while the catalog still names both, exactly as `generate`,
// which sees no frozen object, draws them.
import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d/jet_cad_2d.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit_architecture/src/ids.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit_architecture/src/opening/opening.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit_architecture/src/opening/opening_geometry.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit_architecture/src/wall/wall.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit_architecture/src/wall/wall_geometry.dart'
    show wallsInDocument;

import '../support/opening_fixture.dart';
import '../support/wall_fixture.dart';

const hA = Handle(1000), hX = Handle(1200);
const hO = Handle(5000), hP = Handle(5100);

void main() {
  test(
      'OG-live (spec 3a C1.5) a frozen crossing wall is no obstacle, a '
      'frozen host has no frame or layout, a frozen opening is not among '
      'its host\'s openings; the catalog names all three', () {
    final doc = wallDoc();
    // A: 4,000 left-justified, at 23 degrees in its own rotated group at
    // the far origin. X crosses it at about 1,900 (an X obstacle, 08 D7).
    doc.commands.execute(
        addWall(doc, hA, plan(0, 0), plan(4000, 0), 200, Justification.left));
    final fa = oracleFrameOf(doc, hA);
    doc.commands.execute(addWall(doc, hX, oracleAt(fa, 1800, -900),
        oracleAt(fa, 1950, 900), 150, Justification.centre));
    // O, a door at 700, and P, a window at 3,200: both on A, both fit.
    doc.commands.execute(addOpening(
        doc, hO, const OpeningParams(hA, 700, 800, OpeningKind.door)));
    doc.commands.execute(addOpening(
        doc, hP, const OpeningParams(hA, 3200, 600, OpeningKind.window)));
    expect(driftOf(doc), isEmpty, reason: 'premise: regenerated');

    final live = liveOf(doc);
    // Control: X is A's one obstacle; O and P are A's openings.
    expect([for (final o in layoutInDocument(doc, hA, live)!.obstacles) o.wall],
        [hX]);
    expect([for (final (h, _) in openingsInDocument(doc, hA, live)) h],
        [hO, hP]);

    // X frozen: no obstacle; A's one stretch is its straight span.
    final noX = liveOf(doc, frozen: {hX});
    expect(testCatalog().typeIdOf(doc, hX), ArchitectureTypes.wall,
        reason: 'the catalog still names it');
    expect([for (final w in wallsInDocument(doc, hA, noX)!.walls) w.handle],
        isNot(contains(hX)));
    final layout = layoutInDocument(doc, hA, noX)!;
    expect(layout.obstacles, isEmpty);
    expect(layout.stretches, [(layout.frame.uS, layout.frame.uE)]);

    // A frozen: no host, no frame, no layout.
    final noA = liveOf(doc, frozen: {hA});
    expect(testCatalog().typeIdOf(doc, hA), ArchitectureTypes.wall);
    expect(wallsInDocument(doc, hA, noA), isNull);
    expect(hostFrameInDocument(doc, hA, noA), isNull);
    expect(layoutInDocument(doc, hA, noA), isNull);
    expect(hostFrameInDocument(doc, hA, live), isNotNull, reason: 'control');

    // O frozen: P alone is A's.
    final noO = liveOf(doc, frozen: {hO});
    expect(testCatalog().typeIdOf(doc, hO), ArchitectureTypes.opening);
    expect([for (final (h, _) in openingsInDocument(doc, hA, noO)) h], [hP]);
  });
}
```

```dart
/// [host]'s frame through the document adapter (`wallsInDocument`, over
/// [live], spec 3a C1.5). Null when [host] is not a live wall or is
/// degenerate.
HostFrame? hostFrameInDocument(
    DraftDocument doc, Handle host, LiveTypeOf live) {
  final w = wallsInDocument(doc, host, live);
  return w == null ? null : hostFrameOf(w.host, w.walls);
}

/// [host]'s layout (frame, obstacles, stretches) through the document
/// adapter (`wallsInDocument`, over [live], with [moved] standing in for
/// the walls it names). Null when [host] is not a live wall or is
/// degenerate.
HostLayout? layoutInDocument(DraftDocument doc, Handle host, LiveTypeOf live,
    {Map<Handle, WorldWall> moved = const {}}) {
  final w = wallsInDocument(doc, host, live, moved: moved);
  return w == null ? null : layoutOf(w.host, w.walls);
}

/// [host]'s openings in [doc]: the live openings ([live] names them
/// `ArchitectureTypes.opening`; a frozen one is not live, spec 3a C1.5)
/// whose host is [host], ascending by handle, with their parameters, as
/// [openingsInView] reads them in a regeneration.
List<(Handle, OpeningParams)> openingsInDocument(
        DraftDocument doc, Handle host, LiveTypeOf live) =>
    [
      for (final h in doc.components.withComponent<OpeningParams>())
        if (live(h) == ArchitectureTypes.opening)
          if (doc.components.get<OpeningParams>(h)! case final o
              when o.host == host)
            (h, o),
    ];
```

#### Interface problem

(Resolved by R-P8 and R-P17: Task 11 puts both adapters in `wall_geometry.dart` with the positional `LiveTypeOf`, exactly as proposed below; kept for the record, do not stop on it.)

**The wall, the opening, the room inputs and the dimension import each other today; the plan's file order splits them across Tasks 11, 13, 14 and 16.** Evidence:
- `jet_cad_floor_plan/lib/src/parametric/wall.dart:4-6` imports `opening_geometry.dart` (`wallsInView` for every wall's outline at `:150`, `hostCutsInView`, `piecesOf`, `centrelinePieces` for the cut at `:226-239`) and `room_inputs.dart` (`placeBoxInView`, `roomInputInView` at `:178-187`).
- `wall_grips.dart:5-9` imports `opening.dart` and `opening_geometry.dart` (`wallsInDocument` for the grips at `:52` and `:159`; `layoutInDocument`, `placeCut`, `storedCentreOf` and `liveObjectsOf<OpeningParams>` for 08 D13's "openings stay put", `:71-131`).
- `dimension.dart:21`, `dimension_grips.dart:9`, `dimension_attach.dart:12-13`, `dimension_tool.dart:17`, `room_inputs.dart:13` and `symbols/wall_attach.dart:59-117` import `wallsInView`/`wallsInDocument` from `opening_geometry.dart`.

Proposed resolution, written into this task and Task 14 (the controller reconciles it with Tasks 11, 12 and 16):
1. **Task 11** puts the two wall adapters in `lib/src/wall/wall_geometry.dart`: `wallsInView` copied from `opening_geometry.dart:600-616` unchanged, and

```dart
/// The walls the tools, the grips and the panel see around [host] (the
/// document adapter, Ruling 08-8): [host] as a [WorldWall], and every other
/// live wall of [doc] ([live] names it `ArchitectureTypes.wall`; a frozen
/// one is not live, spec 3a C1.5), ascending by handle. Null when [host] is
/// not a live wall. [moved] stands in for the walls it names.
({WorldWall host, List<WorldWall> walls})? wallsInDocument(
    DraftDocument doc, Handle host, LiveTypeOf live,
    {Map<Handle, WorldWall> moved = const {}}) {
  if (live(host) != ArchitectureTypes.wall) return null;
  final p = doc.components.get<WallParams>(host)!;
  return (
    host:
        moved[host] ?? WorldWall(host, p, doc.tree.accumulatedTransform(host)),
    walls: [
      for (final h in doc.components.withComponent<WallParams>())
        if (h != host && live(h) == ArchitectureTypes.wall)
          moved[h] ??
              WorldWall(h, doc.components.get<WallParams>(h)!,
                  doc.tree.accumulatedTransform(h)),
    ],
  );
}
```

   and ports `WallType.generate` without the `_cut` branch (a wall draws uncut until Task 13; Task 11's wall tests have no openings). Its place hooks (`room_inputs.dart`) are Task 16's question, not this task's.
2. **Task 12** ports `WallGrips` without 08 D13's `_keptPut`/`_seated` (they name `OpeningParams`), taking the live answer as `WallGrips({required LiveTypeOf live})`; its `wall_grips_test` cases that build openings (EG9 and the like) wait for Task 14, which adds `_keptPut` with `opening_end_drag_test`.
3. **Task 13** (this task) adds the cut to `WallType.generate`; **Task 14** adds `_keptPut`/`_seated` to `WallGrips.drag`.

If Task 11 places the adapters elsewhere, only this task's imports (Steps 3, 4, 7) and M-OG-5's file change.

**Plan rulings (this task):**
- **R14-1 (C1.1, "is the host a wall").** Today's position check asks `isLiveObject<WallParams>(doc, o.host)` over the global catalog (`selection_panel.dart:425-430`): a group carrying `WallParams` that a later-registered type names (EG9's shadow, `wall_grips_test.dart:655-756`) is no wall, and every position of an opening on it is refused. A `range` sees a `PlanObject` only (document, handle, world), no services. `openingPositionRange` therefore asks the engine's naming rule (`ParametricCatalog.typeIdOf`) of a catalog the kit builds lazily from its own raw type registrations, in today's order (ruling R-P19: `lib/src/type_naming.dart`'s `kitTypeIdOf`, a kit-internal list, not `architectureKit.types`, so no import cycle through `kit.dart`; only the naming rule is read, no hook runs). The plan registers every loaded kit's types in load order, and Tasks 16, 18 and 20 append the separator, the room and the dimension to the list, so for a plan of this kit this answers exactly as the plan's catalog does; it answers a frozen wall's id too, as the panels' `typeIdOf` does (spec C1.5: "the panels, gates and colour row keep using that one"). A frozen host's opening is then refused by the engine on commit (`DanglingReferenceError`, caught by `PlanController.execute`): the same revert. See "Interface problem" for the alternative.
- **R14-2 (L).** `L` is the host's centreline length in its own group-local space, `(host.end - host.start).length` (today's `:428-429`), not its world length: a host in a scaled group keeps today's bound.
- **R14-3 (the fields).** The Opening section's fields, in today's order (`selection_panel.dart:1338-1371`): `width` (`LengthProperty`, `write` through `openingWidthOf`: strict `isOpeningWidth` by kind, an `ArgumentError` the panel turns into a revert), `position` (`LengthProperty`, `range: openingPositionRange`), `flip-hinge` and `flip-swing` (`ActionProperty`, `visible` for doors only). All four have `gate: PlanGate.reshape` (today's `_capable`: a field or button needs the host's `reshape`, `:384-391`; the flips are hidden without it, S-11, and C1.7 now hides an `ActionProperty` whose gate the host refuses). DraftDocument planDoc() {

```dart
  doc.commands.execute(addWallLocal(
      doc,
      hA,
      const WallParams(0, 0, 4000, 0, 200, Justification.centre),
      Transform2.translation(ox + 300.5, oy - 700.25)
          .multiply(Transform2.rotation(0.6))
          .multiply(Transform2.scale(1.25, 1.25))));
  doc.commands.execute(addOpening(
      doc,
      hD,

          hinge: HingeEnd.end, swing: SwingSide.right),

  doc.commands.execute(
      addOpening(doc, hG, const OpeningParams(hA, 600, 700, OpeningKind.gap)));

    AddNodeCommand(GroupNode(
        handle: hBox,
        parent: doc.rootHandle,
        transform: groupAt(hBox.value),
        children: const [])),
    SetComponentCommand<BoxParams>(hBox, const BoxParams(1200, 800)),
  ], label: 'Add box'));

      doc, hQ, const OpeningParams(hBox, 300, 600, OpeningKind.window)));

      hD, const WallParams(0, 0, 3000, 0, 150, Justification.centre));

      addOpening(doc, hR, const OpeningParams(hD, 500, 600, OpeningKind.window)));
  return doc;
}

/// The panel's words (English, no kit words: the fields read none).
final KitWords words = KitNamesWords(KitNames.empty, () => const Locale('en'));

PropertyField fieldOf(DraftDocument doc, Handle h, String id) =>
    openingPlanType.fieldsOf(doc, h, words).firstWhere((f) => f.spec.id == id);

/// What committing [input] through [h]'s field [id] would store.
OpeningParams committed(
        DraftDocument doc, Handle h, String id, Object? input) =>
    (openingPlanType.commitField(doc, h, fieldOf(doc, h, id), input, words)
            as SetComponentCommand<OpeningParams>)
        .value!;

OpeningParams stored(DraftDocument doc, Handle h) =>
    doc.components.get<OpeningParams>(h)!;

    expect(committed(doc, hD, 'width', 0.0000011).width, 0.0000011);
    for (final bad in [0.0, -40.0, double.nan, double.infinity]) {

          reason: '$bad');
```

```dart
// Spec 3a C1.10 (decision 6): a frozen object's references are locked. A
// door whose type's code fails for it alone is frozen on load (spec 2a E2);
// its host wall then cannot be edited or deleted (PlanLocked, the lock
// hint), so it never regenerates uncut beside the frozen door or leaves the
// door naming a dead handle. A wall whose door is live edits as usual.
// ignore_for_file: invalid_use_of_internal_member
import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d/jet_cad_2d.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_flutter/jet_cad_2d_flutter.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit/jet_cad_2d_kit.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit_architecture/jet_cad_2d_kit_architecture.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_plan/jet_cad_2d_plan.dart';

import '../support/opening_support.dart';

/// The architecture kit, its opening type failing in `generate` for
/// [poisoned] alone, as a kit's code that breaks on one object does. The
/// rest is the kit's own.
PlanKit poisonedKit(Handle poisoned) => PlanKit(
      id: architectureKit.id,
      version: architectureKit.version,
      symbols: architectureKit.symbols,
      types: [
        for (final t in architectureKit.types)
          if (t.id == ArchitectureTypes.opening)
            PlanType<OpeningParams>(
                id: t.id,
                fromJson: OpeningParams.fromJson,
                parametric: _Poisoned(
                    t.parametric as ParametricType<OpeningParams>, poisoned))
          else
            t,
      ],
      tools: architectureKit.tools,
      attachments: architectureKit.attachments,
      names: architectureKit.names,
      prepare: architectureKit.prepare,
    );

final class _Poisoned extends ParametricType<OpeningParams> {
  const _Poisoned(this.inner, this.poisoned);

  final ParametricType<OpeningParams> inner;
  final Handle poisoned;

  @override
  Capability get editCapability => inner.editCapability;

  @override
  Aabb2 reach(OpeningParams params, Transform2 toWorld) =>
      inner.reach(params, toWorld);

  @override
  Iterable<Handle> references(OpeningParams params) =>
      inner.references(params);

  @override
  List<Generated> generate(ParametricView view, Handle self) {
    if (self == poisoned) throw StateError('the test\'s failing door');
    return inner.generate(view, self);
  }

  @override
  List<Diagnostic> diagnose(ParametricView view, Handle self) =>
      inner.diagnose(view, self);
}

void main() {
  testWidgets(
      'OT-frozen-host (spec 3a C1.10) a frozen door locks its host wall: an '
      'edit of the wall is refused with the lock hint and a delete is '
      'refused, the plan unchanged; a wall whose window is live edits in '
      'one step', (tester) async {
    late Handle a, door, b;
    final text = openingPlanText(shellPage, (d) {
      a = d.handleSeed.next();
      d.commands.execute(addWall(
          d, a, plan(0, 0), plan(5000, 0), 200, Justification.right));
      door = d.handleSeed.next();
      d.commands.execute(addOpening(
          d, door, OpeningParams(a, 1730, 900, OpeningKind.door),
          at: doorGroup));
      b = d.handleSeed.next();
      d.commands.execute(addWall(
          d, b, plan(0, 2500), plan(4000, 3100), 150, Justification.left));
      d.commands.execute(addOpening(d, d.handleSeed.next(),
          OpeningParams(b, 2000, 1200, OpeningKind.window)));
    });
    final c = PlanController(kits: [poisonedKit(door)], json: text);
    addTearDown(c.dispose);
    await pumpEditor(tester, c, centre: plan(2500, 1200), scale: 0.15);
    final doc = c.document;
    expect(c.frozen, {door}, reason: 'premise: the door alone, on load');
    expect([for (final d in c.diagnostics.value) d.code],
        contains(KitDiagnosticCode.hookFailed));
    final before = enc(doc);

    final pa = doc.components.get<WallParams>(a)!;
    expect(
        c.execute(SetComponentCommand<WallParams>(a, pa.copyWith(thickness: 250))),
        isFalse,
        reason: 'an edit of the frozen door\'s host');
    expect(c.lockHint.value, isTrue);
    expect(enc(doc), before);
    expect(doc.commands.undoDepth, 0);
```

```dart
/// SG6's composite (R14-7): the plan library's grip dispatch (spec 2a E1)
/// over the kit's two providers, by the type id that names the group. A
/// group no provider takes (a box: it has no grips) is movable, as today's
/// composite's default (`object_grips.dart:102-104`).
final class _Dispatch implements ObjectGripProvider {
  _Dispatch(DraftDocument doc)
      : _live = liveOf(doc),
        _openings = OpeningGrips(live: liveOf(doc)),
        _walls = WallGrips(live: liveOf(doc));

  final LiveTypeOf _live;
  final OpeningGrips _openings;
  final WallGrips _walls;

  ObjectGripProvider? _of(Handle group) => switch (_live(group)) {
        ArchitectureTypes.opening => _openings,
        ArchitectureTypes.wall => _walls,
        _ => null,
      };

  @override
  List<Grip> gripsOf(DraftDocument d, Handle group) =>
      _of(group)?.gripsOf(d, group) ?? const [];

  @override
  DraftCommand? drag(DraftDocument d, Handle group, Grip grip, Vector2 world) =>
      _of(group)?.drag(d, group, grip, world);

  @override
  List<(EntityKind, GeometryPayload)> preview(
          DraftDocument d, Handle group, Grip grip, Vector2 world) =>
      _of(group)?.preview(d, group, grip, world) ?? const [];

  @override
  bool movable(DraftDocument d, Handle group) =>
      _of(group)?.movable(d, group) ?? true;
}
```

```dart
/// Today's shell fixtures' page: 1:20 near the far origin, grid snap on at
/// 10 mm.
final PageComponent shellPage = PageComponent(
    scaleDenominator: 20,
    originX: ox - 2000,
    originY: oy - 2000,
    gridStepMm: 10);

/// The grid step of [shellPage].
const double gridStep = 10;

/// A plan of the architecture kit: [page] on its root, then what [build]
/// adds through a temporary parametric system over the kit's types (as
/// today's `shellDoc`: the objects regenerate as they are made), then what
/// [after] does with no system installed (OS4: a node removed without
/// cascading), saved with its manifest.
String openingPlanText(PageComponent page, void Function(DraftDocument d) build,
    {void Function(DraftDocument d)? after}) {
  final m = FlutterTextMeasurer();
  addTearDown(m.clear);
  final d = DraftDocument.empty(measurer: m);
  PageComponent.register(d.components);
  d.commands.execute(SetComponentCommand<PageComponent>(d.rootHandle, page));
  final system = ParametricSystem(d, kitCatalog())..install();
  try {
    build(d);
  } finally {
    system.dispose();
  }
  after?.call(d);
  return encodePlan(d, validateKitSet([architectureKit]));
}

/// A controller over [text] and the kit, disposed at tear-down.
PlanController openingController(String text) {
  final c = architectureController(json: text);
  addTearDown(c.dispose);
  return c;
}

/// [c]'s camera, today's `view.camera`.
CameraController cameraOf(PlanController c) => c.toolContext.camera;

Future<void> tapWorld(WidgetTester tester, PlanController c, Vector2 p,
    {bool shift = false}) async {
  if (shift) await tester.sendKeyDownEvent(LogicalKeyboardKey.shiftLeft);
  await tester.tapAt(globalAt(tester, c, p));
  if (shift) await tester.sendKeyUpEvent(LogicalKeyboardKey.shiftLeft);
  await tester.pump();
}

/// A mouse drag from world [from] to world [to], past the slop at once.
Future<void> dragWorld(
    WidgetTester tester, PlanController c, Vector2 from, Vector2 to) async {
  final a = globalAt(tester, c, from), b = globalAt(tester, c, to);
  final gesture = await tester.createGesture(
      kind: PointerDeviceKind.mouse, buttons: kPrimaryButton);
  await gesture.down(a);
  await gesture.moveTo(a + const Offset(12, 0));
  await gesture.moveTo(b);
  await gesture.up();
  await gesture.removePointer();
  await tester.pump();
}

Future<void> undoKey(WidgetTester tester) async {
  await tester.sendKeyDownEvent(LogicalKeyboardKey.meta);
  await tester.sendKeyEvent(LogicalKeyboardKey.keyZ);
  await tester.sendKeyUpEvent(LogicalKeyboardKey.meta);
  await tester.pump();
}

/// Today's `view.selection.replace`, then a frame.
Future<void> select(
    WidgetTester tester, PlanController c, List<Handle> hs) async {
  c.selection.replace([for (final h in hs) SelectionKey.root(h)]);
  await tester.pump();
}

/// The shown object grips of [h] (today's `view.grips!.grips`).
List<Grip> objectGripsOf(PlanController c, Handle h) => [
      for (final r in c.grips.grips)
        if (r.object && r.key == SelectionKey.root(h)) r.grip,
    ];

/// The page's grid point nearest [p], as the snap chain computes it.
Vector2 gridOf(DraftDocument doc, Vector2 p) => snapToGrid(
    p, gridStep, doc.components.get<PageComponent>(doc.rootHandle)!);

/// The door's own group: off the identity (today's `doorGroup`).
final Transform2 doorGroup = Transform2.translation(ox + 120, oy - 80)
    .multiply(Transform2.rotation(0.9));

/// Wall [h]'s world centreline, from its stored ends through its group's
/// accumulated transform, and its unit direction: what today's
/// `worldWallOf(doc, h)` gives as `s`, `e` and `d` (R14-9).
({Vector2 s, Vector2 e, Vector2 d}) worldEndsOf(DraftDocument doc, Handle h) {
  final p = doc.components.get<WallParams>(h)!;
  final m = doc.tree.accumulatedTransform(h);
  final s = m.transformPoint(p.start), e = m.transformPoint(p.end);
  return (s: s, e: e, d: (e - s).normalized());
}

// The panel's finders (R14-10).
Finder get section => find.byKey(const Key('section-architecture.opening'));
Finder get width => find.byKey(const Key('property-width'));
Finder get position => find.byKey(const Key('property-position'));
Finder get flipHinge => find.byKey(const Key('property-flip-hinge'));
Finder get flipSwing => find.byKey(const Key('property-flip-swing'));

String textOf(WidgetTester tester, Finder f) =>
    tester.widget<TextField>(f).controller!.text;

Future<void> enterAndSubmit(
    WidgetTester tester, Finder field, String text) async {
  await tester.enterText(field, text);
  await tester.testTextInput.receiveAction(TextInputAction.done);
  await tester.pump();
}

OpeningParams paramsOf(DraftDocument doc, Handle h) =>
    doc.components.get<OpeningParams>(h)!;
```

```dart
final class OpeningGrips implements ObjectGripProvider {
  /// [live] is the plan's live answer (spec 3a C1.5): the host and its
  /// openings are the live ones. [edgeAperture] returns the snap aperture
  /// in world, or null to turn edge snaps off (Ruling 08-15); by default
  /// they are off.
  OpeningGrips({required this.live, double? Function()? edgeAperture})
      : edgeAperture = edgeAperture ?? _off;
```

```dart
/// One opening on its host, as the document draws it now.
final class _Slide {
  _Slide._(this.params, this.layout, this.toWorld, this.openings, this.index,
      this.cuts)
      : toLocal = toWorld.invert();

  /// [group]'s slide state; null when it is not a live opening on a live,
  /// non-degenerate wall ([live]'s answer, spec 3a C1.5).
  static _Slide? of(DraftDocument d, Handle group, LiveTypeOf live) {
    final p = d.components.get<OpeningParams>(group);
    if (p == null) return null;
    final walls = wallsInDocument(d, p.host, live);
    if (walls == null) return null;
    final layout = layoutOf(walls.host, walls.walls);
    if (layout == null) return null;
    final openings = openingsInDocument(d, p.host, live);
    final i = openings.indexWhere((o) => o.$1 == group);
    if (i < 0) return null;
    final placed = cutsOf(layout.frame, layout.stretches, [
      for (final (_, o) in openings) (o.position, o.width),
    ]);
    return _Slide._(p, layout, walls.host.toWorld, openings, i, placed.cuts);
  }
```

```dart
// The opening's plan type (spec 3a C3.3, C1.1, C1.7): today's selection
// panel's Opening section (jet_cad_floor_plan/lib/src/selection_panel.dart:
// 405-433, 754-758, 1035-1059, 1332-1371) as property specs over the
// object, and its slide grip over the plan's services. Task 15 adds the
// three opening tools here.
import 'package:jet_cad_2d/jet_cad_2d.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_flutter/jet_cad_2d_flutter.dart'
    show ObjectGripProvider;
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit/jet_cad_2d_kit.dart';

import '../ids.dart';
import '../live.dart';
import '../type_naming.dart';
import '../wall/wall.dart';
import 'opening.dart';
import 'opening_grips.dart';

/// An opening's section title: its kind's tool word (today's `_titleOf`).
String openingTitle(OpeningParams o) => switch (o.kind) {
      OpeningKind.door => 'tool:${ArchitectureTools.door}',
      OpeningKind.window => 'tool:${ArchitectureTools.window}',
      OpeningKind.gap => 'tool:${ArchitectureTools.gap}',
    };

/// [w] as the width of an opening of [kind] (spec 08 D6: `isOpeningWidth`,
/// strict; a gap's above `4 × wallJoin.linear`), else an [ArgumentError],
/// which the panel turns into a revert. The type's width and the tools'
/// settings both write through it.
double openingWidthOf(OpeningKind kind, double w) {
  if (!isOpeningWidth(kind, w)) {
    throw ArgumentError.value(w, 'width', 'is no width a ${kind.name} takes');
  }
  return w;
}

/// Where [o]'s position may be (spec 3a C1.1; today's `_valid`,
/// `selection_panel.dart:425-430`): `[0, L]`, `L` its host's centreline
/// length in the host's own group-local space, when the engine names the
/// host a wall; null, refusing every position, when it does not (a box, a
/// group a later type names, a missing handle).
(double, double)? openingPositionRange(OpeningParams o, PlanObject object) {
  final doc = object.document;
  if (kitTypeIdOf(doc, o.host) != ArchitectureTypes.wall) {
    return null;
  }
  final host = doc.components.get<WallParams>(o.host)!;
  return (0, (host.end - host.start).length);
}

OpeningParams _flipHinge(OpeningParams o) => o.copyWith(
    hinge: o.hinge == HingeEnd.start ? HingeEnd.end : HingeEnd.start);

OpeningParams _flipSwing(OpeningParams o) => o.copyWith(
    swing: o.swing == SwingSide.left ? SwingSide.right : SwingSide.left);

bool _isDoor(OpeningParams o) => o.kind == OpeningKind.door;

/// The slide grip over [services] (today's shell factory,
/// `planner_shell.dart:649-652`): edge snaps at the snap aperture in world
/// while object snap is on.
ObjectGripProvider openingGripsOf(PlanServices services) => OpeningGrips(
    live: liveTypesOf(services),
    edgeAperture: () => services.objectSnap
        ? kSnapAperturePixels / services.camera.value.scale
        : null);

/// The opening (spec 3a C3.3): fields width, position, Flip hinge and Flip
/// swing (a door's), each needing `reshape`; titled by its kind.
final PlanType<OpeningParams> openingPlanType = PlanType<OpeningParams>(
  id: ArchitectureTypes.opening,
  fromJson: OpeningParams.fromJson,
  parametric: const OpeningType(),
  grips: openingGripsOf,
  title: openingTitle,
  properties: [
    LengthProperty<OpeningParams>(
        id: 'width',
        read: (o) => o.width,
        write: (o, w) => o.copyWith(width: openingWidthOf(o.kind, w)),
        gate: PlanGate.reshape),
    LengthProperty<OpeningParams>(
        id: 'position',
        read: (o) => o.position,
        write: (o, v) => o.copyWith(position: v),
        range: openingPositionRange,
        gate: PlanGate.reshape),
    ActionProperty<OpeningParams>(
        id: 'flip-hinge',
        apply: _flipHinge,
        visible: _isDoor,
        gate: PlanGate.reshape),
    ActionProperty<OpeningParams>(
        id: 'flip-swing',
        apply: _flipSwing,
        visible: _isDoor,
        gate: PlanGate.reshape),
  ],
);
```

```dart
  /// Spec 08 D13: for each wall of [moved] (ascending by handle) whose
  /// stored `start` changed and whose `end` did not (exact `==`, stored
  /// values), each of its live openings ([_live]'s answer, spec 3a C1.5),
  /// ascending, rewritten to `p′ = L′ − (L − p)`: its distance from the end
  /// that did not move is kept. `L` and `L′` are the centreline's
  /// group-local lengths before and after. The document's openings are
  /// read once: O(openings).
  List<DraftCommand> _keptPut(
      DraftDocument d, List<(Handle, WallParams, WorldWall)> moved) {
    final rewrite = <Handle, (double, double)>{};
    for (final (h, p, _) in moved) {
      final old = d.components.get<WallParams>(h)!;
      if (p.start != old.start && p.end == old.end) {
        rewrite[h] = ((old.end - old.start).length, (p.end - p.start).length);
      }
    }
    if (rewrite.isEmpty) return const [];
    final byHost = <Handle, List<(Handle, OpeningParams)>>{};
    for (final o in d.components.withComponent<OpeningParams>()) {
      if (_live(o) != ArchitectureTypes.opening) continue;
      final params = d.components.get<OpeningParams>(o)!;
      if (!rewrite.containsKey(params.host)) continue;
      byHost.putIfAbsent(params.host, () => []).add((o, params));
    }
    final now = {for (final (h, _, w) in moved) h: w};
    final out = <DraftCommand>[];
    for (final (h, _, _) in moved) {
      final lengths = rewrite[h];
      final openings = byHost[h];
      if (lengths == null || openings == null) continue;
      final (l, l2) = lengths;
      final stretches = layoutInDocument(d, h, _live, moved: now)?.stretches;
      openings.sort((a, b) => a.$1.value.compareTo(b.$1.value));
      for (final (o, params) in openings) {
        final p = l2 - (l - params.position);
        out.add(SetComponentCommand<OpeningParams>(
            o,
            params.copyWith(
                position: stretches == null
                    ? p
                    : _seated(stretches, p, params.width))));
      }
    }
    return out;
  }
```

```dart
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// The tool driven directly, as `wall_tool_test.dart` drives the Wall tool,
// over the kit's test double of the plan's services (spec 3a C1.11).

typedef Rig = ({
  OpeningTool tool,
  ToolContext ctx,
  Map<String, Object> settings,
});

/// An opening tool of [kind] over [doc]: a camera at [scale] pixels per mm
/// (the default, 1, gives a 10 mm aperture), object snap as [snap] says
/// (none: on), no page (no grid), the tool's settings at today's default
/// in [Rig.settings], which the services read at each event ([setWidth]),
/// and [frozen] objects the services call not live (spec 2a E2).
Rig directRig(DraftDocument doc, OpeningKind kind,
    {double scale = 1, SnapSettings? snap, Set<Handle> frozen = const {}}) {
  final settings = <String, Object>{
    openingToolIdOf(kind): OpeningSettings.defaultFor(kind),
  };
  final services = FakePlanServices(
      document: doc,
      catalog: testCatalog(),
      frozen: frozen,
      scale: scale,
      settings: settings);
  final index = SpatialIndex(doc);
  final camera = CameraController(
      ViewportTransform(worldToScreenMatrix: Transform2.scale(scale, scale)));
  final selection = SelectionController(doc);
  final tool = OpeningTool(kind, services);
  addTearDown(() {
    tool.dispose();
    services.dispose();
    selection.dispose();
    camera.dispose();
    index.dispose();
  });
  return (
    tool: tool,
    ctx: ToolContext(
        document: doc,
        index: index,
        camera: camera,
        selection: selection,
        snap: snap),
    settings: settings,
  );
}

/// The tool's settings now hold [width] (today's `tool.settings.value =
/// OpeningSettings(width: width)`).
void setWidth(Rig rig, double width) =>
    rig.settings[openingToolIdOf(rig.tool.kind)] =
        OpeningSettings(width: width);
```
