```dart
/// The unwrapped tool [toolId] of [c]'s document (today's palette entry's
/// tool), as the Flutter layer's placement tool: its resolved hover point.
PlacementTool placementOf(PlanController c, String toolId) =>
    c.toolFor(toolId)! as PlacementTool;

/// The tool [toolId]'s settings as the plan holds them, through their
/// `toString`, today's `'OpeningSettings($width)'` (R15-3).
String settingsText(PlanController c, String toolId) =>
    '${c.servicesOf('architecture').settingsOf<Object>(toolId)}';

/// A tool's settings section (R15-4) and its width field.
Finder toolSection(String toolId) => find.byKey(Key('settings-$toolId'));
Finder get settingWidth => find.byKey(const Key('setting-width'));

/// Every opening, ascending (today's `openings`).
List<Handle> openings(DraftDocument doc) =>
    doc.components.withComponent<OpeningParams>().toList();

/// The one opening [doc] gained over [before] (today's `added`).
Handle added(DraftDocument doc, List<Handle> before) =>
    openings(doc).where((o) => !before.contains(o)).single;

/// Adds a wall with a handle from the seed, as a tool would (today's
/// `addWallFromSeed`).
Handle addWallFromSeed(
    DraftDocument doc, Vector2 s, Vector2 e, double t, Justification j) {
  final h = doc.handleSeed.next();
  doc.commands.execute(addWall(doc, h, s, e, t, j));
  return h;
}
```

```dart
class OpeningTool extends PlacementTool {
  /// An opening tool of [kind] over [services]: the width is the plan's
  /// settings of [openingToolIdOf] `(kind)`, read at each hover and click;
  /// the band cache is the kit's shared one ([wallBandsOf]); the walls and
  /// openings it sees are the services' live ones (spec 3a C1.5).
  OpeningTool(this.kind, this.services)
      : _bands = wallBandsOf(services),
        _live = liveTypesOf(services);

  final OpeningKind kind;

  /// The plan's services: read, never kept beyond the document.
  final PlanServices services;

  final WallBands _bands;
  final LiveTypeOf _live;

  /// The width of the next opening: the tool's settings now.
  double get _width =>
      services.settingsOf<OpeningSettings>(openingToolIdOf(kind)).width;
```

```dart
/// One opening tool (spec 3a C3.3): today's palette entry
/// (`planner_shell.dart:560-580`) and its settings (today's one
/// `OpeningSettings` per kind, `:469`), the width field writing through
/// [openingWidthOf]. No keys: the letter is the plan's palette shortcut.
PlanTool _openingPlanTool(OpeningKind kind, String letter, IconData icon) =>
    PlanTool(
      id: openingToolIdOf(kind),
      icon: icon,
      letter: letter,
      needs: const {
        Capability.structure,
        Capability.components,
        Capability.geometry,
      },
      settings: PlanToolSettings<OpeningSettings>(
          initial: OpeningSettings.defaultFor(kind),
          specs: [
            LengthProperty<OpeningSettings>(
                id: 'width',
                read: (s) => s.width,
                write: (s, w) => s.copyWith(width: openingWidthOf(kind, w))),
          ]),
      create: (services) => OpeningTool(kind, services),
    );

final PlanTool doorPlanTool = _openingPlanTool(
    OpeningKind.door, 'D', Icons.door_front_door_outlined);
final PlanTool windowPlanTool =
    _openingPlanTool(OpeningKind.window, 'N', Icons.window_outlined);
final PlanTool gapPlanTool =
    _openingPlanTool(OpeningKind.gap, 'G', Icons.space_bar);
```

**Plan decisions:**
- **The live rule.** Today's `isLiveObject<T>`/`liveObjectsOf<T>` (`jet_cad_floor_plan/lib/src/parametric/live_objects.dart:21-29`) ask the **global** `parametricCatalog`. The kit's `RoomInputs` asks the `LiveTypeOf` it is given: in the plan, `liveTypesOf(services)` (the plan's `liveTypeIdOf`, null for a frozen object, spec C1.5); in the kit's own tests, `liveOf(doc)` (the fixture catalog's `typeIdOf`, which follows the same naming rule as today's `names<T>`, `parametric_system.dart:638-675`). Today's `liveObjectsOf<T>(doc)` becomes "the holders of a `T`, ascending (`withComponent<T>()`), whose live type id is `T`'s": the same handles in the same order for any document without a frozen object.
- **Invalidation is today's** (spec C2): `RoomInputs` keeps its `changes` subscription and its explicit `invalidate()`; `roomInputsOf` only moves the owner from the shell (`planner_shell.dart:473`) to `PlanServices.shared`, which disposes it with its document.
- **Purity.** Today's `room_inputs.dart`, `room_trace.dart` and `room_label.dart` are Flutter-free (spec 10 D1). `room_trace.dart` and `room_label.dart` stay so; `room_inputs.dart` now imports the contract's barrel for `PlanServices` and `Disposable` (the Shared interfaces put `roomInputsOf` in this file); its header says so.
- **`room_tie_test` splits by case**, not by placement: DE1 traces only; DE2 and DE3 add rooms (`addRoom`, `RoomParams`, Task 18). The file lands here with DE1 and its helpers; Task 18 adds its `room_label.dart` import (used by DE2 alone; `unused_import` is an error in this workspace) and the two cases.

```dart
  /// A wall is an input to rooms (spec 10 D4, D16): its uncut band.
  @override
  bool get contributesPlace => true;

  /// The world box of [self]'s uncut band ([roomInputInView]), or null for
  /// a degenerate wall or a band with a non-finite coordinate.
  @override
  Aabb2? placeBox(ParametricView view, Handle self) =>
      placeBoxInView(view, self);

  /// [self]'s uncut band in world, a [RoomInput]: its joined ring after 07's
  /// joints, the short-wall fallback and the local-ring fallback, never its
  /// parameters, so equal inputs mean an equal band (the engine's contract).
  /// The engine asks only when [placeBox] is not null; a fresh `Object()`
  /// otherwise counts as changed, which can only regenerate more.
  @override
  Object placeInput(ParametricView view, Handle self) =>
      roomInputInView(view, self) ?? Object();
```

// Spec 3a C1.5, C2: the room inputs as the kit's code sees them in a plan.
// roomInputsOf(services) is the kit's one RoomInputs per document
// (PlanServices.shared, disposed with it), and its live rule is the plan's
// liveTypeIdOf: a frozen wall or separator is no input, exactly as it is in
// no survey (E2), while the catalog still answers its type id.
//
// The plan is the two-room box (a 100 mm partition at x 3,000) with a
// separator face to face at x 6,250.5, at the corpus far origin turned 23°,
// every wall and the separator in its own rotated, translated group.
// Expected areas are hand arithmetic: inner faces 100 in.
import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit/testing.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit_architecture/jet_cad_2d_kit_architecture.dart'
    show ArchitectureTypes;
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit_architecture/src/room/room_inputs.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit_architecture/src/room/room_trace.dart';

import '../support/room_fixture.dart';

/// The plan of both cases.
Plan fixture() => buildPlan(twoRoomWalls,
    seps: const [(6250.5, 100, 6250.5, 3900)], place: corpusGroups);

void main() {
  test(
      'RR-live a frozen wall and a frozen separator are no input to rooms; '
      'the catalog still names them (M-RR-1, M-RR-2)', () {
    final plan = fixture();
    final doc = plan.doc;
    final partition = plan.walls[4], sep = plan.seps.single;
    final frozen = FakePlanServices(
        document: doc, catalog: testCatalog(), frozen: {partition, sep});
    addTearDown(frozen.dispose);
    // Premises: the catalog names both; the plan's live rule names neither.
    expect(testCatalog().typeIdOf(doc, partition),
        ArchitectureTypes.wall);
    expect(testCatalog().typeIdOf(doc, sep), ArchitectureTypes.separator);
    expect(frozen.liveTypeIdOf(partition), isNull);
    expect(frozen.liveTypeIdOf(sep), isNull);

    final inputs = roomInputsOf(frozen);
    expect(inputs.inputOf(partition), isNull);
    expect(inputs.inputOf(sep), isNull);
    expect(inputs.placedIn(everywhere), plan.walls.take(4).toList(),
        reason: 'the four outer walls only, ascending');
    expect(inputs.wallNeighboursOf(plan.walls[0]), isNot(contains(partition)));
    // Traced among them, the seed's face is the whole box:
    // 7,800 × 3,800 = 29,640,000.
    final whole = traceRoomAmong(plan.at(1500.25, 2000.5), inputs);
    expect(whole, isA<Traced>());
    expect((whole as Traced).area, closeTo(29640000, 1e-2));

    // The control: nothing frozen. The partition and the separator are
    // inputs; the left face is 2,850 × 3,800 = 10,830,000.
    final live =
        FakePlanServices(document: doc, catalog: testCatalog());
    addTearDown(live.dispose);
    final all = roomInputsOf(live);
    expect(all.inputOf(partition), isNotNull);
    expect(all.inputOf(sep), isNotNull);
    expect(all.placedIn(everywhere), [...plan.walls, sep]);
    final left = traceRoomAmong(plan.at(1500.25, 2000.5), all) as Traced;
    expect(left.area, closeTo(10830000, 1e-2));
  });

  test(
      'RR-shared one RoomInputs per services; it follows the document\'s '
      'changes and is released with its services (M-RR-3, M-RR-4)',
      () async {
    final plan = fixture();
    final doc = plan.doc;
    final s = FakePlanServices(document: doc, catalog: testCatalog());
    final inputs = roomInputsOf(s);
    expect(roomInputsOf(s), same(inputs), reason: 'one per document');
    expect(inputs.live(plan.walls[4]), ArchitectureTypes.wall,
        reason: 'the services\' live rule');

    // A change stales it once delivered (today's `changes` subscription).
    final g0 = inputs.generation;
    doc.commands.execute(
        moveWall(plan, 4, const W(3300.5, 0, 3300.5, 4000, 100)));
    await Future<void>.delayed(Duration.zero);
    expect(inputs.generation, greaterThan(g0), reason: 'invalidated');

    // Released with its services: no subscription is left.
    s.dispose();
    final g1 = inputs.generation;
    doc.commands
        .execute(moveWall(plan, 4, const W(3000, 0, 3000, 4000, 100)));
    await Future<void>.delayed(Duration.zero);
    expect(inputs.generation, g1, reason: 'disposed with its services');
  });
}

```dart
/// The trace inputs of a whole document, for the Room and Separator tools
/// and the separator grips (spec 10 D4, D19-D21; Ruling 10-11): the
/// **document adapter**. The kit keeps one per document, [roomInputsOf]
/// (spec 3a C2: a `PlanServices.shared` object, disposed with its
/// document), and hands it to all three.
///
/// It holds every **live** wall and separator ([live]: in a plan, its
/// `liveTypeIdOf`, so a frozen one is left out as every survey leaves it
/// out, spec 3a C1.5), each wall's wall neighbours by the engine's own
/// predicate over `WallType().reach`, each input and place box, and
/// [bounds]. The inputs are those the view adapter gives, bit for bit
/// (`RI1`).
///
/// Marked stale on each of the document's changes (its `changes` stream,
/// which delivers after the task that made the change) and on [invalidate],
/// and rebuilt at the next query.
///
/// It is the tools' [PlaceSource] (spec 10 D7, D19): `traceRoomAmong(seed,
/// roomInputs)` traces what a room there would.
final class RoomInputs implements PlaceSource, Disposable {
  RoomInputs(this.document, this.live) {
    _changes = document.changes.listen((_) => invalidate());
  }

  final DraftDocument document;

  /// The type id of the live object [Handle] names, or null: the plan's
  /// `liveTypeIdOf` (spec 3a C1.5).
  final LiveTypeOf live;
```

    _sweep(walls);
    final byHandle = {for (final w in walls) w.handle: w};
    for (final w in walls) {
      _inputs[w.handle] = roomInputOf(w.handle, w.params, w.toWorld, walls: [

```

```dart
  /// The holders of a `T` whose live type id is [typeId], ascending by
  /// handle (`withComponent`'s order): today's `liveObjectsOf<T>`, asked of
  /// the plan's live rule.
  List<Handle> _live<T extends Component>(String typeId) => [
        for (final h in document.components.withComponent<T>())
          if (live(h) == typeId) h,
      ];
```

  - Line 358's doc (`/// Cancels the document subscription. The owner calls it once.`) → `/// Cancels the document subscription: once, by its owner (the kit's /// services dispose it with its document).` and the method gains `@override`.

```dart
/// The kit's one [RoomInputs] for [s]'s document (spec 3a C2): the Room
/// tool, the Separator tool and the separator grips share it, as they
/// shared the shell's one. Made on first use, disposed with the document.
RoomInputs roomInputsOf(PlanServices s) =>
    s.shared<RoomInputs>((s) => RoomInputs(s.document, liveTypesOf(s)));
```

- **R17-1 (ST1's shell half reads the pending start as `isMidShape`).** Today's case casts the shell's active tool to `SeparatorTool` and reads `isPending` (`separator_tool_test.dart:212, 217-219`). In the plan the canvas holds the kit's tool inside the plan's guard (`kits/guard.dart:253-276`), and the plan's `toolFor`, which unwraps it, is `@internal` (`plan_controller.dart:2131-2137`), so the integration package (public libraries only, ruling R-P1) reaches the guard through the canvas's `InteractionLayer.tools.active` (`interaction_layer.dart:90`). A `PlacementTool`'s `isMidShape` *is* its `isPending` (`placement_tool.dart:70, 76`), and the guard forwards it (`guard.dart:363-366`): the same predicate under its `Tool` name, a finder change in the sense of C7's class 3. The asserted values (`isTrue`, then `isFalse`) are unchanged.
- **R17-2 (ND4 without the sample).** ND4 decodes the sample flat's bytes (`new_document_test.dart:86-96`); the sample is Task 25's. Its live-page-and-walls case is ported over a plan built with the same shape — ten walls, each in its own turned group, and the page off the world origin — so the group's premises (`:92-95`: a page, not the new document's, ten walls) hold as written. Task 25 may point the fixture at `sampleFlatController()` (a fixture change).

/// A Separator tool over [doc], made by the kit's plan tool over a
/// FakePlanServices of the kit tests' catalog (its RoomInputs the services'
/// shared one): a camera at 1 pixel per mm (a 10 mm aperture), object snap
/// as [objectSnap] says, no page (no grid).
Rig separatorRig(DraftDocument doc, {bool objectSnap = true}) {
  final index = SpatialIndex(doc);
  final camera = CameraController(
      ViewportTransform(worldToScreenMatrix: Transform2.identity()));
  final selection = SelectionController(doc);
  final snap = SnapSettings(objectSnap: objectSnap);
  final services = FakePlanServices(
      document: doc, catalog: testCatalog(), objectSnap: objectSnap);
  final tool = separatorPlanTool.create(services) as SeparatorTool;
  addTearDown(() {
    tool.dispose();
    services.dispose();
    snap.dispose();
    selection.dispose();
    camera.dispose();
    index.dispose();
  });
  return (
    tool: tool,
    ctx: ToolContext(
        document: doc,
        index: index,
        camera: camera,
        selection: selection,
        snap: snap),
    inputs: roomInputsOf(services),
  );
}

```dart
// Plans for the separator's integration tests, built through the plan
// library's build seam (spec 3a C1.9) with the kit's public names: walls
// and separators by command, each in its own root group, as today's room
// fixture adds them (jet_cad_floor_plan/test/support/room_fixture.dart:
// 118-178).
import 'dart:math' as math;

import 'package:jet_cad_2d/jet_cad_2d.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit/jet_cad_2d_kit.dart' show KitWords, PlanKit;
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit_architecture/jet_cad_2d_kit_architecture.dart';
import 'package:vector_math/vector_math_64.dart' show Vector2;

/// A wall from world [s] to world [e], [thickness] thick, centred, in its
/// own root group [at] (the identity by default): its stored ends are [s]
/// and [e] taken back through [at]. One command.
Handle addWall(DraftDocument doc, Vector2 s, Vector2 e,
    {double thickness = 200, Transform2? at}) {
  final h = doc.handleSeed.next();
  final g = at ?? Transform2.identity();
  final inv = g.invert();
  final ls = inv.transformPoint(s), le = inv.transformPoint(e);
  doc.commands.execute(CompoundCommand([
    AddNodeCommand(GroupNode(
        handle: h, parent: doc.rootHandle, transform: g, children: const [])),
    SetComponentCommand<WallParams>(h,
        WallParams(ls.x, ls.y, le.x, le.y, thickness, Justification.centre)),
  ], label: 'Add wall'));
  return h;
}

/// A separator from world [s] to world [e] in its own root group [at]
/// (room_fixture.dart:165-178's addSeparator).
Handle addSeparator(DraftDocument doc, Vector2 s, Vector2 e,
    {Transform2? at}) {
  final h = doc.handleSeed.next();
  final g = at ?? Transform2.identity();
  final inv = g.invert();
  final ls = inv.transformPoint(s), le = inv.transformPoint(e);
  doc.commands.execute(CompoundCommand([
    AddNodeCommand(GroupNode(
        handle: h, parent: doc.rootHandle, transform: g, children: const [])),
    SetComponentCommand<SeparatorParams>(
        h, SeparatorParams(ls.x, ls.y, le.x, le.y)),
  ], label: 'Add separator'));
  return h;
}

/// room_fixture.dart:469-475's boxWalls: an 8,000 × 4,000 rectangle of
/// 200 mm walls, centred on their centrelines, in plan millimetres.
const List<(double, double, double, double)> boxWalls = [
  (0, 0, 8000, 0),
  (8000, 0, 8000, 4000),
  (8000, 4000, 0, 4000),
  (0, 4000, 0, 0),
];

/// Where the box's plan points go: centred on the world origin (a new
/// plan's sheet), then turned 23°.
final Transform2 boxPlace = Transform2.rotation(23 * math.pi / 180)
    .multiply(Transform2.translation(-4000, -2000));

Vector2 boxAt(double x, double y) => boxPlace.transformPoint(Vector2(x, y));

/// Wall [k]'s own group: today's `_groupFor` (room_fixture.dart:94-96) on
/// [boxPlace], a turn that is never a multiple of 90°.
Transform2 groupFor(int k) => boxPlace
    .multiply(Transform2.translation(311.5 * (k % 7), -173.25 * (k % 5)))
    .multiply(Transform2.rotation(0.3 + 0.7 * (k % 9)));

/// A [PlanBuild]: [boxWalls] at [boxPlace], each wall in its own group.
void buildBox(DraftDocument doc, KitWords words) {
  for (final (k, (sx, sy, ex, ey)) in boxWalls.indexed) {
    addWall(doc, boxAt(sx, sy), boxAt(ex, ey), at: groupFor(k));
  }
}

/// A [PlanBuild]: a wall, and well clear of it (over 1 m) a separator in a
/// turned, mirrored group, both on a new plan's sheet (A4 landscape at 1:50
/// about the world origin).
void buildWallAndSeparator(DraftDocument doc, KitWords words) {
  addWall(doc, Vector2(-5000.25, 3000.5), Vector2(4000.75, 3600.25),
      at: Transform2.translation(120.5, -80.25)
          .multiply(Transform2.rotation(0.05)));
  addSeparator(doc, Vector2(-3000.5, -1200.25), Vector2(2500.75, 1800.5),
      at: Transform2.translation(-310.25, 140.5)
          .multiply(Transform2.rotation(0.3))
          .multiply(Transform2.scale(-1, 1)));
}

/// A [PlanBuild] of the sample flat's shape for new_document_test's ND4
/// (ruling R17-2): ten walls, each in its own turned group, and the page
/// off the world origin.
void buildTenWalls(DraftDocument doc, KitWords words) {
  doc.commands.execute(SetComponentCommand<PageComponent>(
      doc.rootHandle, PageComponent(originX: 2100.5, originY: -1300.25)));
  for (var k = 0; k < 10; k++) {
    addWall(doc, Vector2(900.5 * k, 250.25),
        Vector2(900.5 * k + 600.75, 1700.5),
        at: Transform2.translation(311.5 * (k % 7), -173.25 * (k % 5))
            .multiply(Transform2.rotation(0.3 + 0.7 * (k % 9))));
  }
}

/// [architectureKit] without its prepare: a plan it writes has no DASHED
/// record (a file from a writer that never had one).
PlanKit get unpreparedKit => PlanKit(
      id: architectureKit.id,
      version: architectureKit.version,
      symbols: architectureKit.symbols,
      types: architectureKit.types,
      tools: architectureKit.tools,
      attachments: architectureKit.attachments,
      names: architectureKit.names,
    );

/// Separator [h]'s ends in world.
(Vector2, Vector2) separatorEnds(DraftDocument doc, Handle h) {
  final p = doc.components.get<SeparatorParams>(h)!;
  final t = doc.tree.accumulatedTransform(h);
  return (t.transformPoint(p.start), t.transformPoint(p.end));
}

/// The kit's DASHED record, written out (it is not exported):
/// jet_cad_floor_plan/lib/src/parametric/separator.dart:128-133.
const LinetypeRecord dashed = LinetypeRecord(
  handle: ReservedHandles.dashedLinetype,
  name: 'DASHED',
  description: 'Dashed __ __ __',
  pattern: DashPattern(dashes: [200, -100], totalLength: 300),
);

```dart
// Appendix A D-30 (spec 3a C3.4, C6): the separator's type is not exported
// (today's exportOmitOwners, jet_cad_floor_plan/lib/src/export/
// export_bytes.dart:28-29), so plan.png and plan.pdf leave every separator
// out, through the real kit. 2a's X-3 pins the plumbing over a test kit
// (jet_cad_2d_plan/test/export/registry_test.dart:78-115); the PDF is read
// back as the app's export test read it (apps/floor_planner/test/export/
// export_flow_test.dart:115-127; export_flat.dart:198-210's toPdf and
// pdfDistanceToSegment, copied here over the page's own origin and scale).
import 'dart:io' show zlib;
import 'dart:math' as math;

import 'package:flutter/services.dart' show rootBundle;
import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d/jet_cad_2d.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_flutter/export_testing.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_flutter/jet_cad_2d_flutter.dart'
    show ExportDpi, exportPagePdf, exportPagePng;
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit_architecture/jet_cad_2d_kit_architecture.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_plan/jet_cad_2d_plan.dart';
import 'package:vector_math/vector_math_64.dart' show Vector2;

import '../support/editor_rig.dart';
import 'separator_plans.dart';

/// World [p] in the PDF's points, under [page] (its origin is the sheet's
/// lower-left corner).
Vector2 toPdf(PageComponent page, Vector2 p) {
  final k = 72 / 25.4 / page.scaleDenominator;
  return Vector2((p.x - page.originX) * k, (p.y - page.originY) * k);
}

/// The distance from [p] to the segment [a]-[b], in pt.
double pdfDistanceToSegment(PdfXY p, Vector2 a, Vector2 b) {
  final ab = b - a;
  final t =
      (((p.x - a.x) * ab.x + (p.y - a.y) * ab.y) / ab.length2).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
  final q = a + ab * t;
  return math.sqrt(math.pow(p.x - q.x, 2) + math.pow(p.y - q.y, 2));
}

/// The plan: a wall, and well clear of it a separator in a turned,
/// mirrored group, on a new plan's sheet.
PlanController exportPlan() {
  final c = PlanController(
      kits: [architectureKit], build: buildWallAndSeparator);
  addTearDown(c.dispose);
  return c;
}

void main() {
  testWidgets(
      'SP-export-png plan.png leaves the separator out: its bytes are the '
      'page drawn without it', (tester) async {
    final c = exportPlan();
    final doc = c.document;
    final seps = liveOf<SeparatorParams>(c, ArchitectureTypes.separator);
    expect(seps, hasLength(1), reason: 'premise');
    final page = doc.components.get<PageComponent>(doc.rootHandle)!;
    final without = (await tester.runAsync(() => exportPagePng(
        document: doc,
        page: page,
        dpi: ExportDpi.d96,
        omitOwners: seps.toSet())))!;
    final whole = (await tester.runAsync(
        () => exportPagePng(document: doc, page: page, dpi: ExportDpi.d96)))!;
    expect(without, isNot(whole),
        reason: 'premise: the separator is on the sheet');
    final got = (await tester.runAsync(() =>
        c.export('plan.png', const PlanExportChoice(dpi: PlanExportDpi.d96))))!;
    // M-SP-1 (exported) and M-SP-10 (omittedOf answering nothing).
    expect(got.bytes, without);
  });

  testWidgets(
      'SP-export-pdf plan.pdf leaves the separator out: no path vertex '
      'within 1 pt of it, where the page exported with nothing omitted has '
      'one; the wall is drawn', (tester) async {
    final c = exportPlan();
    final doc = c.document;
    final sep =
        liveOf<SeparatorParams>(c, ArchitectureTypes.separator).single;
    final page = doc.components.get<PageComponent>(doc.rootHandle)!;
    final (s, e) = separatorEnds(doc, sep);
    final a = toPdf(page, s), b = toPdf(page, e);
    bool onSeparator(PdfContent content) => [
          for (final p in content.paths)
            for (final sub in p.subpaths)
              for (final v in sub.vertices)
                if (pdfDistanceToSegment(v, a, b) < 1.0) v,
        ].isNotEmpty;

    final font = (await tester.runAsync(
        () => rootBundle.load('packages/jet_cad_2d_plan/lib/fonts/Roboto-Regular.ttf')))!;
    final all = (await tester.runAsync(() => exportPagePdf(
        document: doc,
        page: page,
        fontBytes: font.buffer.asUint8List())))!;
    expect(onSeparator(PdfContent.parse(all, inflate: zlib.decode)), isTrue,
        reason: 'premise: exported with nothing omitted, the separator '
            'plots where the check looks');

    final got = (await tester.runAsync(
        () => c.export('plan.pdf', PlanExportChoice.initial)))!;
    final content = PdfContent.parse(got.bytes, inflate: zlib.decode);
    // M-SP-1 and M-SP-10.
    expect(onSeparator(content), isFalse, reason: 'no path at the separator');
    expect(content.paths, isNotEmpty, reason: 'the wall is drawn');
  });
}

The `@internal` plan members of "Interface problem" 2 are members of public classes, not imports.

**Plan decisions:**
- **The Area line is a `TextDisplay`** (spec C1.1): `roomAreaText` is today's `_areaOf` (`jet_cad_floor_plan/lib/src/selection_panel.dart:826-844`): the second TEXT child in handle order, '—' with fewer (today's panel wrote '—' for null, `:1384`). It is memoised per document by `(handle, document.commands.stateId)`: today's memo was dropped on every `commands.changes` event (`:279-281`), and `stateId` moves on exactly the commands those events report (`undo.dart:166-183`).
- **The Name field** is a `TextProperty` whose `write` trims and throws `ArgumentError` on an empty name (today's `_parse`, `selection_panel.dart:392-402`: "trimmed, unless that leaves it empty"), gated by `PlanGate.reshape` (today's `_capable`: an object's own field needs `reshape`, `:384-391`). The plan's panel already trims before it commits (`plan_property_panel.dart:416`); the kit's trim makes the type's own rule hold for any host.
- **The grips** are today's `RoomGrips` over the aperture today's shell gave it: `kSnapAperturePixels / camera.scale`, whatever F3 says (`planner_shell.dart:653`, Ruling 10-17).
- **The colour target** is the room's palette name (`ColourTarget<RoomParams>`); the colour row lists kit targets before units (2b), today's "rooms first, then tables".
- **Kit-case adaptations of today's grip dispatcher.** Today's tests build `ObjectGrips(edgeAperture: () => null, labelAperture: () => ap)` (`room_grips_test.dart:222-223, 630-631`), which hands a room to `RoomGrips(aperture: labelAperture)` (`parametric/object_grips.dart:57`). The port asks the kit type's own provider over a `FakePlanServices` whose camera gives the same aperture: `scale = kSnapAperturePixels / ap` (fixture change; assertions unchanged). GR5's `ObjectGrips(roomInputs: inputs, objectSnap: () => snap)` becomes `separatorPlanType`'s provider over one `FakePlanServices` per F3 state.
- **Integration fixtures.** A shell case's plan is built by a `PlanBuild` (spec C1.9): the plan library makes the document, prepares it, installs its own system with every kit's types, runs the build and clears the history, which is what today's shell fixtures did by hand (`plan.system.dispose(); plan.doc.commands.clearHistory();`, e.g. `room_panel_test.dart:122-123`). Each object is one command, in the kit fixture's order, so the handles are today's. `driftOf` in the integration package is a `ParametricSystem` over a catalog of `architectureKit.types` (`PlanType.registerInto`, public), not installed (today's `driftOf` likewise constructs an uninstalled system, `wall_fixture.dart:277-278`).
- **Integration finders** (C7 class 3, widgets that changed form): `Key('room-section')` → `Key('section-architecture.room')`, `Key('room-name')` → `Key('property-name')`, `Key('room-area')` → `Key('property-area')`, `Key('wall-section')` → `Key('section-architecture.wall')` (`plan_property_panel.dart:700-703, 826-828`); `PlannerView.selection` → `PlanController.activeSelection`, `.camera` → `PlanController.camera`, `.document` → `PlanController.document`, `InteractionLayer` → `PlanCanvas`.

```dart
/// Wall [h]'s end [end] (0 start, 1 end) dragged to world [to] by the
/// select tool's end grip (the wall type's grips: joined ends follow).
DraftCommand? dragEnd(DraftDocument doc, Handle h, int end, Vector2 to) {
  final services =
      FakePlanServices(document: doc, catalog: testCatalog());
  try {
    final grips = wallPlanType.gripsFor(services)!;
    return grips.drag(doc, h, grips.gripsOf(doc, h)[end], to);
  } finally {
    services.dispose();
  }
}
```

  `room_grips_test.dart` (kit), added after `distToLine`:

```dart
/// The room type's own grips over [doc] at the label aperture [ap] (world
/// mm): its provider over a camera of `kSnapAperturePixels / ap` px per mm,
/// the aperture today's ObjectGrips(labelAperture: () => ap) handed to
/// RoomGrips.
ObjectGripProvider roomGripsAt(DraftDocument doc, double ap) {
  final services = FakePlanServices(
      document: doc,
      catalog: testCatalog(),
      scale: kSnapAperturePixels / ap);
  addTearDown(services.dispose);
  return roomPlanType.gripsFor(services)!;
}

/// The separator type's own grips over [doc] and the services they read,
/// with object snap (F3) [snap]: one services per F3 state, so each reads
/// its own flag and its own RoomInputs (today's ObjectGrips(roomInputs:,
/// objectSnap:), which shared one).
(ObjectGripProvider, FakePlanServices) separatorGripsWith(
    DraftDocument doc, bool snap) {
  final services = FakePlanServices(
      document: doc, catalog: testCatalog(), objectSnap: snap);
  addTearDown(services.dispose);
  return (separatorPlanType.gripsFor(services)!, services);
}
```

```dart
// Spec 3a C3.5, C1.1, C1.7: the room as a kit type. Its fields are its
// name (a TextProperty, trimmed, an empty name refused, gated by reshape)
// and its area as drawn (a TextDisplay over the object: the area label's
// string, '—' without one, read once per document state); its colour is its
// palette name; its grips are today's label grip at the snap aperture of
// the camera's scale, and a room is not moved or turned.
//
// The plan: the two-room box with a separator face to face at x 6,250.5,
// at the corpus far origin turned 23°, every wall and the separator in its
// own rotated, translated group; room A ('Kitchen') in a group of its own
// turned 0.61 rad, room B ('Room 2') at the identity. Area strings are
// today's hand arithmetic (room_panel_test.dart RN1, RN6).
import 'dart:ui' show Locale;

import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d/jet_cad_2d.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit/jet_cad_2d_kit.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit/testing.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit_architecture/jet_cad_2d_kit_architecture.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit_architecture/src/room/room_plan.dart';
import 'package:vector_math/vector_math_64.dart' show Vector2;

import '../support/room_fixture.dart';

typedef Rooms = ({Plan plan, Handle a, Handle b});

/// A: x 100..2,950, 2,850 × 3,800 = 10,830,000 mm² ("10.83 m²"); B: x
/// 3,050..6,250.5, 3,200.5 × 3,800 = 12,161,900 mm² ("12.16 m²").
Rooms rooms() {
  final plan = buildPlan(twoRoomWalls,
      seps: const [(6250.5, 100, 6250.5, 3900)], place: corpusGroups);
  attachPage(plan.doc, PageComponent());
  final at = plan.at(1400, 1900);
  final g =
      Transform2.translation(at.x, at.y).multiply(Transform2.rotation(0.61));
  final a = addRoom(plan.doc, plan.at(1500.25, 2000.5), 'Kitchen', at: g);
  final b = addRoom(plan.doc, plan.at(4700.75, 1900.25), 'Room 2');
  plan.doc.commands.clearHistory();
  return (plan: plan, a: a, b: b);
}

/// The kit's own words in English (R-P4: fields are bound with words; the
/// room's read none).
final KitWords words =
    KitNamesWords(architectureKit.names, () => const Locale('en'));

PropertyField fieldOf(DraftDocument doc, Handle room, String id) => roomPlanType
    .fieldsOf(doc, room, words)
    .firstWhere((f) => f.spec.id == id);

void main() {
  test(
      'RM-fields a room\'s fields are its name and its area as drawn, under '
      'its property words; its section is titled by its type word', () {
    final f = rooms();
    final doc = f.plan.doc;
    expect(roomPlanType.id, ArchitectureTypes.room);
    expect(architectureKit.types, contains(roomPlanType));
    final fields = roomPlanType.fieldsOf(doc, f.a, words);
    expect([for (final x in fields) x.wordId], [
      'property:architecture.room.name',
      'property:architecture.room.area',
    ]);
    expect([for (final x in fields) x.value], ['Kitchen', '10.83 m²']);
    expect(fields[0].spec.gate, PlanGate.reshape);
    expect(fields[0].commit, isNotNull);
    expect(fields[1].commit, isNull, reason: 'a display');
    expect(fields[1].visible, isTrue);
    expect(roomPlanType.fieldsOf(doc, f.b, words)[1].value, '12.16 m²');
    expect(roomPlanType.titleWordOf(doc, f.a), 'type:architecture.room');
    expect(roomPlanType.exported, isTrue);
  });

  test(
      'RM-name the name is trimmed, inner spaces kept; an empty name is '
      'refused (M-RM-1, M-RM-2)', () {
    final f = rooms();
    final doc = f.plan.doc;
    doc.commands.execute(roomPlanType.commitField(
        doc, f.a, fieldOf(doc, f.a, 'name'), '  Snug  room \t', words));
    expect(doc.components.get<RoomParams>(f.a)!.name, 'Snug  room');
    expect(labelStrings(doc, f.a), ['Snug  room', '10.83 m²']);
    for (final empty in ['', '   ', '\t ']) {
      expect(
          () => roomPlanType.commitField(
              doc, f.a, fieldOf(doc, f.a, 'name'), empty, words),
          throwsArgumentError,
          reason: '"$empty"');
    }
    expect(doc.commands.undoDepth, 1);
  });

  test(
      'RM-area the Area line is the area label as drawn, read once per '
      'document state, "—" for a room with no labels (M-RM-3, M-RM-4, '
      'M-RM-5, M-RM-6)', () {
    final f = rooms();
    final doc = f.plan.doc;
    final reads = debugRoomAreaReads;
    expect(fieldOf(doc, f.b, 'area').value, '12.16 m²');
    expect(fieldOf(doc, f.b, 'area').value, '12.16 m²');
    expect(debugRoomAreaReads - reads, 1, reason: 'one read at one state');

    // The page turns to ft-in at 1:100, one command: the line follows.
    // 12,161,900 / 92,903.04 ≈ 130.9096; 10,830,000 / 92,903.04 ≈ 116.5731.
    doc.commands.execute(SetComponentCommand<PageComponent>(
        doc.rootHandle,
        pageOf(doc).copyWith(
            displayUnit: DisplayUnit.feetInches, scaleDenominator: 100)));
    expect(fieldOf(doc, f.b, 'area').value, '130.91 ft²');
    expect(fieldOf(doc, f.b, 'area').value, textOf(doc, labelsOf(doc, f.b)[1]));
    expect(fieldOf(doc, f.a, 'area').value, '116.57 ft²');
    doc.commands.undo();
    expect(fieldOf(doc, f.a, 'area').value, '10.83 m²');

    // A file's room that never regenerated has no label: the line reads
    // '—' and is shown.
    late Handle store;
    final loaded = reloadWithPage(staleFile(doc, (bare) {
      store = addRoom(bare, f.plan.at(7000.25, 2000.5), 'Store');
    }));
    expect(kids(loaded, store), isEmpty, reason: 'premise: no children');
    final line = roomPlanType.fieldsOf(loaded, store, words)[1];
    expect(line.value, '—');
    expect(line.visible, isTrue);
  });

  test(
      'RM-colour the colour target is the room\'s palette name; recolouring '
      'is one SetComponentCommand that keeps the rest (M-RM-7)', () {
    final f = rooms();
    final doc = f.plan.doc;
    expect(roomPlanType.hasColour, isTrue);
    expect(roomPlanType.colourOf(doc, f.a), isNull);
    doc.commands.execute(roomPlanType.recolour(doc, f.a, 'teal')!);
    expect(doc.components.get<RoomParams>(f.a)!.color, 'teal');
    expect(roomPlanType.colourOf(doc, f.a), 'teal');
    expect(roomPlanType.recolour(doc, f.a, 'teal'), isNull,
        reason: 'already teal');
    doc.commands.execute(roomPlanType.recolour(doc, f.a, null)!);
    final p = doc.components.get<RoomParams>(f.a)!;
    expect((p.color, p.name), (null, 'Kitchen'));
    expect(doc.commands.undoDepth, 2);
  });

  test(
      'RM-grips the label grip returns to auto within the snap aperture at '
      'the camera\'s scale; a room is not movable (M-RM-8, M-RM-9)', () {
    final f = rooms();
    final doc = f.plan.doc;
    // 0.25 px per mm: the aperture is kSnapAperturePixels / 0.25 = 40 mm.
    final services = FakePlanServices(
        document: doc, catalog: testCatalog(), scale: 0.25);
    addTearDown(services.dispose);
    final grips = roomPlanType.gripsFor(services)!;
    expect(grips.movable(doc, f.b), isFalse);
    // B's label is auto: its grip is its pole.
    final g = grips.gripsOf(doc, f.b).single;
    final pole = Vector2(g.x, g.y);
    expect(grips.drag(doc, f.b, g, pole + Vector2(0.6 * 36, -0.8 * 36)),
        isNull,
        reason: '36 mm from the pole: auto stays auto');
    expect(grips.drag(doc, f.b, g, pole + Vector2(0.6 * 44, -0.8 * 44)),
        isA<SetComponentCommand<RoomParams>>(),
        reason: '44 mm from the pole: an offset');
  });
}

```dart
// The room as the kit's type (spec 3a C3.5): today's RoomType, its label
// grip, and the Selection panel's Room section (jet_cad_floor_plan's
// selection_panel.dart:1373-1386) as property specs: the name, trimmed and
// never empty, and the area as drawn, a TextDisplay over the object (spec
// 3a C1.1). The colour row's room half (colors/color_picker.dart:17-57) is
// the type's colour target. Task 19 adds the Room tool.
import 'package:jet_cad_2d/jet_cad_2d.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit/jet_cad_2d_kit.dart';
import 'package:meta/meta.dart' show visibleForTesting;

import '../ids.dart';
import 'room.dart';
import 'room_grips.dart';

/// The room type (spec 3a C3.5).
///
/// - **Name**: a [TextProperty] committed trimmed; a name empty once
///   trimmed is refused (today's R-24: a nameless room could not be told
///   apart), gated by `reshape` (an object's own field, today's S-10).
/// - **Area**: [roomAreaText], read-only.
/// - **Colour**: the room's palette name (plan colours spec PC-3).
/// - **Grips**: the label grip; a drop within the snap aperture of the
///   pole, at the camera's scale whatever F3 says, returns the label to
///   automatic (Ruling 10-17). A room is not moved or turned (R-22).
final PlanType<RoomParams> roomPlanType = PlanType<RoomParams>(
  id: ArchitectureTypes.room,
  fromJson: RoomParams.fromJson,
  parametric: const RoomType(),
  grips: (s) =>
      RoomGrips(aperture: () => kSnapAperturePixels / s.camera.value.scale),
  properties: [
    TextProperty<RoomParams>(
      id: 'name',
      read: (p) => p.name,
      write: (p, v) {
        final name = v.trim();
        if (name.isEmpty) {
          throw ArgumentError.value(v, 'name', 'is empty once trimmed');
        }
        return p.copyWith(name: name);
      },
      gate: PlanGate.reshape,
    ),
    TextDisplay<RoomParams>(id: 'area', read: (p, o) => roomAreaText(o)),
  ],
  colour: ColourTarget<RoomParams>(
    read: (p) => p.color,
    write: (p, swatch) => p.copyWith(color: swatch),
  ),
);

/// How many times [roomAreaText] read the document (not its memo). Never
/// reset by the library.
@visibleForTesting
int debugRoomAreaReads = 0;

/// The last Area line read per document: the room, the document's state
/// and the string.
final Expando<({Handle room, int state, String text})> _areaMemo =
    Expando('roomAreaText');

/// The Area line of [object], a room (spec 10 D21, R-25; today's `_areaOf`,
/// selection_panel.dart:826-844): its area label's stored string, exactly
/// as drawn, or '—' when it has none (a file's room with no children,
/// today's panel line). The labels are the room's TEXT children, the name
/// then the area in handle order (D9, D18), so the area is the second, in
/// handle order, never in slot order.
///
/// Reads the document once per room shown and per document state
/// (`commands.stateId`): today's panel dropped its memo on every command
/// change, and the state moves on exactly those.
String roomAreaText(PlanObject object) {
  final doc = object.document;
  final room = object.handle;
  final state = doc.commands.stateId;
  final memo = _areaMemo[doc];
  if (memo != null && memo.room == room && memo.state == state) {
    return memo.text;
  }
  debugRoomAreaReads++;
  final entities = doc.entities;
  final labels = <(Handle, int)>[
    for (final slot in entities.liveSlots)
      if (entities.ownerAt(slot) == room &&
          entities.kindAt(slot) == EntityKind.text)
        (entities.handleAt(slot), slot),
  ]..sort((a, b) => a.$1.value.compareTo(b.$1.value));
  final text = labels.length < 2 ? '—' : entities.textAt(labels[1].$2);
  _areaMemo[doc] = (room: room, state: state, text: text);
  return text;
}
```

```dart
// Room plans for the integration tests (spec 3a C6): the kit's room
// fixture's plans (jet_cad_floor_plan/test/support/room_fixture.dart, whose
// plan model and helpers are copied here), built in code by a PlanBuild
// over the architecture kit (spec 3a C1.9). The plan library makes the
// document, prepares it, installs its own system, runs the build and clears
// the history: the controller opens clean, as today's shell fixtures made
// it by hand. Each wall, separator, opening and room is one command, in the
// fixture's order, so the handles are the fixture's.
//
// The editor is driven through the public API only: PlanEditor in
// planEditorApp, the controller's camera, selection and worldToGlobal.
import 'dart:math' as math;

import 'package:flutter/gestures.dart' show PointerDeviceKind, kPrimaryButton;
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter/services.dart' show LogicalKeyboardKey;
import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d/jet_cad_2d.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_flutter/jet_cad_2d_flutter.dart' show SelectionKey;
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit_architecture/jet_cad_2d_kit_architecture.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_plan/jet_cad_2d_plan.dart';
import 'package:vector_math/vector_math_64.dart' show Vector2;

import 'editor_rig.dart';
import 'wall_fixture.dart';

export 'editor_rig.dart' show globalAt, kitCatalog, press, pumpEditor, status;
export 'wall_fixture.dart' show driftOf, enc, kids, kindOf, payloadOf;

// ... the copied plan model and helpers (above) ...

/// A room the build adds at plan point ([x], [y]), named [name], with label
/// offset [label] (null: auto) and, with [at], in a group of that world
/// transform (only a file makes one), its seed taken back through it
/// (today's `addRoom`, room_fixture.dart:561-579).
typedef R = ({
  double x,
  double y,
  String name,
  (double, double)? label,
  Transform2? at,
});

/// A plan built by [roomPlan] and its controller.
final class RoomPlan {
  RoomPlan._(this.c, this.place, this.walls, this.seps, this.openings,
      this.rooms);

  final PlanController c;
  final Placement place;

  /// The handles the build allocated, in the order given.
  final List<Handle> walls, seps, openings, rooms;

  DraftDocument get doc => c.document;
  Vector2 at(double x, double y) => place.at(x, y);
}

/// A controller over the architecture kit whose plan is [walls], [seps],
/// [openings] (hosted by the walls they index) and [rooms], at [place],
/// each one command, built in that order (today's `buildPlan`, then
/// `attachPage` and `addRoom`), with [page] on the root when given.
/// Disposed at tear-down.
RoomPlan roomPlan(List<W> walls,
    {List<S> seps = const [],
    List<O> openings = const [],
    List<R> rooms = const [],
    Placement place = origin,
    PageComponent? page}) {
  final wh = <Handle>[], sh = <Handle>[], oh = <Handle>[], rh = <Handle>[];
  void group(DraftDocument doc, Handle h, Transform2 g, DraftCommand set,
          String label) =>
      doc.commands.execute(CompoundCommand([
        AddNodeCommand(GroupNode(
            handle: h,
            parent: doc.rootHandle,
            transform: g,
            children: const [])),
        set,
      ], label: label));
  final c = PlanController(
    kits: [architectureKit],
    build: (doc, _) {
      var k = 0;
      for (final w in walls) {
        final h = doc.handleSeed.next();
        final g = place.groups ? _groupFor(place, k++) : Transform2.identity();
        final inv = g.invert();
        final s = inv.transformPoint(place.at(w.sx, w.sy));
        final e = inv.transformPoint(place.at(w.ex, w.ey));
        group(doc, h, g,
            SetComponentCommand<WallParams>(
                h, WallParams(s.x, s.y, e.x, e.y, w.t, w.j)),
            'Add wall');
        wh.add(h);
      }
      for (final (sx, sy, ex, ey) in seps) {
        final h = doc.handleSeed.next();
        final g = place.groups ? _groupFor(place, k++) : Transform2.identity();
        final inv = g.invert();
        final s = inv.transformPoint(place.at(sx, sy));
        final e = inv.transformPoint(place.at(ex, ey));
        group(doc, h, g,
            SetComponentCommand<SeparatorParams>(
                h, SeparatorParams(s.x, s.y, e.x, e.y)),
            'Add separator');
        sh.add(h);
      }
      for (final (i, position, width, kind, swing) in openings) {
        final h = doc.handleSeed.next();
        group(
            doc,
            h,
            Transform2.identity(),
            SetComponentCommand<OpeningParams>(
                h, OpeningParams(wh[i], position, width, kind, swing: swing)),
            'Add opening');
        oh.add(h);
      }
      if (page != null) {
        doc.commands
            .execute(SetComponentCommand<PageComponent>(doc.rootHandle, page));
      }
      for (final r in rooms) {
        final h = doc.handleSeed.next();
        final g = r.at ?? Transform2.identity();
        final seed = place.at(r.x, r.y);
        final s = r.at == null ? seed : g.invert().transformPoint(seed);
        group(doc, h, g,
            SetComponentCommand<RoomParams>(
                h, RoomParams(s.x, s.y, r.name, label: r.label)),
            'Add room');
        rh.add(h);
      }
    },
  );
  addTearDown(c.dispose);
  return RoomPlan._(c, place, wh, sh, oh, rh);
}

/// Every live room of [doc], ascending.
List<Handle> rooms(DraftDocument doc) =>
    doc.components.withComponent<RoomParams>().toList();

String nameOf(DraftDocument doc, Handle room) =>
    doc.components.get<RoomParams>(room)!.name;

/// The rig's [pumpEditor] with a rotated, non-reflecting camera of [scale]
/// px per mm, turned [turn] rad, centred on [centre] (today's shell tests'
/// `pumpShell`, room_grips_test.dart:145-162).
Future<void> pumpAt(WidgetTester tester, PlanController c, Vector2 centre,
        {double scale = 0.15, double turn = 0.35}) =>
    pumpEditor(tester, c, centre: centre, scale: scale, turn: turn);

Future<void> clickAt(WidgetTester tester, PlanController c, Vector2 p) async {
  await tester.tapAt(globalAt(tester, c, p));
  await tester.pump();
}

/// A mouse drag from world [from] to world [to], past the slop at once
/// (today's `dragWorld`, room_grips_test.dart:176-188).
Future<void> dragWorld(
    WidgetTester tester, PlanController c, Vector2 from, Vector2 to) async {
  final a = globalAt(tester, c, from), b = globalAt(tester, c, to);
  final gesture = await tester.createGesture(
      kind: PointerDeviceKind.mouse, buttons: kPrimaryButton);
  await gesture.down(a);
  await gesture.moveTo(a + const Offset(12, 0));
  await gesture.moveTo(b);
  await gesture.up();
  await gesture.removePointer();
  await tester.pump();
  await tester.pump();
}

Future<void> undoKey(WidgetTester tester) async {
  await tester.sendKeyDownEvent(LogicalKeyboardKey.meta);
  await tester.sendKeyEvent(LogicalKeyboardKey.keyZ);
  await tester.sendKeyUpEvent(LogicalKeyboardKey.meta);
  await tester.pump();
  await tester.pump();
}

Future<void> toggleF3(WidgetTester tester) async {
  await tester.sendKeyEvent(LogicalKeyboardKey.f3);
  await tester.pump();
}

String osnap(WidgetTester tester) =>
    tester.widget<Text>(find.byKey(const Key('osnap-text'))).data!;

/// The design's selection replaced by [hs], as roots.
Future<void> select(
    WidgetTester tester, PlanController c, List<Handle> hs) async {
  c.activeSelection.replace([for (final h in hs) SelectionKey.root(h)]);
  await tester.pump();
}

```dart
/// A Room tool over [doc], made by the kit's own tool (roomPlanTool) over
/// a FakePlanServices: a camera at [scale] pixels per mm (1 gives a 10 mm
/// aperture), object snap on, no page (no grid), the kit's words in
/// [locale] (today's `strings`) with [names] first when given, and
/// [frozen] frozen. Its inputs are the kit's shared RoomInputs.
Rig roomRig(DraftDocument doc,
    {double scale = 1,
    Locale locale = const Locale('en'),
    KitNames? names,
    Set<Handle> frozen = const {}}) {
  final services = FakePlanServices(
      document: doc,
      catalog: testCatalog(),
      scale: scale,
      locale: locale,
      names: names == null
          ? architectureKit.names
          : names.merge(architectureKit.names),
      frozen: frozen);
  final selection = SelectionController(doc);
  final tool = roomPlanTool.create(services) as RoomTool;
  addTearDown(() {
    tool.dispose();
    selection.dispose();
    services.dispose();
  });
  return (
    tool: tool,
    ctx: ToolContext(
        document: doc,
        index: services.index,
        camera: services.camera,
        selection: selection),
    inputs: roomInputsOf(services),
  );
}
```

    final plan = buildPlan(boxWalls, place: corpusGroups);

    final before = rooms(doc);

    expect(doc.components.get<RoomParams>(addedRoom(doc, before))!.name,
        'Space 3');

    addTearDown(services.dispose);
    final tool = roomPlanTool.create(services) as RoomTool;
    addTearDown(tool.dispose);
    expect(tool.inputs, same(roomInputsOf(services)));

  test(
      'RT-frozen-wall beside a frozen wall the Room tool\'s preview and the '
      'room it makes agree: both ignore it (Review Focus 5; M-RT-6)', () {
    // The two-room box at the corpus far origin, every wall in its own
    // turned group, the partition frozen (spec 2a E2): in no survey, so no
    // room reads it, and no input to the tool. The seed's face is the whole
    // box: 7,800 × 3,800 = 29,640,000 ("29.64 m²", 0.005 from a tie).
    final plan = buildPlan(twoRoomWalls, place: corpusGroups);
    final doc = plan.doc;
    final frozen = {plan.walls[4]};
    plan.system.dispose();
    final system =
        ParametricSystem(doc, testCatalog(), isFrozen: frozen.contains)
          ..install();
    addTearDown(system.dispose);
    final rig = roomRig(doc, frozen: frozen);
    final seed = plan.at(1500.25, 2000.5);
    hoverTo(rig, seed);
    final preview = ringOf(rig.tool.debugPreview.single);
    expectRing(plan, preview,
        const [(100, 100), (7900, 100), (7900, 3900), (100, 3900)],
        'the preview: the whole box');
    pressAt(rig, seed);
    final room = rooms(doc).single;
    expect(labelStrings(doc, room), ['Room 1', '29.64 m²']);
    expectSameRing(worldTintOf(doc, room), preview,
        'the room\'s tint is the preview');

    // The control: nothing frozen, both see the partition: the left face,
    // 2,850 × 3,800 = 10,830,000 ("10.83 m²").
    final live = buildPlan(twoRoomWalls, place: corpusGroups);
    final lrig = roomRig(live.doc);
    final lseed = live.at(1500.25, 2000.5);
    hoverTo(lrig, lseed);
    final lpreview = ringOf(lrig.tool.debugPreview.single);
    expectRing(live, lpreview,
        const [(100, 100), (2950, 100), (2950, 3900), (100, 3900)],
        'the control\'s preview: the left face');
    pressAt(lrig, lseed);
    final lroom = rooms(live.doc).single;
    expect(labelStrings(live.doc, lroom), ['Room 1', '10.83 m²']);
    expectSameRing(worldTintOf(live.doc, lroom), lpreview, 'the control');
  });

  - Lines 374-393 (`_nextName`) become:

```dart
  /// A name the Room tool gives (spec 10 D19, spec 14d L7, spec 3a C1.6):
  /// the kit's numbered name ([kRoomNameText]) in the words of the moment,
  /// `n` the smallest positive integer no live room's name takes in those
  /// words or in any locale the kit ships (today's rule: the current
  /// language and every built-in one).
  String _nextName(DraftDocument doc) {
    final patterns = _namePatterns();
    final used = <int>{
      for (final h in _liveRooms(doc))
        if (numberedNameIndex(
                doc.components.get<RoomParams>(h)!.name, patterns)
            case final n?)
          n,
    };
    var n = 1;
    while (used.contains(n)) {
      n++;
    }
    return words.text(kRoomNameText, {'n': n});
  }

  /// One numbered-name pattern per locale (spec 3a C1.6): the words of the
  /// moment first (a host's word for the current locale included), then
  /// each locale of the kit's own words.
  List<String Function(int n)> _namePatterns() => [
        (n) => words.text(kRoomNameText, {'n': n}),
        for (final locale in architectureNames.words.values)
          if (locale[kRoomNameText] case final template?)
            (n) => fillText(template, {'n': n}),
      ];

  /// Every live room of [doc], ascending by handle (today's
  /// `liveObjectsOf<RoomParams>`, asked of the plan's live rule).
  List<Handle> _liveRooms(DraftDocument doc) => [
        for (final h in doc.components.withComponent<RoomParams>())
          if (live(h) == ArchitectureTypes.room) h,
      ];
```

// Spec 3a C6, C1.2: the Room tool in the plan library's editor. TT1's
// shell half, TT7 and SG1 are ported from jet_cad_floor_plan/test/
// room_tool_test.dart (spec 10 D19, decision 26, R-29, X15-guardMS),
// assertions unchanged: the status line composes the tool's label and its
// notice as today ('Room — Already a room: Room 1'). RT-notice-locale is
// Review Focus 2: a language switch re-words a notice already shown, at
// once, the room's name kept.
import 'package:flutter/gestures.dart' show PointerDeviceKind;
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter/services.dart' show LogicalKeyboardKey;
import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_integration/jet_cad_2d_integration.dart';
import 'package:vector_math/vector_math_64.dart' show Vector2;

import '../support/room_plans.dart';

/// Today's `shellSamplePlan` (room_tool_test.dart:213-218): the sample
/// plan's walls, column, separator and openings at the origin, with
/// [rooms].
RoomPlan sampleRoomPlan({List<R> rooms = const []}) =>
    roomPlan([...sampleWalls(), sampleColumn],
        seps: const [sampleSeparator],
        openings: sampleOpenings,
        rooms: rooms);

void main() {
  testWidgets(
      'TT1 M places one room with one click, one undo step, named Room 1, '
      'seeded at the raw point; the tool stays active and Esc returns to '
      'Select (the editor)', (tester) async {
    // The editor: M and the palette entry both activate the tool, a click
    // places a room, the tool stays active, and Esc returns to Select.
    final shell = sampleRoomPlan();
    await pumpEditor(tester, shell.c,
        centre: shell.at(20000, 10500), scale: 0.12);
    final sdoc = shell.doc;
    await press(tester, LogicalKeyboardKey.keyM);
    expect(status(tester), 'Room');
    await press(tester, LogicalKeyboardKey.escape);
    expect(status(tester), 'Select');
    await tester.tap(find.byKey(const Key('tool-architecture.room')));
    await tester.pump();
    expect(status(tester), 'Room');
    final sdepth = sdoc.commands.undoDepth;
    await clickAt(tester, shell.c, shell.at(18500.5, 9750.25));
    final kitchen = rooms(sdoc).single;
    expect(sdoc.commands.undoDepth, sdepth + 1);
    // The Kitchen: x 17,060-21,440, y 8,250-11,440: 4,380 × 3,190 =
    // 13,972,200 mm², 13.97 m² (0.0022 from a tie).
    expect(labelStrings(sdoc, kitchen), ['Room 1', '13.97 m²']);
    expect(status(tester), 'Room — Already a room: Room 1',
        reason: 'the tool stays active, over the face it just filled');
    await undoKey(tester);
    expect(rooms(sdoc), isEmpty);
    expect(status(tester), 'Room', reason: 'the face is free again');
    await press(tester, LogicalKeyboardKey.escape);
    expect(status(tester), 'Select');

      'TT7 a click in an occupied face places nothing and the status line '

      (x: 19000, y: 10000, name: 'Kitchen', label: null, at: null),
    ]);
    await pumpEditor(tester, plan.c,
        centre: plan.at(20000, 10500), scale: 0.12);
    final doc = plan.doc;
    final mouse = await tester.createGesture(kind: PointerDeviceKind.mouse);
    addTearDown(mouse.removePointer);
    Future<void> hover(double x, double y) async {
      await mouse.moveTo(globalAt(tester, plan.c, plan.at(x, y)));
      await tester.pump();
    }

    await press(tester, LogicalKeyboardKey.keyM);
    expect(status(tester), 'Room');
    await hover(20500.5, 9000.25);
    expect(status(tester), 'Room — Already a room: Kitchen',
        reason: 'hovering the occupied face');
    final before = rooms(doc);
    final depth = doc.commands.undoDepth;
    await clickAt(tester, plan.c, plan.at(18200.5, 10800.25));
    expect(rooms(doc), before, reason: 'nothing placed');
    expect(doc.commands.undoDepth, depth);
    expect(status(tester), 'Room — Already a room: Kitchen',
        reason: 'after a click there');
    // The Bath: a face with no room.
    await hover(23500.5, 10000.25);
    expect(status(tester), 'Room', reason: 'cleared on leaving the face');
    await hover(19000.5, 10500.25);
    expect(status(tester), 'Room — Already a room: Kitchen');
    await press(tester, LogicalKeyboardKey.escape);
    expect(status(tester), 'Select', reason: 'cleared on deactivation');
    expect(plan.c.toolNotice.value, isNull);
    await press(tester, LogicalKeyboardKey.keyM);
    expect(status(tester), 'Room');

  testWidgets(
      'SG1 M and S typed into a text entry switch no tool (the shell\'s '
      'guard, X15-guardMS)', (tester) async {

    await press(tester, LogicalKeyboardKey.keyT);
    expect(status(tester), 'Text');
    await tester.tapAt(globalAt(tester, plan.c, Vector2(2000.5, 2000.25)));
    await tester.pump();
    expect(find.byKey(const Key('text-entry')), findsOneWidget);
    for (final k in [LogicalKeyboardKey.keyM, LogicalKeyboardKey.keyS]) {
      await press(tester, k);
      expect(status(tester), 'Text', reason: '$k switched no tool');
      expect(find.byKey(const Key('text-entry')), findsOneWidget);
    }
  });

  testWidgets(
      'RT-notice-locale a language switch re-words the Room tool\'s notice '
      'at once, in the new language, the room\'s name kept (Review Focus 2; '
      'M-RT-3)', (tester) async {
    final plan = roomPlan(boxWalls, place: corpusGroups, rooms: const [
      (x: 1500.25, y: 2000.5, name: 'Kitchen', label: null, at: null),
    ]);
    await pumpEditor(tester, plan.c,
        centre: plan.at(4000, 2000), scale: 0.15);
    final mouse = await tester.createGesture(kind: PointerDeviceKind.mouse);
    addTearDown(mouse.removePointer);
    await press(tester, LogicalKeyboardKey.keyM);

    await tester.pump();
    expect(status(tester), 'Room — Already a room: Kitchen');
    expect(plan.c.toolNotice.value?.id, 'text:architecture.room-occupied');
    expect(plan.c.toolNotice.value?.args, {'name': 'Kitchen'});
    // The language turns, the pointer stays: the line re-words at once.
    for (final (locale, line) in const [
      (Locale('de'), 'Raum — Bereits ein Raum: Kitchen'),
      (Locale('tr'), 'Oda — Zaten bir oda: Kitchen'),
      (Locale('en'), 'Room — Already a room: Kitchen'),
    ]) {
      await tester.pumpWidget(planEditorApp(plan.c, locale: locale));
      await tester.pump();
      expect(status(tester), line, reason: '$locale');
    }
  });
}

    ```dart
    /// `T` (spec 11 D10): the largest **world** thickness of a live wall of
    /// [doc], each wall's stored thickness times its group's `scaleMagnitude`
    /// (so a scaled group, file only, is covered); 0 with no live wall. One pass
    /// over the walls. A live wall is one [live] names a wall (spec 3a C1.5:
    /// the plan's `liveTypeIdOf`, so a frozen wall is none).
    double thickestWall(DraftDocument doc, LiveTypeOf live) {
      var t = 0.0;
      for (final h in doc.components.withComponent<WallParams>()) {
        if (live(h) != ArchitectureTypes.wall) continue;
        final w = doc.components.get<WallParams>(h)!.thickness *
            doc.tree.accumulatedTransform(h).scaleMagnitude;
        if (w > t) t = w;
      }
      return t;
    }
    ```
  - lines 48-114 (the doc comment of `attachCandidates`): copy unchanged, then append a paragraph:
    ```dart
    ///
    /// **[live]** answers which handles are live walls and live openings (spec
    /// 3a C1.5): the plan's `liveTypeIdOf`, so a frozen wall or opening is in
    /// neither query, as it is in no survey.
    ```
  - lines 115-171 become:
    ```dart
    List<AttachedEnd> attachCandidates(
        DraftDocument doc, SpatialIndex index, Vector2 q,
        {required LiveTypeOf live,
        required bool objectSnap,
        required double thickest,
        Map<Handle, WallPoints>? points}) {
      if (!objectSnap) return const [];
      final walls = <Handle>{};
      final tight = dimAttach.linear;
      index.forEachInRect(
          Aabb2.raw(q.x - tight, q.y - tight, q.x + tight, q.y + tight),
          const QueryFilter.rendering(), (slot) {
        final owner = doc.entities.ownerAt(slot);
        if (live(owner) == ArchitectureTypes.wall) walls.add(owner);
      });
      final grown = dimAttach.linear + thickest;
      FilterEvaluator? drawn;
      index.forEachInRect(
          Aabb2.raw(q.x - grown, q.y - grown, q.x + grown, q.y + grown),
          const QueryFilter.rendering(), (slot) {
        final owner = doc.entities.ownerAt(slot);
        if (live(owner) != ArchitectureTypes.opening) return;
        final host = doc.components.get<OpeningParams>(owner)!.host;
        if (live(host) != ArchitectureTypes.wall) return;
        // Only a host the renderer draws (D10: what is drawn attaches): the
        // opening's children passed `rendering()`, its host's group must too,
        // and its object layer must be visible (spec 12b D6, R-7).
        drawn ??= FilterEvaluator(doc);
        if (drawn!.acceptsNode(host, const QueryFilter.rendering()) &&
            _layerVisible(doc, objectLayer(doc, host))) {
          walls.add(host);
        }
      });
      final out = <AttachedEnd>[];
      for (final h in walls.toList()..sort((a, b) => a.value.compareTo(b.value))) {
        if (!_onALine(doc, h, q)) continue;
        debugLineTestPasses++;
        final six = points == null
            ? _wallPointsOf(doc, h, live)
            : (points[h] ??= _wallPointsOf(doc, h, live));
        for (final (k, side, p) in six) {
          if ((p - q).length <= dimAttach.linear) out.add(AttachedEnd(h, k, side));
        }
      }
      return out;
    }

    /// Whether [layer] is drawn (spec 12b D6): a missing record counts as
    /// visible, as `FilterEvaluator` counts it.
    bool _layerVisible(DraftDocument doc, Handle layer) =>
        doc.tables.layers[layer]?.visible ?? true;

    /// Live wall [h]'s six points among every other live wall of [doc].
    WallPoints _wallPointsOf(DraftDocument doc, Handle h, LiveTypeOf live) {
      debugWallPointComputations++;
      final ws = wallsInDocument(doc, h, live)!;
      return wallEndPoints(ws.host, ws.walls);
    }
    ```
  - copy lines 172-297 unchanged (`_onALine`, `_nearALine`, `decideEnd`, `_parallelMeasure`, `_before`, `_centreRank`: they read `WallParams` of handles the caller already decided).

```dart
// 3a Task 20, spec C1.5: the dimension's attach search asks the plan's live
// types, never a catalog of its own. A frozen wall (the plan's
// liveTypeIdOf answers null) is no candidate, by its own children or as an
// opening's host, and no part of T; a frozen opening brings no host in.
// Today's rule (`live_objects.dart`) asked the global catalog, which
// answers a frozen object's id too (spec C1.5's Facts:
// `ParametricCatalog.typeIdOf`, parametric_system.dart:672-675).
//
// The fixture is AM6's flush T (spike C5) at the corpus far origin with
// every wall in its own turned group: C (0, 0) -> (6000, 0), 200; S (2500,
// 0) -> (2500, 3000), 100; a 900 mm door on S centred 450 along it, so S's
// butt-end points are reached only through the door's host query (AM6's
// premise, re-asserted below).
import 'dart:convert' show jsonDecode;

import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d/jet_cad_2d.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit_architecture/src/dimension/dimension.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit_architecture/src/dimension/dimension_attach.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit_architecture/src/ids.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit_architecture/src/live.dart';
import 'package:vector_math/vector_math_64.dart' show Vector2;

import '../support/dimension_fixture.dart';

const l = WallSide.left, c = WallSide.centre;

void main() {
  test(
      'DG-frozen a frozen wall is no candidate and no part of T; a frozen '
      'host is not brought in by its door; a frozen door brings no host '
      '(M-DG1, M-DG2, M-DG3, M-DG4)', () {
    final plan = flushT(corpusGroups);
    final doc = plan.doc;
    final [cw, s] = plan.walls;
    final door = plan.openings.single;
    final index = SpatialIndex(doc);
    addTearDown(index.dispose);
    final all = liveOf(doc);
    LiveTypeOf frozen(Handle h) => (x) => x == h ? null : all(x);

    // Premises: the catalog names all three; the plan's view of a frozen
    // object answers null for it alone.
    expect(all(cw), ArchitectureTypes.wall);
    expect(all(s), ArchitectureTypes.wall);
    expect(all(door), ArchitectureTypes.opening);
    expect(frozen(cw)(cw), isNull);
    expect(frozen(cw)(s), ArchitectureTypes.wall);

    // -- T: the thickest live wall. C is 200, S 100.
    expect(thickestWall(doc, all), 200, reason: 'control');
    expect(thickestWall(doc, frozen(cw)), 100, reason: 'C frozen: S only');

    // -- C's free start, left face (0, 100): a point of C's own children.
    final c0 = plan.at(0, 100);
    List<AttachedEnd> at(Vector2 q, LiveTypeOf live) => attachCandidates(
        doc, index, q,
        live: live, objectSnap: true, thickest: thickestWall(doc, live));
    expect(at(c0, all), contains(AttachedEnd(cw, 0, l)), reason: 'control');
    expect([for (final e in at(c0, frozen(cw))) e.wall], isNot(contains(cw)),
        reason: 'C frozen: none of its points');

    // -- S's butt end on C's face, its centre (2500, 0): not stored on S
    // (AM6), so only the door's host query reaches it.
    final s0 = plan.at(2500, 0);
    expect(at(s0, all), contains(AttachedEnd(s, 0, c)), reason: 'control');
    expect(bruteCandidates(doc, s0), contains(AttachedEnd(s, 0, c)),
        reason: 'premise: a point of S');
    expect([for (final e in at(s0, frozen(s))) e.wall], isNot(contains(s)),
        reason: 'S frozen: its door does not bring it in');
    expect([for (final e in at(s0, frozen(door))) e.wall], isNot(contains(s)),
        reason: 'the door frozen: no host query through it');
  });

  test(
      'DG-id a dimension is stored under architecture.dimension (M-DG5)',
      () {
    expect(DimensionParams.componentTypeId, ArchitectureTypes.dimension);
    expect(ArchitectureTypes.dimension, 'architecture.dimension');
    final plan = buildPlan(const [W(0, 0, 4000, 0, 200)], place: corpusGroups);
    addDimension(plan.doc, const FixedEnd(10.5, -20.25),
        const FixedEnd(3010.75, 1180.5),
        kind: DimKind.horizontal, offset: 300.25, at: corpusGroups.m);
    final json = jsonDecode(enc(plan.doc)) as Map<String, Object?>;
    final components = json['components']! as Map<String, Object?>;
    expect(components.keys, contains('architecture.dimension'));
    expect(components.keys, isNot(contains('floor_planner.dimension')));
  });
}
```

```dart
// The dimension as a plan type (3a spec C3.6, C1.1): today's Dimension
// section (jet_cad_floor_plan/lib/src/selection_panel.dart:846-976) as
// property specs over the object, and the grips over the plan's services.
//
// - Value: the TEXT child's string as drawn, '—' without one (a broken
//   dimension, D15), read once per dimension and history state (today:
//   once per document change, :232-236, :851-864).
// - Kind: a choice; a change keeps the ends and the offset (R-27). Gated
//   by `reshape` (today's `_dimensionEditable`, :870-875: the host's
//   reshape, then the document's `components` and the type's geometry,
//   which the plan's panel checks for every type).
// - Axes: a linear dimension's group's world rotation, rounded to tenths
//   and normalised to (−180°, 180°], in the UI language's words and
//   decimal separator; omitted for aligned and below 0.05° (:901-916).
// - End 1, End 2: `Wall <hex>, start|end, <side>` or `Fixed` (:918-931).
import 'dart:math' as math;

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart' show visibleForTesting;
import 'package:jet_cad_2d/jet_cad_2d.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit/jet_cad_2d_kit.dart';

import '../ids.dart';
import '../live.dart';
import 'dimension.dart';
import 'dimension_grips.dart';

/// The dimension's plan type (Shared interfaces, spec C3.6).
final PlanType<DimensionParams> dimensionPlanType = PlanType<DimensionParams>(
  id: ArchitectureTypes.dimension,
  fromJson: DimensionParams.fromJson,
  parametric: const DimensionType(),
  grips: (s) => DimensionGrips(
      index: s.index, objectSnap: () => s.objectSnap, live: liveTypesOf(s)),
  properties: [
    TextDisplay<DimensionParams>(id: 'value', read: dimensionValueOf),
    ChoiceProperty<DimensionParams, DimKind>(
        id: 'kind',
        values: DimKind.values,
        read: (p) => p.kind,
        write: (p, kind) => p.copyWith(kind: kind),
        gate: PlanGate.reshape),
    TextDisplay<DimensionParams>(id: 'axes', read: dimensionAxesOf),
    TextDisplay<DimensionParams>(
        id: 'end-1', read: (p, o) => dimensionEndLine(p.a, o.words)),
    TextDisplay<DimensionParams>(
        id: 'end-2', read: (p, o) => dimensionEndLine(p.b, o.words)),
  ],
);

/// Every scan [dimensionValueOf] made of a document's entities. Tests read
/// the difference across calls: one per dimension shown and history state.
@visibleForTesting
int debugDimensionValueScans = 0;

/// The last value read, per document.
final class _ValueMemo {
  Handle? handle;
  int state = 0;
  String? text;
}

final Expando<_ValueMemo> _valueMemo = Expando<_ValueMemo>('dimension value');

/// The Value line (spec 11 D14, decision 13): [object]'s TEXT child's
/// stored string, exactly as drawn, or '—' when it has none (a broken
/// dimension generates no child, D7, D15). Read once per dimension and
/// `document.commands.stateId` (spec 3a C1.1): a wall edit or a page change
/// is a command and rewrites the string in place.
String? dimensionValueOf(DimensionParams p, PlanObject object) {
  final doc = object.document;
  final state = doc.commands.stateId;
  final memo = _valueMemo[doc] ??= _ValueMemo();
  if (memo.handle != object.handle || memo.state != state) {
    debugDimensionValueScans++;
    final entities = doc.entities;
    String? text;
    for (final slot in entities.liveSlots) {
      if (entities.ownerAt(slot) == object.handle &&
          entities.kindAt(slot) == EntityKind.text) {
        text = entities.textAt(slot);
        break;
      }
    }
    memo
      ..handle = object.handle
      ..state = state
      ..text = text;
  }
  return memo.text ?? '—';
}

/// The axes line (spec 11 D11, R-18), or null: for a linear kind whose
/// group's world rotation, `atan2(M.b, M.a)` in degrees, is at least 0.05°
/// either way (the number, not its printed string, S-8). Rounded to tenths
/// first and then normalised to (−180°, 180°], so −179.96° reads `180.0°`,
/// in [object]'s words with their decimal separator (spec 3a C1.6).
String? dimensionAxesOf(DimensionParams p, PlanObject object) {
  if (p.kind == DimKind.aligned) return null;
  final m = object.world;
  final angle = math.atan2(m.b, m.a) * 180 / math.pi;
  if (angle.abs() < 0.05) return null;
  var shown = double.parse(angle.toStringAsFixed(1));
  if (shown <= -180) shown += 360;
  final words = object.words;
  return words.text('text:architecture.axes-turned', {
    'degrees':
        shown.toStringAsFixed(1).replaceAll('.', words.decimalSeparator),
  });
}

/// An end line (spec 11 D14, R-28): for an attached end, its wall's handle
/// in hex, the start or end word for its `k` and the side's word (`Wall 1A,
/// end, left face`); the fixed word for a fixed end.
String dimensionEndLine(DimEnd end, PlanWords words) => switch (end) {
      FixedEnd() => words.word('text:architecture.end-fixed'),
      AttachedEnd(:final wall, :final k, :final side) =>
        words.text('text:architecture.end-on-wall', {
          'wall': wall.toHex(),
          'end': words.word(k == 0
              ? 'text:architecture.end-start'
              : 'text:architecture.end-end'),
          'side': words.word(switch (side) {
            WallSide.left => 'text:architecture.face-left',
            WallSide.centre => 'text:architecture.face-centre',
            WallSide.right => 'text:architecture.face-right',
          }),
        }),
    };
```
