```dart
// Plans for the dimension's integration tests (3a Tasks 21, 22), built in
// code through the plan's build seam (spec C1.9) over the architecture
// kit's public types, and read back through the plan's public API (C6).
// Copied, not imported (the plan's Ruling 11-22), from
// jet_cad_floor_plan/test/support/room_fixture.dart (:28-99, :118-194,
// :663-668), wall_fixture.dart (:180-191, :223-235, :284) and
// dimension_fixture.dart (:366-403). The rig's helpers are imported, not
// copied (R-P14).
import 'dart:math' as math;

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d/jet_cad_2d.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_flutter/jet_cad_2d_flutter.dart'
    show SelectionKey;
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit/jet_cad_2d_kit.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit_architecture/jet_cad_2d_kit_architecture.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_plan/jet_cad_2d_plan.dart';
import 'package:vector_math/vector_math_64.dart' show Vector2;

import '../support/editor_rig.dart';

export '../support/editor_rig.dart'
    show activeTool, kitCatalog, press, pumpEditor, status;

/// A wall in plan millimetres (room_fixture.dart:28-35).
final class W {
  const W(this.sx, this.sy, this.ex, this.ey, this.t,
      [this.j = Justification.centre]);

  final double sx, sy, ex, ey, t;
  final Justification j;
}

/// Where a plan is placed: plan point -> world point (room_fixture.dart:
/// 50-67).
final class Placement {
  const Placement(this.name, this.dx, this.dy, this.deg, {this.groups = false});

  final String name;
  final double dx, dy, deg;
  final bool groups;

  Transform2 get m => Transform2.translation(dx, dy)
      .multiply(Transform2.rotation(deg * math.pi / 180));

  Vector2 at(double x, double y) => m.transformPoint(Vector2(x, y));

  @override
  String toString() => name;
}

const origin = Placement('origin', 0, 0, 0);
const corpusGroups = Placement(
    'corpus far origin, 23 deg, own groups', 4500000, 1200000, 23,
    groups: true);

/// A group transform for object number [k] of a [Placement.groups] plan
/// (room_fixture.dart:94-97).
Transform2 groupFor(Placement p, int k) => p.m
    .multiply(Transform2.translation(311.5 * (k % 7), -173.25 * (k % 5)))
    .multiply(Transform2.rotation(0.3 + 0.7 * (k % 9)));

/// C2: an L, A east then B north, 200 each (dimension_fixture.dart:76).
const List<W> c2Walls = [W(0, 0, 4000, 0, 200), W(4000, 0, 4000, 3000, 200)];

/// A page at 1:50 in millimetres (dimension_fixture.dart:366-367).
PageComponent get mmPage =>
    PageComponent().copyWith(displayUnit: DisplayUnit.millimeters);

/// [page] on [doc]'s root, one command.
void setPage(DraftDocument doc, PageComponent page) => doc.commands
    .execute(SetComponentCommand<PageComponent>(doc.rootHandle, page));

/// A controller over the architecture kit whose new plan [build] fills
/// (spec C1.9: the plan's own document, system and DASHED record; the
/// history cleared after). A throw inside [build] fails the test (the
/// controller would only report it as a diagnostic). Disposed at
/// tear-down.
PlanController planOf(void Function(DraftDocument doc) build) {
  Object? failure;
  StackTrace? trace;
  final c = PlanController(
      kits: [architectureKit],
      build: (doc, _) {
        try {
          build(doc);
        } catch (e, s) {
          failure = e;
          trace = s;
          rethrow;
        }
      });
  addTearDown(c.dispose);
  if (failure != null) fail('the build threw: $failure\n$trace');
  return c;
}

/// A separator in plan millimetres (room_fixture.dart:37).
typedef S = (double sx, double sy, double ex, double ey);

/// An opening: its host's index in the plan's wall list, its position, its
/// width, kind and swing side (room_fixture.dart:41-47).
typedef O = (
  int wall,
  double position,
  double width,
  OpeningKind kind,
  SwingSide swing
);

/// What [buildPlanIn] added, in the order given.
typedef Built = ({List<Handle> walls, List<Handle> seps, List<Handle> openings});

/// room_fixture.dart:118-163's `buildPlan` on [doc], the plan's own
/// document inside a `PlanBuild`: [walls], then [seps], then [openings]
/// (hosted by the walls they index), each object one command, at [place].
/// Without `installParametric` and `ensureDashedLinetype`: the plan
/// installed its system and prepared the DASHED record (spec C1.3, C1.9).
Built buildPlanIn(DraftDocument doc, List<W> walls,
    {List<S> seps = const [],
    List<O> openings = const [],
    Placement place = origin}) {
  final wh = <Handle>[], sh = <Handle>[], oh = <Handle>[];
  var k = 0;
  for (final w in walls) {
    final h = doc.handleSeed.next();
    final g = place.groups ? groupFor(place, k++) : Transform2.identity();
    final inv = g.invert();
    final s = inv.transformPoint(place.at(w.sx, w.sy));
    final e = inv.transformPoint(place.at(w.ex, w.ey));
    doc.commands.execute(CompoundCommand([
      AddNodeCommand(GroupNode(
          handle: h, parent: doc.rootHandle, transform: g, children: const [])),
      SetComponentCommand<WallParams>(
          h, WallParams(s.x, s.y, e.x, e.y, w.t, w.j)),
    ], label: 'Add wall'));
    wh.add(h);
  }
  for (final (sx, sy, ex, ey) in seps) {
    sh.add(addSeparator(doc, place.at(sx, sy), place.at(ex, ey),
        at: place.groups ? groupFor(place, k++) : null));
  }
  for (final (i, position, width, kind, swing) in openings) {
    oh.add(addOpening(
        doc, OpeningParams(wh[i], position, width, kind, swing: swing)));
  }
  return (walls: wh, seps: sh, openings: oh);
}

/// A separator from world [s] to world [e] in its own root group [at]
/// (room_fixture.dart:165-178).
Handle addSeparator(DraftDocument doc, Vector2 s, Vector2 e, {Transform2? at}) {
  final h = doc.handleSeed.next();
  final g = at ?? Transform2.identity();
  final inv = g.invert();
  final ls = inv.transformPoint(s), le = inv.transformPoint(e);
  doc.commands.execute(CompoundCommand([
    AddNodeCommand(GroupNode(
        handle: h, parent: doc.rootHandle, transform: g, children: const [])),
    SetComponentCommand<SeparatorParams>(
        h, SeparatorParams(ls.x, ls.y, le.x, le.y)),
  ], label: 'Add separator'));
  return h;
}

/// Opening [o] in its own root group at the identity, one command
/// (room_fixture.dart:180-194).
Handle addOpening(DraftDocument doc, OpeningParams o) {
  final h = doc.handleSeed.next();
  doc.commands.execute(CompoundCommand([
    AddNodeCommand(GroupNode(
        handle: h,
        parent: doc.rootHandle,
        transform: Transform2.identity(),
        children: const [])),
    SetComponentCommand<OpeningParams>(h, o),
  ], label: 'Add opening'));
  return h;
}

/// Wall [h] in its own group [at] with the local parameters [p], one
/// command (wall_fixture.dart:180-191).
DraftCommand addWallLocal(
        DraftDocument doc, Handle h, WallParams p, Transform2 at) =>
    CompoundCommand([
      AddNodeCommand(GroupNode(
          handle: h, parent: doc.rootHandle, transform: at, children: const [])),
      SetComponentCommand<WallParams>(h, p),
    ], label: 'Add wall');

/// A dimension from [a] to [b] in its own root group at [at]: the
/// Dimension tool's commit (dimension_fixture.dart:373-386).
Handle addDimension(DraftDocument doc, DimEnd a, DimEnd b,
    {DimKind kind = DimKind.aligned, double offset = 500, Transform2? at}) {
  final h = doc.handleSeed.next();
  doc.commands.execute(CompoundCommand([
    AddNodeCommand(GroupNode(
        handle: h,
        parent: doc.rootHandle,
        transform: at ?? Transform2.identity(),
        children: const [])),
    SetComponentCommand<DimensionParams>(
        h, DimensionParams(a, b, kind, offset)),
  ], label: 'Add dimension'));
  return h;
}

/// A fixed end at world [w] in a group at [at] (dimension_fixture.dart:
/// 390-393).
FixedEnd fixedAt(Vector2 w, [Transform2? at]) {
  final l = (at ?? Transform2.identity()).invert().transformPoint(w);
  return FixedEnd(l.x, l.y);
}

/// [group]'s children, ascending (wall_fixture.dart:223-227).
List<Handle> kids(DraftDocument doc, Handle group) => [
      for (final slot in doc.entities.liveSlots)
        if (doc.entities.ownerAt(slot) == group) doc.entities.handleAt(slot),
    ]..sort((a, b) => a.value.compareTo(b.value));

EntityKind kindOf(DraftDocument doc, Handle h) =>
    doc.entities.kindAt(doc.entities.slotOf(h)!);

GeometryPayload payloadOf(DraftDocument doc, Handle h) =>
    doc.geometry.read(doc.entities.geomIndexAt(doc.entities.slotOf(h)!));

/// Dimension [h]'s value string: its one TEXT child's.
String dimText(DraftDocument doc, Handle h) {
  final text = kids(doc, h).singleWhere((k) => kindOf(doc, k) == EntityKind.text);
  return doc.entities.textAt(doc.entities.slotOf(text)!);
}

/// The select tool's group delete (room_fixture.dart:663-668).
DraftCommand deleteObject(DraftDocument doc, Handle g) => CompoundCommand([
      for (final k in kids(doc, g))
        if (kindOf(doc, k) != EntityKind.fill) RemoveEntityCommand(k),
      RemoveNodeCommand(g),
    ], label: 'Delete');

String enc(DraftDocument doc) => DraftDocumentCodec.encodeToString(doc);

/// `drift()` of [doc] under the kit's types (wall_fixture.dart's `driftOf`)
/// through the rig's [kitCatalog].
List<Handle> driftOf(DraftDocument doc) =>
    ParametricSystem(doc, kitCatalog()).drift();

/// A saved plan with what [add] adds to a copy of [saved] that has no
/// parametric system (room_fixture.dart's `staleFile`): the commands land
/// as given and nothing is generated, as a file written by another program.
String stalePlan(String saved, void Function(DraftDocument bare) add) {
  final bare = decodePlan(saved,
      register: (r) {
        PageComponent.register(r);
        registerKitComponents(r);
        kitCatalog().registerComponents(r);
      },
      diagnostics: <Diagnostic>[]);
  add(bare);
  return encodePlan(bare, validateKitSet([architectureKit]));
}

/// [c]'s editor in a 1440 x 900 window, one frame: the rig's [pumpEditor].
Future<void> pumpPlan(WidgetTester tester, PlanController c,
        {Locale locale = const Locale('en')}) =>
    pumpEditor(tester, c, locale: locale);

/// [hs] as the design's selection, one frame.
Future<void> select(
    WidgetTester tester, PlanController c, List<Handle> hs) async {
  c.activeSelection.replace([for (final h in hs) SelectionKey.root(h)]);
  await tester.pump();
}

Finder byKey(String k) => find.byKey(Key(k));
```

Function(T value, PlanObject object)` and `PlanObject { document; handle; world; }` (the 3a plan, "Shared interfaces", `properties.dart` block). Spec C3.6 needs the axes line "degrees with `KitWords.decimalSeparator`" and End 1, End 2 "`text:architecture.endOnWall` with the start or end word and the side word, or the fixed word"; spec C1.6 says `KitWords.decimalSeparator` exists so "a kit formats a number in the UI language (the axes line)". Today the panel reads its own strings for both (`jet_cad_floor_plan/lib/src/selection_panel.dart:907-931`, `_strings.axesTurned`, `_strings.endOnWall`, `_strings.decimalSeparator`). Neither `read`'s arguments nor `PlanType.fieldsOf(DraftDocument, Handle)` carry a `KitWords`, and a `PlanType` is a static value (`architectureKit` is built once, `plan_type.dart:34-48`), so no closure can capture the plan's words either. **Proposed fix** (what Steps 2, 3 and 5 are written against): `PlanObject` gains `KitWords get words;` (the owning kit's words at the plan's current locale: `PlanServices.words`), `DocumentPlanObject(this.document, this.handle, this.words)`, and `PlanType.fieldsOf(DraftDocument document, Handle group, {required KitWords words})` and `commitField(DraftDocument document, Handle group, PropertyField field, Object? input, {required KitWords words})` build it; the plan's panel passes `c.servicesOf(kit).words`, as it already does to `sectionFor` (`plan_property_panel.dart:836-845`). A language switch then re-words the lines at the panel's next build (the panel rebuilds on `reportLocale`). Alternative: a third `read` argument, `String? Function(T value, PlanObject object, KitWords words)`, with the same `fieldsOf`/`commitField` change. Either way Task 2 owns the change; this task's `object.words` (three uses) and its test helper `fieldsOf(..., words:)` follow the controller's choice.

```dart
/// A ToolContext over [doc] at 0.3 px/mm (aperture 33.3 mm), F3 on, the
/// document's page (TL's `dimRig`, dimension_tool_test.dart:50-80).
ToolContext contextOf(DraftDocument doc) {
  final index = SpatialIndex(doc);
  final camera = CameraController(
      ViewportTransform(worldToScreenMatrix: Transform2.scale(0.3, 0.3)));
  final selection = SelectionController(doc);
  final snap = SnapSettings();
  final page = PageNotifier(doc);
  addTearDown(() {
    page.dispose();
    snap.dispose();
    selection.dispose();
    camera.dispose();
    index.dispose();
  });
  return ToolContext(
      document: doc,
      index: index,
      camera: camera,
      selection: selection,
      page: page,
      snap: snap);
}

ToolPointerEvent eventAt(Vector2 world, {int buttons = 0}) =>
    ToolPointerEvent(
        screen: Offset.zero,
        world: world,
        pointer: 1,
        buttons: buttons,
        shift: false,
        control: false,
        meta: false,
        alt: false,
        pickRadiusWorld: 1);

void hover(Tool tool, ToolContext ctx, Vector2 w) =>
    tool.onPointerMove(eventAt(w), ctx);

void click(Tool tool, ToolContext ctx, Vector2 w) {
  hover(tool, ctx, w);
  tool.onPointerDown(eventAt(w, buttons: kPrimaryButton), ctx);
}

/// C2's L at the corpus far origin in own groups; a 1:50 page in metres,
/// no grid snap.
Plan lPlan() {
  final plan = buildPlan(c2Walls, place: corpusGroups);
  attachPage(plan.doc, PageComponent(snapToGrid: false));
  return plan;
}

List<Handle> dimsOf(DraftDocument doc) =>
    doc.components.withComponent<DimensionParams>().toList();
```

```dart
/// The sample plan's nine walls, in its order E1-E4, P1-P5, the flat's outer
/// corner at (12000, 8000) (room_fixture.dart:360-376).
List<W> sampleWalls() { /* copy room_fixture.dart:361-373 (the consts and the return) unchanged */ }

/// The sample's fifteen openings, indexing [sampleWalls]
/// (room_fixture.dart:378-394).
const List<O> sampleOpenings = [ /* copy :379-393 unchanged */ ];

/// The Living | Dining separator (room_fixture.dart:398).
const S sampleSeparator = (21500.0, 11560.0, 21500.0, 16750.0);

/// The column, the sample's tenth wall (room_fixture.dart:402).
const W sampleColumn = W(23500, 14000, 23900, 14000, 400);

/// The sample's room seeds, plan coordinates (room_fixture.dart:405-413).
const Map<String, (double, double)> sampleSeeds = { /* copy :406-412 unchanged */ };

/// A room at world [seed] named [name], a root group at the identity and
/// its parameters, one command (room_fixture.dart:567-580, without a label
/// offset or a group transform).
Handle addRoom(DraftDocument doc, Vector2 seed, String name) {
  final h = doc.handleSeed.next();
  doc.commands.execute(CompoundCommand([
    AddNodeCommand(GroupNode(
        handle: h,
        parent: doc.rootHandle,
        transform: Transform2.identity(),
        children: const [])),
    SetComponentCommand<RoomParams>(h, RoomParams(seed.x, seed.y, name)),
  ], label: 'Add room'));
  return h;
}

/// Every live dimension of [doc], ascending (today's `liveObjectsOf`,
/// asked of the kit's types).
List<Handle> dims(DraftDocument doc) => [
      for (final h in doc.components.withComponent<DimensionParams>())
        if (kitCatalog().typeIdOf(doc, h) == ArchitectureTypes.dimension) h,
    ];

/// The active tool's notice in words, or null (spec C1.2).
String? noticeText(PlanController c) {
  final notice = c.toolNotice.value;
  return notice == null ? null : c.textOf(notice);
}

/// [c]'s camera at [pxPerMm], centred on world [at] (y down, as today's
/// `centreOn`, dimension_tool_test.dart:162-171).
Future<void> centreOn(
    WidgetTester tester, PlanController c, Vector2 at, double pxPerMm) async {
  final size = tester.getSize(find.byType(InteractionLayer));
  c.camera.value = ViewportTransform(
      worldToScreenMatrix: Transform2.translation(
              size.width / 2 - pxPerMm * at.x, size.height / 2 - pxPerMm * at.y)
          .multiply(Transform2.scale(pxPerMm, pxPerMm)));
  await tester.pump();
}

/// A primary tap at world [p] on [c]'s canvas.
Future<void> tapWorld(WidgetTester tester, PlanController c, Vector2 p) async {
  final s = c.camera.value.worldToScreen(p);
  await tester.tapAt(
      tester.getTopLeft(find.byType(InteractionLayer)) + Offset(s.x, s.y));
  await tester.pump();
}

/// Plan vector ([x], [y]) turned by [place]'s rotation
/// (dimension_tool_test.dart:119-124).
Vector2 turnedBy(Placement place, double x, double y) {
  final rad = place.deg * math.pi / 180;
  return Vector2(x * math.cos(rad) - y * math.sin(rad),
      x * math.sin(rad) + y * math.cos(rad));
}
```

  (The three `/* copy … */` bodies are copied from the named lines byte for byte; the comments are instructions, not code.)

- [ ] **Step 2: The test support.** Create `packages/jet_cad_2d_kit_architecture/test/support/place_entry.dart`:

```dart
// A library entry placed by the engine's commands (3a Task 23). The plan
// library's placer (jet_cad_2d_plan/lib/src/symbols/symbol_placer.dart:
// 103-219, `definitionForEntry` and `placeSymbol`) is not exported, and a
// kit's tests may not import the plan library (tool/ci/check_kit_deps.dart),
// so the kit's tests place through this copy of its path for a placement
// without a unit label: the definition copied on first use (reused by key and
// version afterwards), then a root-level instance on the drawing layer under
// the contract's `placementTransform`, or under [transform] when given (an
// attachment's). The leaf-equality check of the plan's reuse is not copied:
// a test document holds only copies this helper made.
import 'package:jet_cad_2d/jet_cad_2d.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit/jet_cad_2d_kit.dart';
import 'package:vector_math/vector_math_64.dart' show Vector2;

/// The definition of [doc] that copies [entry] (same key and version), or
/// null.
Handle? copyOfEntry(DraftDocument doc, SymbolEntry entry) {
  for (final h in doc.components.withComponent<SymbolComponent>()) {
    final c = doc.components.get<SymbolComponent>(h);
    if (c != null &&
        c.key == entry.symbol.key &&
        c.version == entry.symbol.version &&
        doc.tree.definition(h) != null) {
      return h;
    }
  }
  return null;
}

/// The command that places [entry] in [doc] at [at] ([quarterTurns]
/// counter-clockwise, [mirrored]), or under [transform] when given; one
/// compound labelled `Place <name>`, every handle allocated here, in the
/// placer's order (the definition, its leaves, the instance). [doc] must
/// have the contract's components registered.
CompoundCommand placeEntry(
  DraftDocument doc,
  SymbolEntry entry, {
  required Vector2 at,
  int quarterTurns = 0,
  bool mirrored = false,
  Transform2? transform,
}) {
  final commands = <DraftCommand>[];
  var definition = copyOfEntry(doc, entry);
  if (definition == null) {
    final copy = doc.handleSeed.next();
    commands
      ..add(AddDefinitionCommand(Definition(
        handle: copy,
        name: entry.id,
        basePoint: entry.definition.basePoint,
        children: const [],
      )))
      ..add(SetComponentCommand<SymbolComponent>(copy, entry.symbol));
    final unit = entry.unit;
    if (unit != null) {
      commands.add(SetComponentCommand<UnitComponent>(copy, unit));
    }
    for (final leaf in entry.leaves) {
      commands.add(AddEntityCommand(
        record:
            leaf.record.copyWith(handle: doc.handleSeed.next(), owner: copy),
        payload: leaf.payload,
      ));
    }
    definition = copy;
  }
  commands.add(AddNodeCommand(InstanceNode(
    handle: doc.handleSeed.next(),
    parent: doc.rootHandle,
    definition: definition,
    layer: drawingLayer(doc),
    transform: transform ??
        placementTransform(
          at: at,
          basePoint: entry.definition.basePoint,
          quarterTurns: quarterTurns,
          mirrored: mirrored,
        ),
  )));
  return CompoundCommand(commands, label: 'Place ${entry.symbol.name}');
}
```

```dart
    const today = [
      'dining.table.square.two',
      'dining.table.square.four',
      'dining.table.rect.four',
      'dining.table.rect.six',
      'dining.table.round',
      'dining.chair',
      'dining.bench',
      'kitchen.base.300',
      'kitchen.base.400',
      'kitchen.base.600',
      'kitchen.base.800',
      'kitchen.sink',
      'kitchen.hob',
      'kitchen.fridge',
      'kitchen.dishwasher',
      'kitchen.washer',
      'kitchen.island',
      'bed.double.1400',
      'bed.double',
      'bed.double.1800',
      'bed.single.800',
      'bed.single',
      'bed.single.1000',
      'bed.nightstand',
      'bed.wardrobe.1200',
      'bed.wardrobe',
      'bed.wardrobe.2400',
      'sofa.two',
      'sofa.three',
      'armchair',
      'table.coffee',
      'tv.unit',
      'bath.toilet',
      'bath.washbasin',
      'bath.tub',
      'bath.shower',
      'office.desk.1200',
      'office.desk',
      'office.desk.1600',
      'office.chair',
      'office.bookshelf',
    ];

    test(
        'FU-keys every id is `architecture.` and today\'s key at version 1, '
        'in today\'s order; armchair, one segment today, is '
        'architecture.armchair.single', () {
      expect(today, hasLength(41));
      expect([for (final e in assetLibrary().entries) e.symbol.id], [
        for (final k in today)
          k == 'armchair'
              ? 'architecture.armchair.single@1'
              : 'architecture.$k@1',
      ]);
    });

    test(
        'FU-tags tags are search words only: no against-wall tag, no family: '
        'tag; every attachTo is empty or exactly [wall-face]', () {
      for (final e in assetLibrary().entries) {
        final why = e.symbol.key;
        expect(e.symbol.tags, isNot(contains('against-wall')), reason: why);
        expect(e.symbol.tags.where((t) => t.startsWith('family:')), isEmpty,
            reason: why);
        expect(e.symbol.attachTo, anyOf(isEmpty, equals(const ['wall-face'])),
            reason: why);
      }
    });

    test(
        'FU-plain-tables no symbol carries a unit, in the catalog or the '
        'file; the five dining tables are plain symbols at version 1 '
        '(decision 3)', () {
      final lib = assetLibrary();
      expect([
        for (final e in lib.entries)
          if (e.unit != null) e.symbol.key,
      ], isEmpty);
      expect([
        for (final s in furnitureCatalog.symbols)
          if (s.unit != null) s.key,
      ], isEmpty);
      for (final key in const [
        'architecture.dining.table.square.two',
        'architecture.dining.table.square.four',
        'architecture.dining.table.rect.four',
        'architecture.dining.table.rect.six',
        'architecture.dining.table.round',
      ]) {
        final e = lib.entries.firstWhere((e) => e.symbol.key == key);
        expect((e.symbol.version, e.unit), (1, null), reason: key);
      }
    });
  });
```

- [ ] **Step 4: The ported asset test.** Create `packages/jet_cad_2d_kit_architecture/test/furniture/package_assets_test.dart`. PA2 and PA3 are the source's (`jet_cad_floor_plan/test/package_assets_test.dart:47-63`), **assertions unchanged**; adaptations: the key written out is the kit's, `readBundledLibrary(bundle)` → `furnitureReader(bundle: bundle)()`, the decode is the contract's. `_MapBundle` and `_file` are copied unchanged (:14-29).

```dart
// 3a Task 23 (spec C4; D-15), ported from jet_cad_floor_plan/test/
// package_assets_test.dart PA2, PA3 (spec 14 V-10): the kit's library is read
// under its package key, so a host app finds it; an app key fails. PA1's
// counterpart for the kit's key is FU-asset-key. PA4 (the export font) is
// sub-project 4's.
import 'dart:io';

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart' show FlutterError;
import 'package:flutter/services.dart';
import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit/jet_cad_2d_kit.dart' show SymbolLibrary;
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit_architecture/src/furniture/furniture_source.dart';

/// A bundle that serves fixed bytes under the keys it holds, and nothing
/// else.
class _MapBundle extends CachingAssetBundle {
  _MapBundle(this.assets);

  final Map<String, Uint8List> assets;

  @override
  Future<ByteData> load(String key) async {
    final bytes = assets[key];
    if (bytes == null) throw FlutterError('no asset $key');
    return ByteData.sublistView(bytes);
  }
}

Uint8List _file(String path) => File(path).readAsBytesSync();

void main() {
  group('V-10 the asset key is the package\'s', () {
    // Written out, not read from the constant: a key that drifted to an
    // app's `assets/...` must turn these red.
    const libraryKey =
        'packages/jet_cad_2d_kit_architecture/assets/library/furniture.jetlib';

    test('FU-asset-key the constant names the package key', () {
      expect(kFurnitureAsset, libraryKey);
    });

    test(
        'PA2 the furniture library loads from a bundle holding only the '
        'package key', () async {
      final bytes = _file('assets/library/furniture.jetlib');
      final read =
          await furnitureReader(bundle: _MapBundle({libraryKey: bytes}))();
      expect(read, orderedEquals(bytes));
      expect(SymbolLibrary.decode(read).entries, isNotEmpty);
    });

    test('PA3 a bundle holding only the app\'s old key fails the read',
        () async {
      final bytes = _file('assets/library/furniture.jetlib');
      await expectLater(
          furnitureReader(
              bundle: _MapBundle({'assets/library/furniture.jetlib': bytes}))(),
          throwsA(isA<FlutterError>()));
    });
  });
}
```

- [ ] **Step 6: The catalog.** Create `packages/jet_cad_2d_kit_architecture/lib/src/furniture/furniture_catalog.dart` (new code; the geometry is `jet_cad_floor_plan/lib/src/symbols/furniture_catalog.dart:102-675`, each shape mapped as the plan decision says):

```dart
// The architecture kit's furniture (spec 3a C4): today's 41 symbols
// (jet_cad_floor_plan/lib/src/symbols/furniture_catalog.dart), rewritten in
// the authoring language, each in millimetres in a corner-origin local frame
// (x to the right, y up the plan, the front of the piece on y = 0), its base
// point off the origin.
//
// - Keys: `architecture.` and today's key, at version 1 (umbrella decision
//   9: no plan of jet_cad_floor_plan is read, so versions restart);
//   `armchair`, one segment, is `architecture.armchair.single`.
// - Behaviour is fields (umbrella A5): the 30 symbols of 09c D9's
//   against-the-wall set attach to `wall-face`; the six size families are
//   `family` fields; tags are search words only.
// - The dining tables are plain symbols (decision 3): no unit.
// - Every symbol's leaves are today's, in today's order and vertex order: a
//   chair is today's `_chair` (a `rect` and its back line), not `chairAt`.
//
// Pure Dart: no Flutter, no dart:io (the generator runs it under `dart run`).
import 'dart:math' as math;

import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit/authoring.dart';

const double _pi = math.pi;

const String _dining = 'Dining Room';
const String _kitchen = 'Kitchen';
const String _bedRoom = 'Bed Room';
const String _livingRoom = 'Living Room';
const String _bathroom = 'Bathroom';
const String _office = 'Office';

/// The one attachment kind the kit's symbols name (spec C5).
const List<String> _wallFace = ['wall-face'];

/// Which side of the table a chair sits on; the chair's back is on the far
/// side from the table.
enum _Side { bottom, top, left, right }

/// Today's seat depth beyond the table edge: 450 − 100 = 350.
const double _chairReach = chairSize - chairTuck;

CatalogLine _line(double x1, double y1, double x2, double y2) =>
    CatalogLine((x1, y1), (x2, y2));

/// One chair: a closed 450 x 450 seat outline from (x, y) and a thin back
/// line 60 mm in from the outer edge, on the side away from the table.
List<CatalogShape> _chair(double x, double y, _Side back) => [
      rect(x, y, chairSize, chairSize),
      switch (back) {
        _Side.bottom => _line(x, y + 60, x + chairSize, y + 60),
        _Side.top => _line(
            x, y + chairSize - 60, x + chairSize, y + chairSize - 60),
        _Side.left => _line(x + 60, y, x + 60, y + chairSize),
        _Side.right => _line(
            x + chairSize - 60, y, x + chairSize - 60, y + chairSize),
      },
    ];

/// A [tw] x [th] table with its chairs, its lower-left corner at ([ox],
/// [oy]); [chairs] are (side, centre along that side) pairs. The base point
/// is the table centre. Leaves: table outline, table inset, then each chair
/// (outline, back line). A plain symbol (decision 3).
CatalogSymbol _diningSet(String key, String name, double tw, double th,
    double ox, double oy, List<String> tags, List<(_Side, double)> chairs) {
  final shapes = <CatalogShape>[
    rect(ox, oy, tw, th),
    rect(ox + 50, oy + 50, tw - 100, th - 100),
  ];
  for (final (side, c) in chairs) {
    const h = chairSize / 2;
    switch (side) {
      case _Side.bottom:
        shapes.addAll(_chair(ox + c - h, oy - _chairReach, side));
      case _Side.top:
        shapes.addAll(_chair(ox + c - h, oy + th - chairTuck, side));
      case _Side.left:
        shapes.addAll(_chair(ox - _chairReach, oy + c - h, side));
      case _Side.right:
        shapes.addAll(_chair(ox + tw - chairTuck, oy + c - h, side));
    }
  }
  return CatalogSymbol(
    key: key,
    name: name,
    category: _dining,
    tags: tags,
    base: (ox + tw / 2, oy + th / 2),
    shapes: shapes,
  );
}

// The size families (spec 09c D9): each member is its family's drawing at
// another width, the depth, the front (y = 0) and the back the same, the
// base point on the box's centre x.

/// A double bed [w] x 2000: outline, two pillows 240 deep with 100 mm
/// margins and gap, the fold line at 1300. Base point: the centre.
CatalogSymbol _doubleBed(String key, String name, double w) {
  final pillow = (w - 300) / 2;
  return CatalogSymbol(
    key: key,
    name: name,
    category: _bedRoom,
    tags: const ['bed', 'double', 'sleeping'],
    attachTo: _wallFace,
    family: 'bed-double',
    base: (w / 2, 1000),
    shapes: [
      rect(0, 0, w, 2000),
      rect(100, 1680, pillow, 240),
      rect(200 + pillow, 1680, pillow, 240),
      _line(0, 1300, w, 1300),
    ],
  );
}

/// A single bed [w] x 2000: outline, one pillow 240 deep with 120 mm
/// margins, the fold line at 1300. Base point: the centre.
CatalogSymbol _singleBed(String key, String name, double w) => CatalogSymbol(
      key: key,
      name: name,
      category: _bedRoom,
      tags: const ['bed', 'single', 'sleeping'],
      attachTo: _wallFace,
      family: 'bed-single',
      base: (w / 2, 1000),
      shapes: [
        rect(0, 0, w, 2000),
        rect(120, 1680, w - 240, 240),
        _line(0, 1300, w, 1300),
      ],
    );

/// A wardrobe [w] x 600 of 600 mm doors: outline, the door line at y = 40,
/// a line between each pair of doors, the handles either side of the first.
/// Base point: the front centre.
CatalogSymbol _wardrobe(String key, String name, double w) => CatalogSymbol(
      key: key,
      name: name,
      category: _bedRoom,
      tags: const ['wardrobe', 'storage', 'closet'],
      attachTo: _wallFace,
      family: 'wardrobe',
      base: (w / 2, 0),
      shapes: [
        rect(0, 0, w, 600),
        _line(0, 40, w, 40),
        for (var x = 600.0; x < w; x += 600) _line(x, 40, x, 600),
        _line(560, 40, 560, 160),
        _line(640, 40, 640, 160),
      ],
    );

/// A kitchen base unit [w] x 600: outline, the front line at y = 40, the
/// knob at the front centre. Base point: the front centre.
CatalogSymbol _baseUnit(String key, String name, double w) => CatalogSymbol(
      key: key,
      name: name,
      category: _kitchen,
      tags: const ['base unit', 'cabinet', 'cupboard'],
      attachTo: _wallFace,
      family: 'kitchen-base',
      base: (w / 2, 0),
      shapes: [
        rect(0, 0, w, 600),
        _line(0, 40, w, 40),
        CatalogCircle((w / 2, 20), 10),
      ],
    );

/// A desk [w] x 700: outline, a 400 mm drawer block at the right with two
/// drawer lines. Base point: the front centre.
CatalogSymbol _desk(String key, String name, double w) => CatalogSymbol(
      key: key,
      name: name,
      category: _office,
      tags: const ['desk', 'office', 'table'],
      attachTo: _wallFace,
      family: 'desk',
      base: (w / 2, 0),
      shapes: [
        rect(0, 0, w, 700),
        _line(w - 400, 0, w - 400, 700),
        _line(w - 400, 230, w, 230),
        _line(w - 400, 460, w, 460),
      ],
    );

/// The catalog, in the order the library stores it: definition handles and
/// leaf handles ascend in this order (today's order).
final Catalog furnitureCatalog = Catalog(kit: 'architecture', symbols: [
  // Dining Room
  _diningSet(
```

```dart
// The furniture library as the kit's symbol source (spec 3a C4, contract
// K5): the package's asset, read under its `packages/` key so a host app
// finds it (today's kFurnitureLibraryAsset and readBundledLibrary,
// jet_cad_floor_plan/lib/src/symbols/symbol_library_loader.dart:17-26).
import 'dart:typed_data';

import 'package:flutter/services.dart' show AssetBundle;
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit/jet_cad_2d_kit.dart'
    show SymbolLibrarySource, bundledLibrary;

/// The library's asset key: the package's, never an app's.
const String kFurnitureAsset =
    'packages/jet_cad_2d_kit_architecture/assets/library/furniture.jetlib';

/// The reader of [kFurnitureAsset] in [bundle] (`rootBundle` when null),
/// resolved each time it runs.
Future<Uint8List> Function() furnitureReader({AssetBundle? bundle}) =>
    bundledLibrary(kFurnitureAsset, bundle: bundle);

/// The kit's one symbol source: [furnitureReader] over `rootBundle`.
final SymbolLibrarySource furnitureSource =
    SymbolLibrarySource(label: 'furniture', read: furnitureReader());
```

- [ ] **Step 9: The generator.** Create `packages/jet_cad_2d_kit_architecture/tool/generate_furniture_library.dart`:

```dart
// Writes the architecture kit's furniture library from its catalog and adds
// the geometry snapshot's entries of new key@Ns, never rewriting one (spec
// 3a C4, contract K7).
//
// Run from the package directory, under plain Dart (no Flutter):
//   dart run tool/generate_furniture_library.dart
import 'dart:io';

import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit/authoring.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit_architecture/src/furniture/furniture_catalog.dart';

void main() {
  final library = File('assets/library/furniture.jetlib');
  final bytes = encodeLibrary(furnitureCatalog);
  library.parent.createSync(recursive: true);
  library.writeAsBytesSync(bytes);
  final snapshot = File('assets/library/furniture.snapshot.json');
  final committed = snapshot.existsSync()
      ? parseSnapshot(snapshot.readAsStringSync())
      : <String, String>{};
  snapshot.writeAsStringSync(encodeSnapshot(
      updateSnapshot(committed, geometrySnapshot(furnitureCatalog))));
  stdout.writeln('wrote ${library.path}: ${bytes.length} bytes, '
      '${furnitureCatalog.symbols.length} symbols');
}
```

  Run it: `cd packages/jet_cad_2d_kit_architecture && dart run tool/generate_furniture_library.dart`. Expected: `wrote assets/library/furniture.jetlib: <n> bytes, 41 symbols` (quote `<n>`). If `dart run` asks for a resolution, run `flutter pub get` from the repository root, then `git status --short` and `git checkout --` any `analysis_options.yaml` it rewrote, and run the generator again. Run it a second time: `git status --short packages/jet_cad_2d_kit_architecture/assets` must show the same two new files and `git diff --stat` nothing more (the generator is deterministic and the snapshot only grows).

#### Interface problem

**(Resolved by rulings R-P1 and R-P3: such a case runs in the kit over `test/support/place_entry.dart`.)** `placeSymbol` cannot be called where spec C7 puts the cases that use it. C7 sends a case naming `placeSymbol` to `jet_cad_2d_integration`, but that package may import the public libraries only (`implementation_imports`, Global Constraints), and the plan library exports no placer (`packages/jet_cad_2d_plan/lib/jet_cad_2d_plan.dart`: no `symbols/symbol_placer.dart` export; `placeSymbol` is `lib/src/symbols/symbol_placer.dart:169`). The cases affected: this task's "every symbol placed" and "plausible size" groups; D-13 (`symbol_box_test.dart:321-339, 391-410`); and D-01's `wall_attach_test` and `wall_attach_property_test`, which also name the kit's internals (`attachToWall`, `FaceRun`, `WallBands`, `WallFaces`: `jet_cad_floor_plan/test/symbols/wall_attach_test.dart:13-19, 119, 358-374`), unreachable from the integration package too. Proposed fix (taken here for this task's cases): such a case runs **in the kit** and places through `test/support/place_entry.dart` (the placer's no-unit path over the engine's commands and the contract's `placementTransform`), its assertions unchanged; Task 28 ports D-01's two files and D-13's three cases the same way. The alternative (exporting `placeSymbol` from the plan library) widens the plan's public surface, which spec 2a fixed; it is the human's call, not a task's.

#### New shared name

- `packages/jet_cad_2d_kit_architecture/test/support/place_entry.dart`: `CompoundCommand placeEntry(DraftDocument doc, SymbolEntry entry, {required Vector2 at, int quarterTurns = 0, bool mirrored = false, Transform2? transform})` and `Handle? copyOfEntry(DraftDocument doc, SymbolEntry entry)`. Used by Task 24's provider tests and, by the problem above, Task 28's D-01 and D-13 ports.

**Appendix A rows closed:**
- **D-01**, its kit part: `jet_cad_floor_plan/test/symbols/wall_faces_test.dart` WF1-WF9, all nine in the kit. `wall_attach_test.dart` (23) and `wall_attach_property_test.dart` (2) are Task 28's by the spec's assignment, and `symbol_move_test.dart` (6) too (`PlanMoveResolver`); see "Interface problem" for where the first two can lawfully run.
- **D-06** `WallFaces` compares `document.commands.stateId` (WF-state).
- **D-07** today's capture and keep distance, one capture whether or not the query keeps an earlier answer (WF-hysteresis); the plan test kit's inverted hysteresis is not copied.
- **D-08** the provider fits `AttachmentProvider` (kind `wall-face`); under `mayRotate: false` only a face the symbol already faces, its linear part kept bit for bit (WF-keep).
- C5's layer rule, the kit half of D-04's SS17: a wall on a hidden or locked layer offers no face (WF-hidden). C1.5's "a frozen wall is absent from the wall faces" (WF-frozen).

**Plan decisions:**
- **Today's oracle, unchanged.** `attachToWall` keeps its signature and code (09c D4: face pick, hold check, rotation, centre, edge snap to run ends and neighbours, clamp; F-7's `keep`). The provider maps the query onto it:
  - the footprint is the box: `left = minX`, `right = maxX`, `front = minY`, `back = maxY` (the inverse of `footprintOf`, `jet_cad_2d_plan/lib/src/symbols/symbol_box.dart:166-170`);
  - `pointer`, `capture` and `edgeCapture` as given: the plan passes today's 16 px and the snap aperture over the scale (`jet_cad_2d_plan/lib/src/tools/plan_symbol_tool.dart:254-264`, `move_resolver.dart:80-91`), today's `kWallAttachPixels` and `kSnapAperturePixels` (`jet_cad_floor_plan/lib/src/symbols/symbol_place_tool.dart:298-302`, `symbol_move.dart:54-58`);
  - **F-7** (D-08): `keep: query.mayRotate ? null : query.current`. Today's placement passed the unturned linear part (identity or the mirror, `symbol_place_tool.dart:295-297`) and the move passed `delta · T` (`symbol_move.dart:58`); the plan's `current` is exactly those (the placement's turns are 0 while rotation is refused, `plan_symbol_tool.dart:192`; the move's `current` is `delta · T`, `move_resolver.dart:84`). `attachToWall` reads only the linear part of `keep`;
  - **the query's `keep`** (the previous answer) is not read: today's attachment has one capture, kept or not (D-07). WF-hysteresis pins it;
  - `exclude`: the plan passes none or the one moved node (`move_resolver.dart:89`); `attachToWall` takes one handle. A query excluding more than one object attaches nowhere (the safe answer; no caller asks it) (WF-exclude);
  - the answer: `Attachment(transform, marker: q, token: run)`;
  - an empty footprint attaches nowhere.
- **The cache** (`WallFaces`, spec C2 "Shared caches"): one per kit and document through `PlanServices.shared`, over the shared `WallBands` and the kit's `LiveTypeOf`, with today's `isUsableHost` as the host predicate. **D-06:** today the placement tool invalidated the bands after each placement (`symbol_place_tool.dart:500`); `plan.symbol` and `plan.select` are plan tools and cannot. So `_refresh` also keeps the document's `commands.stateId`: when it moved since the last build, it invalidates the bands (their next scan rebuilds, as after today's placement) and rebuilds the runs, the neighbours and the boxes, before the document's `changes` stream reports the change. Today's WA9 (`wall_attach_test.dart:544-610`, Task 28's port) still counts one build per change: a delivered change and a moved state each lead to one rebuild on the next query.
- **Liveness** (C1.5): `faceRunsOf` gains the `LiveTypeOf` its `wallsInDocument` call needs (Task 13); `WallFaces` holds the one it was made with. A frozen wall is then absent from the faces exactly as it is from `generate`.
- **Layers** (C5): a wall whose object layer is hidden or locked offers no face (`accept: isUsableHost`, today's `planner_shell.dart:492`).
- **The source joins the kit here** with the provider (Task 23's plan decision): no state of the branch loads a symbol naming `wall-face` while no provider offers it (WF-offered).
- **Placement of the 09c tests** (C7). `wall_faces_test` uses `faceRunsOf` and the wall geometry only: kit. Its fixture (`jet_cad_floor_plan/test/support/wall_attach_fixture.dart`, 163 lines) is ported here because WF1-WF9 need it; Task 28 reuses it.

```dart
// 3a Task 24 (spec C5, C2 "Shared caches", C1.5; D-06, D-07, D-08): the
// wall-face provider over FakePlanServices. Every scene is the 09c fixture's:
// walls in their own rotated groups near (1e5, −7e4), never at the identity.
// The oracle is today's attachToWall over the same runs; the expected points
// are the run's own frame, a + t·u + m·s.
import 'dart:io';

import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d/jet_cad_2d.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit/jet_cad_2d_kit.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit/testing.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit_architecture/jet_cad_2d_kit_architecture.dart'
    show ArchitectureTypes;
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit_architecture/src/attach/wall_attach.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit_architecture/src/attach/wall_face_provider.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit_architecture/src/opening/opening_tool.dart'
    show isUsableHost;
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit_architecture/src/wall/wall.dart';
import 'package:vector_math/vector_math_64.dart' show Vector2;

import '../support/place_entry.dart';
import '../support/wall_attach_fixture.dart';

/// 16 px and 6 px at 0.1 px/mm: today's capture and edge snap in world.
const double capture = 160, edge = 60;

/// An off-origin box, its front not its back: x 120..1320, y 40..640.
const SymbolBox box = SymbolBox(left: 120, right: 1320, front: 40, back: 640);

/// The point `u` along [r] and `s` into the room from its face.
Vector2 at(FaceRun r, double u, double s) => r.a + r.t * u + r.m * s;

AttachmentQuery query(Aabb2 footprint, Vector2 p,
        {bool mirrored = false,
        bool mayRotate = true,
        Transform2? current,
        Set<Handle> exclude = const {},
        Attachment? keep}) =>
    AttachmentQuery(
      footprint: footprint,
      current: current ?? Transform2.identity(),
      pointer: p,
      capture: capture,
      edgeCapture: edge,
      mirrored: mirrored,
      mayRotate: mayRotate,
      exclude: exclude,
      keep: keep,
    );

/// The kit's services over [doc], frozen [frozen], disposed at tear-down.
FakePlanServices servicesOf(DraftDocument doc,
    {Set<Handle> frozen = const {}}) {
  final s = FakePlanServices(
      document: doc, catalog: testCatalog(), frozen: frozen, scale: 0.1);
  addTearDown(s.dispose);
  return s;
}

List<double> linear(Transform2 g) => [g.a, g.b, g.c, g.d];
List<double> all(Transform2 g) => [g.a, g.b, g.c, g.d, g.e, g.f];

/// The committed library's [key].
SymbolEntry furniture(String key) =>
    SymbolLibrary.decode(
            File('assets/library/furniture.jetlib').readAsBytesSync())
        .entries
        .firstWhere((e) => e.symbol.key == key);

/// [doc]'s last root-level instance.
Handle lastInstance(DraftDocument doc) {
  final root = doc.tree[doc.tree.root]! as GroupNode;
  return [
    for (final h in doc.tree.childNodesOf(root.children))
      if (doc.tree[h] is InstanceNode) h,
  ].last;
}

void main() {
  test(
      'WF-query the provider is today\'s attachToWall over the document\'s '
      'faces: kind wall-face; the footprint read as the box (front minY, '
      'back maxY); the marker the face point q; the token the run; the '
      'back-centre on the marker; beyond the capture, nothing; a 30° wall '
      'in a turned group, mirrored and not', () {
    for (final mirrored in const [false, true]) {
      final why = mirrored ? 'mirrored' : 'plain';
      final sc = freeWallScene(30, Justification.left, mirrored: mirrored);
      final provider = wallFaceProvider(servicesOf(sc.doc));
      expect(provider.kind, 'wall-face');
      final runs = faceRunsOf(sc.doc, sc.walls.single, liveOf(sc.doc),
          accept: isUsableHost);
      expect(runs, hasLength(2), reason: why);
      for (final r in runs) {
        final p = at(r, 1500, 90);
        final want = attachToWall(runs, box, p, capture,
            mirrored: mirrored,
            neighbours: [for (final _ in runs) const <FaceNeighbour>[]],
            edgeCaptureWorld: edge)!;
        final got = provider.attach(
            query(footprintOf(box), p, mirrored: mirrored))!;
        final rw = '$why ${r.side.name}';
        expect(all(got.transform), all(want.transform), reason: rw);
        expect(got.marker, want.q, reason: rw);
        expect((got.token as FaceRun).side, r.side, reason: rw);
        expect(
            (got.transform.transformPoint(box.backCentre) - got.marker).length,
            lessThan(1e-6),
            reason: '$rw: the back edge on the face');
        expect(provider.attach(query(footprintOf(box), at(r, 1500, capture + 1),
                mirrored: mirrored)),
            isNull,
            reason: '$rw: beyond the capture');
      }
    }
  });

  test(
      'WF-keep (D-08) with mayRotate false the symbol attaches only to a '
      'face its current turn already faces and keeps its linear part bit '
      'for bit, mirrored or not; with mayRotate true, to either face', () {
    // A wall along world x in a turned group: one face looks −y (t = (1, 0),
    // the unturned symbol's), the other +y.
    final sc = freeWallScene(0, Justification.centre);
    final provider = wallFaceProvider(servicesOf(sc.doc));
    final runs = faceRunsOf(sc.doc, sc.walls.single, liveOf(sc.doc));
    expect([for (final r in runs) r.m.y.sign], unorderedEquals([1.0, -1.0]),
        reason: 'premise: one face looks −y, the other +y');
    for (final (mirrored, current) in [
      (false, Transform2.translation(37.5, -12.25)),
      (true, const Transform2(-1, 0, 0, 1, 410.5, 88.75)),
    ]) {
      for (final r in runs) {
        final p = at(r, 1800, 60);
        final why = '${mirrored ? 'mirrored' : 'plain'} m.y ${r.m.y.sign}';
        expect(provider.attach(query(footprintOf(box), p, mirrored: mirrored)),
            isNotNull,
            reason: '$why: free to turn');
        final kept = provider.attach(query(footprintOf(box), p,
            mirrored: mirrored, mayRotate: false, current: current));
        if (r.m.y < 0) {
          expect(kept, isNotNull, reason: '$why: the face it already faces');
          expect(linear(kept!.transform), linear(current), reason: why);
        } else {
          expect(kept, isNull, reason: '$why: a face it would turn to');
        }
      }
    }
  });

  test(
      'WF-hysteresis (D-07) one capture, kept or not: 130 mm from the face '
      '(13 px) attaches with and without the previous answer; 170 mm (17 '
      'px) attaches with neither', () {
    final sc = freeWallScene(30, Justification.centre);
    final provider = wallFaceProvider(servicesOf(sc.doc));
    final r = faceRunsOf(sc.doc, sc.walls.single, liveOf(sc.doc)).first;
    final first = provider.attach(query(footprintOf(box), at(r, 1500, 50)))!;
    final near = at(r, 1500, 130), far = at(r, 1500, 170);
    expect(provider.attach(query(footprintOf(box), near)), isNotNull);
    expect(provider.attach(query(footprintOf(box), near, keep: first)),
        isNotNull,
        reason: 'kept: the same capture, not a smaller one');
    expect(provider.attach(query(footprintOf(box), far)), isNull);
    expect(provider.attach(query(footprintOf(box), far, keep: first)), isNull,
        reason: 'kept: the same capture, not a larger one');
  });

  test(
      'WF-hidden (C5, SS17) a wall on a hidden layer and a wall on a locked '
      'layer offer no face; on a visible, unlocked layer they do', () {
    for (final (name, visible, locked, offers) in const [
      ('visible', true, false, true),
      ('hidden', false, false, false),
      ('locked', true, true, false),
    ]) {
      final sc = freeWallScene(30, Justification.right);
      final zero = sc.doc.tables.layers[ReservedHandles.layerZero]!;
      // The restore form: the record exactly, past the current-layer rule.
      sc.doc.commands.execute(SetLayerCommand.restore(
          zero.copyWith(visible: visible, locked: locked)));
      final provider = wallFaceProvider(servicesOf(sc.doc));
      final r = faceRunsOf(sc.doc, sc.walls.single, liveOf(sc.doc)).first;
      final got = provider.attach(query(footprintOf(box), at(r, 1500, 40)));
      expect(got != null, offers, reason: name);
    }
  });

  test(
      'WF-frozen (C1.5) a frozen wall offers no face, though the catalog '
      'still names its type', () {
    final sc = freeWallScene(-112.5, Justification.centre);
    final wall = sc.walls.single;
    final r = faceRunsOf(sc.doc, wall, liveOf(sc.doc)).first;
    final p = at(r, 1500, 40);
    final live = wallFaceProvider(servicesOf(sc.doc));
    expect(live.attach(query(footprintOf(box), p)), isNotNull);
    final s = servicesOf(sc.doc, frozen: {wall});
    expect(testCatalog().typeIdOf(sc.doc, wall), ArchitectureTypes.wall,
        reason: 'premise: the catalog answers a frozen object');
    expect(s.liveTypeIdOf(wall), isNull, reason: 'premise');
    expect(wallFaceProvider(s).attach(query(footprintOf(box), p)), isNull);
  });

  test(
      'WF-state (D-06) a symbol placed by a command is a neighbour at the '
      'next query, before the document\'s changes are delivered: the next '
      'unit snaps flush to it', () {
    final sc = freeWallScene(30, Justification.centre);
    final doc = sc.doc;
    if (!doc.components.isRegistered<SymbolComponent>()) {
      registerKitComponents(doc.components);
    }
    final provider = wallFaceProvider(servicesOf(doc));
    final unit = furniture('architecture.kitchen.base.600');
    final ubox = boxOfEntry(unit)!;
    final foot = footprintOf(ubox);
    final r = faceRunsOf(doc, sc.walls.single, liveOf(doc)).first;
    // The first unit, centred at u = 1200 (its sides 900 and 1500: no end
    // within the edge capture).
    final first = provider.attach(query(foot, at(r, 1200, 40)))!;
    expect((first.marker - at(r, 1200, 0)).length, lessThan(1e-6),
        reason: 'premise: no snap');
    doc.commands.execute(
        placeEntry(doc, unit, at: first.marker, transform: first.transform));
    // No pump: the changes stream has not delivered. The next unit's left
    // side comes 40 short of the first's right (1500): it snaps to 1500,
    // its centre to 1200 + 600.
    final next = provider.attach(query(foot, at(r, 1840, 40)))!;
    expect((next.marker - at(r, 1200 + ubox.width, 0)).length, lessThan(1e-6),
        reason: 'flush to the neighbour placed one command ago');
  });

  test(
      'WF-exclude the excluded instance is no neighbour; a query excluding '
      'two objects attaches nowhere', () {
    final sc = freeWallScene(30, Justification.centre);
    final doc = sc.doc;
    if (!doc.components.isRegistered<SymbolComponent>()) {
      registerKitComponents(doc.components);
    }
    final provider = wallFaceProvider(servicesOf(doc));
    final unit = furniture('architecture.kitchen.base.600');
    final foot = footprintOf(boxOfEntry(unit)!);
    final r = faceRunsOf(doc, sc.walls.single, liveOf(doc)).first;
    final first = provider.attach(query(foot, at(r, 1200, 40)))!;
    doc.commands.execute(
        placeEntry(doc, unit, at: first.marker, transform: first.transform));
    final neighbour = lastInstance(doc);
    final free =
        provider.attach(query(foot, at(r, 1840, 40), exclude: {neighbour}))!;
    expect((free.marker - at(r, 1840, 0)).length, lessThan(1e-6),
        reason: 'no snap to the excluded instance');
    expect(
        provider.attach(query(foot, at(r, 1840, 40),
            exclude: {neighbour, sc.walls.single})),
        isNull);
  });
}
```

```dart
/// The face runs of wall [wall] of [doc] (spec 09c D3) through the document
/// adapter ([wallsInDocument]: every other live wall can cut it). Empty when
/// [wall] is not a live wall by [live] (a frozen wall or a missing kit's is
/// not, spec C1.5), is degenerate, or [accept] refuses it (the kit passes
/// `isUsableHost`: a hidden or locked wall hosts nothing). [accept] is asked
/// only for a live wall.
List<FaceRun> faceRunsOf(DraftDocument doc, Handle wall, LiveTypeOf live,
    {bool Function(DraftDocument, Handle)? accept}) {
  final w = wallsInDocument(doc, wall, live);
  if (w == null) return const [];
  if (accept != null && !accept(doc, wall)) return const [];
  return faceRunsAmong(w.host, w.walls);
}
```

```dart
// The kit's cache of the wall faces a symbol stands against and of the
// symbols already against them (spec 09c D3, D4, S-8; 3a C2 "Shared
// caches", C5), ported from jet_cad_floor_plan/lib/src/symbols/
// wall_attach.dart:409-550 by 3a Task 24. One per kit and document
// (`PlanServices.shared`); besides the bands' generation it keeps the
// document's command state (D-06).
import 'package:jet_cad_2d/jet_cad_2d.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit/jet_cad_2d_kit.dart'
    show
        PlanServices,
        SymbolBox,
        SymbolComponent,
        boxOfDefinition,
        isOrthonormal;
import 'package:vector_math/vector_math_64.dart' show Vector2;

import '../live.dart';
import '../opening/opening_tool.dart' show isUsableHost;
import '../wall/wall.dart';
import '../wall/wall_bands.dart';
import 'wall_attach.dart';

/// The cache of the face runs and their neighbours (spec 09c D3, D4, S-8),
/// shared by every query of the wall-face provider for one document.
///
/// Built from [bands]' live walls (`WallBands.liveWalls`, which keeps
/// [WallBands.generation] current), the kit's reader [live], the host
/// predicate [accept] (the kit passes `isUsableHost`: a hidden or locked
/// wall hosts nothing) and the document. The runs, the neighbours and the
/// boxes of the document's definitions are rebuilt only when the document,
/// the bands' generation or the document's command state (`stateId`, D-06)
/// changes; a query over a cached set ([attach]) is O(runs) and allocates
/// O(1).
final class WallFaces {
  WallFaces(this.bands, this.live,
      {bool Function(DraftDocument, Handle)? accept})
      : _accept = accept;

  /// The kit's bands, shared with the Wall and Opening tools.
  final WallBands bands;

  /// Which objects are live walls (spec C1.5): a frozen wall has no face.
  final LiveTypeOf live;
  final bool Function(DraftDocument, Handle)? _accept;

  DraftDocument? _document;
  int _generation = 0;
  int _state = -1;
  List<FaceRun> _runs = const [];
  List<List<FaceNeighbour>> _neighbours = const [];
  final Map<Handle, SymbolBox?> _boxes = <Handle, SymbolBox?>{};
  int _builds = 0;

  /// How many times the runs and neighbours were rebuilt: once per
  /// document, bands generation and command state, never per query.
  int get builds => _builds;

  /// The face runs of [doc]'s accepted live walls, ascending by wall handle
  /// (each wall's left face's runs, then its right face's).
  List<FaceRun> runsOf(DraftDocument doc) {
    _refresh(doc);
    return _runs;
  }

  /// Parallel to [runsOf]: the neighbours (spec D4) standing against each
  /// run.
  List<List<FaceNeighbour>> neighboursOf(DraftDocument doc) {
    _refresh(doc);
    return _neighbours;
  }

  /// The local box of [doc]'s definition [definition], memoised until the
  /// next rebuild (spec D2: per definition handle, cleared on a document
  /// change); null when it does not attach.
  SymbolBox? boxOf(DraftDocument doc, Handle definition) {
    _refresh(doc);
    return _box(doc, definition);
  }

  /// [attachToWall] over [doc]'s cached runs and neighbours, [exclude]
  /// (the instance a move carries, D8) not a neighbour, keeping [keep]'s
  /// linear part when given (F-7).
  WallAttachment? attach(
    DraftDocument doc,
    SymbolBox box,
    Vector2 p,
    double captureWorld, {
    required bool mirrored,
    required double edgeCaptureWorld,
    Handle? exclude,
    Transform2? keep,
  }) {
    _refresh(doc);
    return attachToWall(_runs, box, p, captureWorld,
        mirrored: mirrored,
        neighbours: _neighbours,
        edgeCaptureWorld: edgeCaptureWorld,
        exclude: exclude,
        keep: keep);
  }

  SymbolBox? _box(DraftDocument doc, Handle definition) {
    if (_boxes.containsKey(definition)) return _boxes[definition];
    return _boxes[definition] = boxOfDefinition(doc, definition);
  }

  void _refresh(DraftDocument doc) {
    final state = doc.commands.stateId;
    // D-06: a command since the last build (a placement by plan.symbol, a
    // move by plan.select: plan tools, which cannot invalidate the bands as
    // today's placement tool did, symbol_place_tool.dart:500) makes the
    // walls, the neighbours and the boxes stale before the document's
    // changes stream reports it. Invalidate the bands as that tool did.
    if (identical(doc, _document) && state != _state) bands.invalidate();
    final walls = bands.liveWalls(doc);
    if (identical(doc, _document) && bands.generation == _generation) return;
    _document = doc;
    _generation = bands.generation;
    _state = state;
    _builds++;
    _boxes.clear();
    final runs = <FaceRun>[
      for (final h in walls) ...faceRunsOf(doc, h, live, accept: _accept),
    ];
    _runs = List.unmodifiable(runs);
    _neighbours = _neighboursAlong(doc, runs);
  }

  /// Spec D4's neighbours of each of [runs]: the root-level instances on a
  /// visible, unlocked layer (the picking rule, [QueryFilter.picking])
  /// whose definition carries a [SymbolComponent] and has a box, whose
  /// transform is orthonormal, whose transformed back edge has both ends on
  /// the run's line (within `wallJoin.linear`) with the front on the room
  /// side, and whose interval along `t` overlaps `[0, L]`.
  List<List<FaceNeighbour>> _neighboursAlong(
      DraftDocument doc, List<FaceRun> runs) {
    final placed = <(Handle, Vector2, Vector2, Vector2)>[];
    final root = doc.tree[doc.tree.root];
    if (root is GroupNode) {
      final filter = FilterEvaluator(doc);
      for (final h in doc.tree.childNodesOf(root.children)) {
        final node = doc.tree[h];
        if (node is! InstanceNode) continue;
        if (doc.components.get<SymbolComponent>(node.definition) == null) {
          continue;
        }
        if (!filter.acceptsNode(h, const QueryFilter.picking())) continue;
        final box = _box(doc, node.definition);
        if (box == null) continue;
        final g = doc.tree.accumulatedTransform(h);
        if (!isOrthonormal(g)) continue;
        placed.add((
          h,
          g.transformPoint(Vector2(box.left, box.back)),
          g.transformPoint(Vector2(box.right, box.back)),
          g.transformPoint(Vector2((box.left + box.right) / 2, box.front)),
        ));
      }
    }
    final tol = wallJoin.linear;
    return List.unmodifiable([
      for (final r in runs)
        List<FaceNeighbour>.unmodifiable([
          for (final (h, e1, e2, front) in placed)
            if (((e1 - r.a).dot(r.m)).abs() <= tol &&
                ((e2 - r.a).dot(r.m)).abs() <= tol &&
                (front - r.a).dot(r.m) > 0)
              if (_interval((e1 - r.a).dot(r.t), (e2 - r.a).dot(r.t), h)
                  case final n when n.hi >= 0 && n.lo <= r.length)
                n,
        ]),
    ]);
  }

  static FaceNeighbour _interval(double u1, double u2, Handle h) =>
      u1 <= u2 ? (lo: u1, hi: u2, instance: h) : (lo: u2, hi: u1, instance: h);
}

/// The kit's one [WallFaces] for [s]'s document (spec C2 "Shared caches"):
/// over the shared bands, the kit's live walls and today's host rule.
WallFaces wallFacesOf(PlanServices s) => s.shared<WallFaces>((s) =>
    WallFaces(wallBandsOf(s), liveTypesOf(s), accept: isUsableHost));
```

- [ ] **Step 8: The provider.** Create `packages/jet_cad_2d_kit_architecture/lib/src/attach/wall_face_provider.dart`:

```dart
// The wall-face attachment provider (spec 3a C5; umbrella A5; 09c D4, D6,
// D8): today's attachToWall over the kit's WallFaces, answering the plan
// library's AttachmentQuery. The capture and the edge snap are the query's
// (today's 16 px and snap aperture, which the plan passes); one capture,
// whether or not the query keeps an earlier answer (D-07); under
// mayRotate false only a face the symbol already faces (F-7, D-08).
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit/jet_cad_2d_kit.dart';

import 'wall_faces.dart';

/// The target kind the kit's symbols name in `attachTo`.
const String kWallFaceKind = 'wall-face';

/// The kit's provider for [services]' document: one per document, made by
/// the plan library from the kit's `attachments` (spec 2a P1, lifetimes).
AttachmentProvider wallFaceProvider(PlanServices services) =>
    _WallFaceProvider(services);

final class _WallFaceProvider implements AttachmentProvider {
  _WallFaceProvider(this._services);

  final PlanServices _services;

  @override
  String get kind => kWallFaceKind;

  /// [attachToWall] for the query's pointer over the document's faces, its
  /// footprint read as the symbol's box (front `minY`, back `maxY`, the
  /// inverse of `footprintOf`). The marker is the face point the symbol's
  /// back-centre lands on; the token is the run. Null for an empty
  /// footprint, for no face within the capture, for a query excluding
  /// more than one object (no caller asks it), and under `mayRotate:
  /// false` for a face the symbol's current turn does not face.
  @override
  Attachment? attach(AttachmentQuery query) {
    final f = query.footprint;
    if (f.isEmpty) return null;
    final exclude = query.exclude;
    if (exclude.length > 1) return null;
    final a = wallFacesOf(_services).attach(
      _services.document,
      SymbolBox(left: f.minX, right: f.maxX, front: f.minY, back: f.maxY),
      query.pointer,
      query.capture,
      mirrored: query.mirrored,
      edgeCaptureWorld: query.edgeCapture,
      exclude: exclude.isEmpty ? null : exclude.single,
      keep: query.mayRotate ? null : query.current,
    );
    if (a == null) return null;
    return Attachment(transform: a.transform, marker: a.q, token: a.run);
  }
}
```

```dart
// 3a Tasks 23-24 (spec C4, C5, C6): the kit's furniture library loads in a
// plan from the package's asset key, named in the kit's words, and its
// wall-face kind is offered.
import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_integration/jet_cad_2d_integration.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit/jet_cad_2d_kit.dart'
    show KitDiagnosticCode, SymbolsState;
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_plan/jet_cad_2d_plan.dart';

/// Lets the library's load (a real asset read through the test binding,
/// then a decode) finish: polls [c]'s state, at most about half a second.
/// The plan library's own `settle` (twenty zero delays,
/// `test/support/symbol_fixtures.dart:248-252`) serves in-memory reads only.
Future<void> settle(PlanController c) async {
  for (var i = 0;
      i < 500 && c.symbolsState.value == SymbolsState.loading;
      i++) {
    await Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 1));
  }
}

void main() {
  TestWidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized();

  test(
      'FU-load the furniture library loads from the kit\'s package key: 41 '
      'symbols of the kit, architecture.*@1 in catalog order, named in '
      'German and Turkish by the kit\'s words; no library diagnostic',
      () async {
    final c = architectureController();
    addTearDown(c.dispose);
    await settle(c);
    expect(c.symbolsState.value, SymbolsState.ready);
    final ids = [for (final s in c.symbols) s.id];
    expect(ids, hasLength(41));
    expect(ids.first, 'architecture.dining.table.square.two@1');
    expect(ids.last, 'architecture.office.bookshelf@1');
    expect(ids.every((id) => id.startsWith('architecture.') && id.endsWith('@1')),
        isTrue);
    expect({for (final s in c.symbols) s.kitId}, {'architecture'});
    final bed = c.symbolById('architecture.bed.double@1')!;
    expect(bed.names.symbolName('de', bed.component), 'Doppelbett');
    expect(bed.names.symbolName('tr', bed.component), 'Çift kişilik yatak');
    expect(
        bed.names.categoryName('de', 'architecture', bed.component.category),
        'Schlafzimmer');
    expect([
      for (final d in c.diagnostics.value)
        if (d.code == KitDiagnosticCode.libraryUnreadable ||
            d.code == KitDiagnosticCode.libraryKitMismatch ||
            d.code == KitDiagnosticCode.symbolDuplicate)
          d.code,
    ], isEmpty);
  });

  test(
      'WF-offered every attachment kind the library names is offered: no '
      'attachmentKindUnoffered once the symbols load', () async {
    final c = architectureController();
    addTearDown(c.dispose);
    await settle(c);
    expect(c.symbolsState.value, SymbolsState.ready);
    expect(c.symbols.where((s) => s.component.attachTo.contains('wall-face')),
        hasLength(30),
        reason: 'premise: the library names wall-face');
    expect([
      for (final d in c.diagnostics.value)
        if (d.code == KitDiagnosticCode.attachmentKindUnoffered) d.subject,
    ], isEmpty);
  });
}
```

```dart
/// The sample flat as the plan library builds it for `PlanController(build:)`
/// (spec C1.9): a document over [measurer] with the page's, the contract's
/// and the kit's components and millimetres; the kit's `prepare` (the DASHED
/// record); a parametric system over the kit's six types, installed and
/// disposed at tear-down; [buildSampleFlat] in [words] (English and the
/// point by default); then the history cleared, as the plan library clears
/// it.
({DraftDocument doc, ParametricSystem system, ParametricCatalog catalog})
    sampleFlat(FlutterTextMeasurer measurer, {KitWords? words}) {
  final catalog = ParametricCatalog();
  for (final type in architectureKit.types) {
    type.registerInto(catalog);
  }
  final doc = DraftDocument.empty(measurer: measurer);
  PageComponent.register(doc.components);
  registerKitComponents(doc.components);
  catalog.registerComponents(doc.components);
  doc.header.units = DrawingUnits.millimeters;
  architectureKit.prepare!(doc);
  final system = ParametricSystem(doc, catalog)..install();
  addTearDown(system.dispose);
  buildSampleFlat(
      doc,
      words ??
          KitNamesWords(architectureKit.names, () => const Locale('en')));
  doc.commands.clearHistory();
  return (doc: doc, system: system, catalog: catalog);
}
```

```dart
// 3a Task 25 (spec C3.7, C1.9, C6; D-34): the sample flat built by the plan
// library over the architecture kit. Ported from jet_cad_floor_plan/test/
// startup_plan_test.dart: the clamp constants' case (now the plan's
// constants) and the page-with-no-history case (the history after a build
// is the plan library's). The kit runs the other twelve.
import 'dart:ui' show Size;

import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d/jet_cad_2d.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_flutter/jet_cad_2d_flutter.dart'
    show ViewportTransform;
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_integration/jet_cad_2d_integration.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit_architecture/jet_cad_2d_kit_architecture.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_plan/jet_cad_2d_plan.dart';

// The kit's sample constants the page case reads (its lib/src/sample/
// sample_flat.dart), written out: this package imports public libraries
// only.
const double kPlanOriginX = 12000.0;
const double kPlanWidth = 14000.0;

/// The walls' extents: the union of every wall group's bounds (each at the
/// identity, SP5), so the dimensions' lines outside the plan are not in it.
Aabb2 wallExtents(DraftDocument doc) {
  var box = Aabb2.empty();
  for (final w in doc.components.withComponent<WallParams>()) {
    box = box.union(doc.definitionBounds(w));
  }
  return box;
}

/// Lets the controller's library load finish.
Future<void> settle() async {
  for (var i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
    await Future<void>.delayed(Duration.zero);
  }
}

PlanController flat() {
  final c = sampleFlatController();
  addTearDown(c.dispose);
  return c;
}

void main() {
  TestWidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized();

  // Spec D4's owed check: the constants against the document's own units.
  // At 1440 x 900 the fit scale is 0.95 * min(1440 / 14000, 900 / 9000) --
  // 0.095 px/mm -- so kPlanMinScale allows ~95x further out and
  // kPlanMaxScale ~1000x further in. Both decades are needed by a CAD user;
  // neither is absurd. The numbers are printed so the results note can
  // quote them.
  test('the clamp constants bracket the fitted scale by decades', () {
    final doc = flat().document;
    final fit = ViewportTransform.fit(doc.extents, const Size(1440, 900));
    // ignore: avoid_print
    print('STARTUP fit scale ${fit.scale} px/mm; '
        'min $kPlanMinScale (${fit.scale / kPlanMinScale}x out), '
        'max $kPlanMaxScale (${kPlanMaxScale / fit.scale}x in)');
    expect(fit.scale / kPlanMinScale, greaterThan(10));
    expect(kPlanMaxScale / fit.scale, greaterThan(100));
  });

  test(
      'the startup plan carries an A4 landscape page at 1:50 centred on the '
      'plan, in millimetres, with no history', () {
    final doc = flat().document;
    final page = doc.components.get<PageComponent>(doc.rootHandle)!;
    expect(page.preset, SheetSize.a4);
    expect(page.orientation, PageOrientation.landscape);
    expect(page.scaleDenominator, 50);
    expect(page.displayUnit, DisplayUnit.meters);
    final rect = sheetWorldRect(page);
    // Centred on the plan, the walls' outer rectangle (19,000, 12,500):
    // the page is set before the rooms and dimensions, and spec 11 D17's
    // overall dimensions, outside the walls, do not move it (Ruling 11-14,
    // the controller's ruling).
    final extents = wallExtents(doc);
    expect(extents.center.x, 19000);
    expect(extents.center.y, 12500);
    expect(rect.center.x, closeTo(extents.center.x, 1e-9));
    expect(rect.center.y, closeTo(extents.center.y, 1e-9));
    expect(rect.minX, lessThan(kPlanOriginX));
    expect(rect.maxX, greaterThan(kPlanOriginX + kPlanWidth));
    expect(doc.header.units, DrawingUnits.millimeters);
    expect(doc.commands.canUndo, isFalse, reason: 'Ruling 04-1');
  });

  test(
      'SF-controller sampleFlatController opens the sample flat clean: seven '
      'rooms named in English, 611 entities, nothing to undo, not dirty, no '
      'diagnostic once the library has loaded', () async {
    final c = flat();
    await settle();
    final doc = c.document;
    final rooms = doc.components.withComponent<RoomParams>().toList()
      ..sort((a, b) => a.value.compareTo(b.value));
    expect([for (final r in rooms) doc.components.get<RoomParams>(r)!.name], [
      'Hall',
      'Bedroom 1',
      'Bedroom 2',
      'Kitchen',
      'Bath',
      'Living',
      'Dining',
    ]);
    expect(doc.entities.liveCount, 611);
    expect(c.canUndo.value, isFalse);
    expect(c.dirty.value, isFalse);
    expect(c.diagnostics.value, isEmpty);
  });
}
```

```dart
/// The sample's page: A4 landscape at 1:50 in metres, centred on [extents],
/// printing [decimalSeparator].
PageComponent _samplePage(Aabb2 extents,
    {DecimalSeparator decimalSeparator = DecimalSeparator.point}) {
  final page = PageComponent(decimalSeparator: decimalSeparator);
  final w = page.effectiveWidthMm * page.scaleDenominator;
  final h = page.effectiveHeightMm * page.scaleDenominator;
  return page.copyWith(
      originX: extents.center.x - w / 2, originY: extents.center.y - h / 2);
}
```
