Plan rulings (the controller confirms each before execution; each becomes a ledger `Ruling:` line):
- **IT-R1 (C6 public only; rulings R-P1, R-P9).** Every integration test file imports the plan library, the kit, the contract, the engine and the Flutter layer through their public libraries only. Where today's test reached a shell internal, the port reads the same value through a public road: the active tool is `InteractionLayer.tools.active` (`tester.widget<InteractionLayer>(...)`, the Flutter layer's public widget; a kit tool reaches it wrapped by the guard, whose `phase` and `isMidShape` forward, `jet_cad_2d_plan/lib/src/kits/guard.dart:346-370`); the selection is `PlanController.activeSelection`; a table is a unit found by its `UNIT` label in the document. Units are placed and labelled by hand (`units.dart`, the plan's placer and label command re-stated over the engine's commands and the contract's label helpers, as Task 23's `place_entry.dart` re-states the placer for the kit), because `placeSymbol` and `addUnitLabelCommand` are not exported. A file that reads an `@internal` member of a public plan class (`selection`, `grips`, `outlines`, `toolContext`) starts with `// ignore_for_file: invalid_use_of_internal_member` (R-P9); this task needs it in `room_paint_test.dart` only (OL4's `outlines`), every other read has a public road.
- **IT-R2 (tables stay tables).** Today's cases that select, edit or delete table `1` keep it: the editor fixture is 2b's unit editor fixture (`fx` units `1`, `2`, `7`, ` 7 `, an unlabelled one, `5` hidden, `L` locked, a chair), now on the sample flat (2b's stand-in lines for the north wall, its inner face, the column and the hairline are dropped: the flat draws them). `setTableData` is `setUnitData`, `selectedTables` is `selectedUnits`, `TableSurvey.withNumber(n)` is the units of `c.units` labelled `n` (2b's renames, C7 class 1).
- **IT-R3 (planner_grips' fixture).** The spec's A.2 calls A1-A4 "stretch, F3 and undo mid-drag on the sample flat's walls"; the source's fixture is two lines on a page (`planner_grips_test.dart:40-52`). The source is the oracle: ported as written, over `architectureController` so the kit is loaded while the generic grips run. The file's fifth case (M-03ao) is ported with it.
- **IT-R4 (window sizes).** `planner_shell_test`'s cases ran at flutter_test's 800 x 600; `PlanEditor`'s columns (240 + 280 px, `plan_editor.dart:933-958`) would leave a 280 px canvas, so they run at 1440 x 900. Their comments' pick-radius bounds hold with room to spare: the page fit there is about 0.06 px/mm, a 6 px pick is about 97 mm, under the 366 mm and 506 mm the comments name.
- **IT-R5 (TD1's camera).** Today's TD1 used the shell's own fit over a document with no page. A plan file has a page (the new plan's, at the origin), which the first fit frames, leaving the D23 plan off the screen; the port sets the camera on the plan's middle at 0.05 px/mm, y up, before the gestures. The fixture changes, the assertions do not.
- **IT-R6 (C7 class 3, the choices).** A `ChoiceProperty` is a `DropdownButton` (`plan_property_panel.dart:728-744`): `SegmentedButton<T>.onSelectionChanged` reads `DropdownButton<Object?>.onChanged`; a tap on a segment `'<x>-<v>'` is the menu opened and its item `'<key>-<v>'` tapped. The asserted values do not change.
- **IT-R7 (one key, two scopes).** Today's shell keyed a field the same whether it edited the object or the active tool's settings (`wall-thickness`, `opening-width`); the plan keys `property-<id>` and `setting-<id>` (`plan_property_panel.dart:702`), never shown together. A ported line keeps its single finder: `field('thickness')` matches either key (`canvas_rig.dart`), and `section(type, tool)` matches `section-<type>` or `settings-<tool>`.
- **IT-R8 (T5-f's placed sofa).** Today's T5-f placed `sofa.two` with `placeSymbol` at an exact transform (`editor_panels_test.dart:178-183`). The port arms `architecture.sofa.two` (`c.armSymbol`) and clicks at (24,600, 13,600), as a user would; no assertion reads the transform.
- **IT-R9 (the palette's rows).** A12b's map gains the eight architecture rows with today's flags (`planner_draw_test.dart:337-353`: every row but Select draws), under the plan's keys `tool-architecture.<tool>`. 2a's port dropped them for want of the tools (`jet_cad_2d_plan/test/editor/palette_draw_test.dart:228-230`); A12b's plan-library copy stays as it is.
- **IT-R12 (the sample flat's shell reads, R-P5's question).** `dimension_shell_test`'s three reads of the shell's internals map to public roads, no assertion changes:
  - SL1's `view.grips!.rotatable` and `view.grips!.pivot` (`dimension_shell_test.dart:369-371`) → `gripsOf(tester).rotatable` and `.pivot`: the `GripCache` the plan hands its tools in their `ToolContext` (`jet_cad_2d_plan/lib/src/controller/session.dart:69-76`), reached as `InteractionLayer.tools.context.grips` (the Flutter layer's public `ToolController.context`, `jet_cad_2d_flutter/lib/src/tool.dart:165`, and `ToolContext.grips`, `:106`). The same cache as `PlanController.grips` (`@internal`), without R-P9's ignore.
  - TL9's `view.tools.active` (`:561`) → `activeTool(tester)` (`InteractionLayer.tools.active`): `plan.line` is the Flutter layer's `LineTool` (`jet_cad_2d_plan/lib/src/tools/generic_tools.dart:134`), unguarded (only kit tools are wrapped), so `isA<LineTool>()`, `hoverVisible`, `hoverKind`, `hoverPoint` read as today (`PlacementTool`'s public members).
  - `view.index.pickInto`/`snapInto` (`:179`, `:577`) → the same calls on a `SpatialIndex(c.document)` the test makes and disposes (Task 22's note: the engine's index over the same document answers alike; a fixture change).
- **IT-R13 (SL1's oracle lines, kit internals).** `oracleEnd`'s attached branch and `oracleFailures` (`dimension_fixture.dart:445-522`) read the kit's `wallsInDocument`, `wallEndPoint` and `layoutDimension`, which the integration package cannot import (R-P1). Ported: `oracleEnd`'s fixed branch (`:447-449`, public: the dimension's group transform), so `:340` and `:384`, `:422` (each the diagonal's fixed end `b`) keep their assertions. Not ported (the controller confirms; Task 21's DM-R2 is the precedent): `:345-349` (the attached end E1/1/left through the oracle; the next two lines, `:350-351`, assert the dimension line's start at the same (25,750, 8,250) within 1e-6) and `:359`, `:427` (`oracleFailures(doc)` empty; `driftOf(doc)` beside each asserts the stored children are what regeneration gives, and Task 20's attach and follow tests carry the oracle over the same closure in the kit).
- **IT-R14 (`room_paint_test`'s SR3, the plan's open path).** Today's SR3 decodes the stripped file with the old catalog and installs a system by hand (`room_paint_test.dart:496-513`). The port opens the stripped plan file through the plan library, as a host does: `architectureController(json: stripped)`; `system.drift()` → `driftOf(c.document)` and `system.diagnostics()` → `ParametricSystem(c.document, kitCatalog()).diagnostics()` (both the engine's, over the kit's types); the edit is executed on `c.document.commands` as today; `system.dispose(); doc.commands.clearHistory();` are dropped (the controller's system stays, its history keeps the edit; no later line reads the depth). The rest is unchanged: a file without the record opens unchanged and its separator draws continuous (Review Focus 1, spec C1.3).

```dart
/// Wall [h]'s world ends: its stored ends under its group's accumulated
/// transform (today's `WorldWall.s`, `.e`).
({Vector2 s, Vector2 e}) worldEndsOf(DraftDocument doc, Handle h) {
  final p = doc.components.get<WallParams>(h)!;
  final m = doc.tree.accumulatedTransform(h);
  return (
    s: m.transformPoint(Vector2(p.sx, p.sy)),
    e: m.transformPoint(Vector2(p.ex, p.ey)),
  );
}

/// The face line of the wall from [s] to [e] at [offset] along its left
/// normal, as two points (today's `face`, wall_fixture.dart:96-103).
(Vector2, Vector2) faceOf(Vector2 s, Vector2 e, double offset) {
  final dx = e.x - s.x, dy = e.y - s.y;
  final len = math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
  final nx = -dy / len * offset, ny = dx / len * offset;
  return (Vector2(s.x + nx, s.y + ny), Vector2(e.x + nx, e.y + ny));
}
```

```dart
/// The handles [buildPlan] added, in the order given, and its placement.
final class Plan {
  Plan(this.place, this.walls, this.seps, this.openings);
  final Placement place;
  final List<Handle> walls, seps, openings;

  Vector2 at(double x, double y) => place.at(x, y);
}

/// Today's `buildPlan` (room_fixture.dart:118-162) into [doc], which has
/// the plan's system (a [planWith] document): its creation of a document,
/// its system and its DASHED record are the plan library's here (C1.3).
Plan buildPlan(DraftDocument doc, List<W> walls,
    {List<S> seps = const [],
    List<W> wallsAfter = const [],
    List<O> openings = const [],
    Placement place = origin}) {
  final wh = <Handle>[], sh = <Handle>[], oh = <Handle>[];
  var k = 0;
  void addWalls(List<W> ws) {
    for (final w in ws) {
      final h = doc.handleSeed.next();
      final g = place.groups ? groupFor(place, k++) : Transform2.identity();
      final inv = g.invert();
      final s = inv.transformPoint(place.at(w.sx, w.sy));
      final e = inv.transformPoint(place.at(w.ex, w.ey));
      doc.commands.execute(CompoundCommand([
        AddNodeCommand(GroupNode(
            handle: h,
            parent: doc.rootHandle,
            transform: g,
            children: const [])),
        SetComponentCommand<WallParams>(
            h, WallParams(s.x, s.y, e.x, e.y, w.t, w.j)),
      ], label: 'Add wall'));
      wh.add(h);
    }
  }

  addWalls(walls);
  for (final (sx, sy, ex, ey) in seps) {
    sh.add(addSeparator(doc, place.at(sx, sy), place.at(ex, ey),
        at: place.groups ? groupFor(place, k++) : null));
  }
  addWalls(wallsAfter);
  for (final (i, position, width, kind, swing) in openings) {
    oh.add(addOpening(
        doc, OpeningParams(wh[i], position, width, kind, swing: swing)));
  }
  return Plan(place, wh, sh, oh);
}
```

Then write:

```dart
/// [s] placed by [transform] on [layer] (layer 0 by default), one step:
/// its definition copied unless a live one of its key and version is there
/// (the placer's reuse, less its leaf-equality check: fixture symbols are
/// never edited). Returns the instance.
Handle placeUnit(DraftDocument doc, CatalogSymbol s,
    {required Transform2 transform, Handle? layer}) {
  final entry = entryOf(s);
  final commands = <DraftCommand>[];
  Handle? definition;
  for (final h in doc.components.withComponent<SymbolComponent>()) {
    final c = doc.components.get<SymbolComponent>(h)!;
    if (c.key == entry.symbol.key &&
        c.version == entry.symbol.version &&
        doc.tree.definition(h) != null) {
      definition = h;
      break;
    }
  }
  if (definition == null) {
    final copy = doc.handleSeed.next();
    commands
      ..add(AddDefinitionCommand(Definition(
          handle: copy,
          name: entry.symbol.id,
          basePoint: entry.definition.basePoint,
          children: const [])))
      ..add(SetComponentCommand<SymbolComponent>(copy, entry.symbol));
    if (entry.unit case final unit?) {
      commands.add(SetComponentCommand<UnitComponent>(copy, unit));
    }
    for (final leaf in entry.leaves) {
      commands.add(AddEntityCommand(
          record:
              leaf.record.copyWith(handle: doc.handleSeed.next(), owner: copy),
          payload: leaf.payload));
    }
    definition = copy;
  }
  final h = doc.handleSeed.next();
  commands.add(AddNodeCommand(InstanceNode(
      handle: h,
      parent: doc.rootHandle,
      definition: definition,
      layer: layer ?? ReservedHandles.layerZero,
      transform: transform)));
  doc.commands.execute(CompoundCommand(commands, label: 'Place ${s.name}'));
  return h;
}

/// [s] with its base point at [at], [quarterTurns] counter-clockwise and
/// [mirrored] (unit_fixtures.dart:273-283, over the contract's transform).
Handle placeAt(DraftDocument doc, CatalogSymbol s, Vector2 at,
        {int quarterTurns = 0, bool mirrored = false}) =>
    placeUnit(doc, s,
        transform: placementTransform(
            at: at,
            basePoint: Vector2(s.base.$1, s.base.$2),
            quarterTurns: quarterTurns,
            mirrored: mirrored));

/// The box of [definition]'s lowest-handle leaf when it is a circle or a
/// polyline, else empty (the plan's `placedLabelTopOf`,
/// unit_label.dart:134-164, the label height's rule, ruling R-21).
Aabb2 labelTopOf(DraftDocument doc, Handle definition) {
  int? first;
  for (final slot in doc.entities.liveSlots) {
    if (doc.entities.ownerAt(slot) != definition) continue;
    if (first == null ||
        doc.entities.handleAt(slot).value <
            doc.entities.handleAt(first).value) {
      first = slot;
    }
  }
  if (first == null) return Aabb2.empty();
  final p = doc.geometry.read(doc.entities.geomIndexAt(first));
  switch (doc.entities.kindAt(first)) {
    case EntityKind.circle:
      final r = p.scalars[0];
      return Aabb2.raw(
          p.coords[0] - r, p.coords[1] - r, p.coords[0] + r, p.coords[1] + r);
    case EntityKind.polyline:
      final c = p.coords;
      var minX = c[0], maxX = c[0], minY = c[1], maxY = c[1];
      for (var i = 2; i + 1 < c.length; i += 2) {
        minX = math.min(minX, c[i]);
        maxX = math.max(maxX, c[i]);
        minY = math.min(minY, c[i + 1]);
        maxY = math.max(maxY, c[i + 1]);
      }
      return Aabb2.raw(minX, minY, maxX, maxY);
    default:
      return Aabb2.empty();
  }
}

/// [text] as [instance]'s UNIT label, one step; the label's handle.
Handle labelUnit(DraftDocument doc, Handle instance, String text) {
  final node = doc.tree[instance]! as InstanceNode;
  final def = doc.tree.definition(node.definition)!;
  final h = doc.handleSeed.next();
  doc.commands.execute(AddEntityCommand(
    record: EntityRecord(
      handle: h,
      owner: instance,
      kind: EntityKind.attrib,
      layer: ReservedHandles.layerZero,
      linetype: ReservedHandles.byBlockLinetype,
      linetypeScale: 1.0,
      geomIndex: 0,
      color: const ByBlockColor(),
      lineweight: kByBlock,
      transparency: kByBlock,
      flags: 0,
      text: text,
      tag: kUnitLabelTag,
      textStyle: ReservedHandles.standardTextStyle,
      textAttrs: kUnitLabelTextAttrs,
    ),
    payload: unitLabelPayload(
      anchor: def.basePoint,
      height: unitLabelHeight(labelTopOf(doc, node.definition)),
      instanceToWorld: node.transform,
    ),
  ));
  return h;
}

/// The instances of [doc] whose UNIT label reads [label] trimmed, by
/// handle (today's `TableSurvey.withNumber`, 2b's `withLabel`).
List<Handle> unitsLabelled(DraftDocument doc, String label) {
  final out = <Handle>[];
  for (final slot in doc.entities.liveSlots) {
    final r = doc.entities.read(slot);
    if (r.kind == EntityKind.attrib &&
        r.tag == kUnitLabelTag &&
        r.text.trim() == label.trim()) {
      out.add(r.owner);
    }
  }
  return out..sort((a, b) => a.value.compareTo(b.value));
}

/// Table [n]'s instance; ` 7 ` is the later of the two sevens, null the
/// unlabelled unit (2b's `tableOf`, unit_editor_fixture.dart:228-236).
Handle tableOf(PlanController c, String? n) {
  final d = c.document;
  if (n == null) {
    final labelled = {
      for (final slot in d.entities.liveSlots)
        if (d.entities.read(slot).tag == kUnitLabelTag)
          d.entities.ownerAt(slot),
    };
    return d.tree.nodes
        .whereType<InstanceNode>()
        .where((i) =>
            d.components.get<UnitComponent>(i.definition) != null &&
            !labelled.contains(i.handle))
        .single
        .handle;
  }
  return unitsLabelled(d, n)[n == ' 7 ' ? 1 : 0];
}
```

- [ ] **Step 5: The canvas rig.** Create `I/test/support/canvas_rig.dart`:

```dart
// Cameras, gestures and read-outs for the integration tests (3a Task 26),
// beside Task 9's editor_rig.dart (re-exported: activeTool, globalOf with
// x and y, globalAt with a point, kitCatalog, press, status),
// over the public widgets: today's PlannerView handles (its camera, its
// selection, its tools) are the controller's camera and selection and the
// InteractionLayer's tool controller (spec C6, ruling IT-R1).
import 'dart:ui' as ui;

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter/services.dart' show LogicalKeyboardKey;
import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d/jet_cad_2d.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_flutter/jet_cad_2d_flutter.dart'
    show GripCache, InteractionLayer, ViewportTransform;
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_plan/jet_cad_2d_plan.dart';
import 'package:vector_math/vector_math_64.dart' show Vector2;

import 'editor_rig.dart' show press;

export 'editor_rig.dart'
    show activeTool, globalAt, globalOf, kitCatalog, press, status;

Finder byKey(String k) => find.byKey(Key(k));

/// One field whatever its scope: the object's `property-<id>` or the
/// active tool's `setting-<id>` (today's shell keyed both alike; ruling
/// IT-R7).
Finder field(String id) => find.byWidgetPredicate((w) =>
    w.key == Key('property-$id') || w.key == Key('setting-$id'));

/// The section of [typeId] or the settings of [toolId] (today's
/// `<type>-section`, shown for the object and for its tool).
Finder section(String typeId, String toolId) => find.byWidgetPredicate(
    (w) => w.key == Key('section-$typeId') || w.key == Key('settings-$toolId'));

/// [c] in a [PlanEditor] in a [size] window, in [locale], two frames.
Future<void> pumpPlanEditor(WidgetTester tester, PlanController c,
    {Size size = const Size(1440, 900),
    Locale? locale,
    bool layerPanel = true}) async {
  await tester.binding.setSurfaceSize(size);
  addTearDown(() => tester.binding.setSurfaceSize(null));
  await tester.pumpWidget(MaterialApp(
      locale: locale,
      supportedLocales: planSupportedLocales,
      localizationsDelegates: planLocalizationsDelegates,
      home: Scaffold(
          body: PlanEditor(controller: c, layerPanel: layerPanel))));
  await tester.pump();
  await tester.pump();
}

/// The camera on world [centre] at [scale] px/mm, y up, turned [turn]
/// radians on the screen; set after the editor's first fit.
Future<void> frameOn(WidgetTester tester, PlanController c, Vector2 centre,
    {required double scale, double turn = 0}) async {
  final size = tester.getSize(find.byType(InteractionLayer));
  final linear =
      Transform2.rotation(turn).multiply(Transform2.scale(scale, -scale));
  final mid = linear.transformPoint(centre);
  c.camera.value = ViewportTransform(
      worldToScreenMatrix: Transform2.translation(
              size.width / 2 - mid.x, size.height / 2 - mid.y)
          .multiply(linear));
  await tester.pump();
}

/// The selection's grips and box: the cache the plan hands its tools in
/// their context (`InteractionLayer.tools.context.grips`; ruling IT-R12).
GripCache gripsOf(WidgetTester tester) => tester
    .widget<InteractionLayer>(find.byType(InteractionLayer))
    .tools
    .context
    .grips!;

/// A key press and a pump; whether a handler took it: the rig's [press]
/// under today's name.
Future<bool> pressKey(WidgetTester tester, LogicalKeyboardKey key) =>
    press(tester, key);

/// A mouse resting at [at], then a press and a release there.
Future<void> mouseClick(WidgetTester tester, Offset at) async {
  final g = await tester.createGesture(kind: ui.PointerDeviceKind.mouse);
  await g.addPointer(location: at - const Offset(3, 3));
  await g.moveTo(at);
  await tester.pump();
  await g.down(at);
  await tester.pump();
  await g.up();
  await tester.pump();
  await g.removePointer();
  await tester.pump();
}

/// The canvas's own focus node.
FocusNode canvasFocus(WidgetTester tester) => tester
    .widget<Focus>(find
        .descendant(
            of: find.byType(InteractionLayer), matching: find.byType(Focus))
        .first)
    .focusNode!;

/// A click a little inside the canvas's top left: the canvas takes focus.
Future<void> focusCanvas(WidgetTester tester) async {
  await tester.tapAt(
      tester.getTopLeft(find.byType(InteractionLayer)) + const Offset(6, 6));
  await tester.pump();
  expect(FocusManager.instance.primaryFocus, same(canvasFocus(tester)),
      reason: 'premise: the canvas focused');
}

/// Whether the canvas (or a node under it) has the focus.
bool canvasFocused() {
  final context = FocusManager.instance.primaryFocus?.context;
  return context != null &&
      context.findAncestorWidgetOfExactType<InteractionLayer>() != null;
}

/// The menu of the choice [id] opened and its value [segment] tapped (a
/// `ChoiceProperty` is a dropdown; ruling IT-R6). Nothing when the menu
/// does not open (a disabled choice): today's tap on a disabled segment.
Future<void> choose(WidgetTester tester, String id, String segment) async {
  final menu = field(id);
  final key = (tester.widget(menu).key! as ValueKey<String>).value;
  await tester.tap(menu);
  await tester.pumpAndSettle();
  final item = byKey('$key-$segment');
  if (item.evaluate().isEmpty) return;
  await tester.tap(item.last);
  await tester.pumpAndSettle();
}

/// The choice [id]'s dropdown.
DropdownButton<Object?> menuOf(WidgetTester tester, String id) =>
    tester.widget<DropdownButton<Object?>>(field(id));
```

```dart
/// P-6's layers on [doc], at [place].
LayerPlan layersOn(DraftDocument doc, {Placement place = corpusGroups}) {
  final zero = doc.tables.layers[ReservedHandles.layerZero]!;
  Handle add(String name, int aci, {bool visible = true, bool locked = false}) {
    final handle = doc.handleSeed.next();
    doc.commands.execute(AddLayerCommand(LayerRecord(
      handle: handle,
      name: name,
      color: IndexedColor(aci),
      linetype: zero.linetype,
      lineweight: zero.lineweight,
      transparency: zero.transparency,
      visible: visible,
      locked: locked,
    )));
    return handle;
  }

  final a = add('A', 1);
  final b = add('B', 5, locked: true);
  final c = add('C', 3, visible: false);
  return LayerPlan(place, a, b, c);
}
```

```dart
/// The kit's tool [toolId] over plan services on [l]'s document: the kit's
/// test catalog (the live types), object snap on, one pixel per mm (as
/// [toolContextOf]'s camera), and each tool's initial settings. The
/// services are disposed at tear-down.
Tool toolOf(LayerDoc l, String toolId) {
  final services = FakePlanServices(
      document: l.doc,
      catalog: testCatalog(),
      settings: {
        for (final t in architectureKit.tools)
          if (t.settings case final s?) t.id: s.initial,
      });
  addTearDown(services.dispose);
  final tool = architectureKit.tools
      .singleWhere((t) => t.id == toolId)
      .create(services);
  addTearDown(tool.dispose);
  return tool;
}
```

```dart
  (ArchitectureTools.door, LogicalKeyboardKey.keyD, 'Door'),
  (ArchitectureTools.window, LogicalKeyboardKey.keyN, 'Window'),
  (ArchitectureTools.gap, LogicalKeyboardKey.keyG, 'Gap'),

];

      'IT-letters each architecture letter arms its tool, the status line '

      expect(c.activeTool.value, 'plan.select', reason: '$id: Escape');
```

Plan rulings (the controller confirms; each becomes a ledger `Ruling:` line):
- **IP-R1 (C7 classes 1 and 3; Task 26's IT-R6, IT-R7).** Keys: `wall-thickness` → `field('thickness')` (either scope); `wall-justification` → the choice `justification` (`menuOf(...).value` for `SegmentedButton.selected`, wrapped in a one-element set where today compared a set; `onChanged` for `onSelectionChanged`); a tap on `wall-left|centre|right` → `choose(tester, 'justification', 'left|centre|right')`; `wall-section` → `section(ArchitectureTypes.wall, ArchitectureTools.wall)`; `box-width`, `box-height` → `field('width')`, `field('height')`; `room-area` → `property-area`, `dimension-value` → `property-value` (`TextDisplay` rows, a `Text` keyed `property-<id>` as `ValueDisplay`'s are, `plan_property_panel.dart:745-750`); `room-name` → `field('name')`; `opening-section` → `section-architecture.opening`. The asserted values do not change.
- **IP-R2 (a kit tool's private state; R-P1).** Lines that read the Wall tool's settings object (`(view.tools.active as WallTool).settings.value.thickness`, `selection_panel_test.dart:396-397` in WS3 and `:754`, `:776` in WS10) cannot be written in the integration package (the kit's `WallTool` and `WallSettings` are internal) nor in the kit (the case drives the plan's panel). Not ported; each is covered in the same case by an observable equal to it: the field shows the kept value (`:395`, `:777`) and the next wall the tool draws has it (`:399-403`, `:771-772`). WS6's `view.tools.active as PlacementTool` + `.isPending` (`:499-523`) → `activeTool(tester).isMidShape`: `PlacementTool.isMidShape` is `isPending` (`jet_cad_2d_flutter/lib/src/draw/placement_tool.dart:70-76`) and the guard forwards it (`jet_cad_2d_plan/lib/src/kits/guard.dart:363-370`); the asserted values are unchanged.
- **IP-R3 (the Dimension tool's notice; spec C1.2).** `noticeCases`' `tool.notice.value` (`decimal_separator_test.dart:187`), a `String` today, is a `KitText` now, put into words when read: `c.textOf(c.toolNotice.value!)` (the controller's public notice, Task 4) equals the same `want`. Its two premises over the tool's private state, `tool.points` hasLength 2 (`:184`) and `tool.hoverKind` isNull (`:186`), are not ported: the status line `'$label — $want'` asserted next (`:188`) holds only with two points placed and a free hover (an attached end gives another length than 345.7).
- **IP-R4 (DT1 and LK2's library table).** Today's furniture library carried a servable dining table (`dining.table.square.two@2`); the architecture kit's are plain symbols (decision 3), so the table these cases place is the fixture kit's: `fx.dining.table.two`, named `Square dining table, 2 seats`, a unit of kind `table` seating 2, offered by `fxKit(library: [diningTableTwo])` beside the architecture kit. Its cell key is `symbol-cell-fx.dining.table.two@1`; `table-number` is `unit-label`; `table-section` is `unit-section`. Every assertion keeps its value (DT1's `"7"` and the English name; LK2's six kinds).
- **IP-R5 (LK2's allowlist).** Today's recording language recorded every architecture word because the planner asked its strings for them. The kit's words come from `KitNames`: the leak check also allows a text that is one of the kit's Turkish words or one of its `text:` templates filled (each `{name}` matching any non-empty run). The check, `expect(leaks, isEmpty)`, is unchanged.
- **IP-R6 (PW1's justification words).** `Sol`, `Orta`, `Sağ` are the choice's three words; a dropdown shows the chosen one only, so PW1 opens the menu to find the other two and closes it by choosing `Orta` again (no step: the same value, WS4's rule). C7 class 3.
- **IP-R7 (CP3's two command lines; R-P1).** CP3's direct calls of today's `recolorCommand` (`color_picker_test.dart:497-507`: the command for the selection, and `null` for a colour a room already has) call the plan's internal `recolour` (`jet_cad_2d_plan/lib/src/panels/colour_row.dart`). Not ported; CP3's swatch taps, which make the same two claims through the panel (a tap on the colour a room has adds no step; a tap on teal with A teal and B purple changes B only), are.
- **IP-R8 (WS9's malformed file).** Today's WS9 decodes a document whose wall A's fill names B's outline and hands it to the shell. The port loads the same JSON as a plan file (`architectureController(json:)`). If the plan's load locks A as broken (2a's `lockBroken`, `plan_controller.dart:749`) instead of refusing the edit at its commit, the field is read-only and the case's premise differs: that is a finding for the controller, not an assertion to change.

```dart
/// The fixture's plan file, its room and its dimension.
({String json, Handle room, Handle dim}) q0PlanJson() {
  late Handle room, dim;
  final json = planWith((d) {
    final plan = buildPlan(d, q0Walls, place: corpus);
    attachPage(d, q0Page);
    room = addRoom(d, plan.at(1500.25, 1700.75), 'Kitchen');
    dim = addDimension(
        d, const FixedEnd(-120.5, 40.25), const FixedEnd(3336.8, 40.25),
        offset: 300.25,
        at: corpus.m
            .multiply(Transform2.translation(600.5, 4400.25))
            .multiply(Transform2.rotation(0.4)));
  });
  return (json: json, room: room, dim: dim);
}

/// [doc]'s page with separator [s], one command (today's `separatorTo`).
DraftCommand separatorTo(DraftDocument doc, DecimalSeparator s) =>
    SetComponentCommand<PageComponent>(
        doc.rootHandle, pageOf(doc).copyWith(decimalSeparator: s));
```

  4. `I/test/support/rooms_plan.dart`, the colour picker's plan (`color_picker_test.dart:76-113`, `Rooms`, `roomsPlan`) as a plan file:

```dart
// The colour picker's plan (jet_cad_floor_plan/test/colors/
// color_picker_test.dart:76-113) as a plan file (3a Task 27): the two-room
// rectangle at the corpus far origin turned 23 degrees, every wall and the
// separator in its own rotated group, a separator at x = 6,250.5, room A
// `Kitchen` in a group turned 0.61 rad and room B `Room 2` at the identity,
// the page's grid hidden.
import 'package:jet_cad_2d/jet_cad_2d.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_plan/jet_cad_2d_plan.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_integration/jet_cad_2d_integration.dart';
import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';

import 'plans.dart';

/// The plan, opened: its controller (disposed at tear-down) and handles.
typedef Rooms = ({
  PlanController c,
  Plan plan,
  DraftDocument doc,
  Handle a,
  Handle b,
  Handle sep,
  Handle w
});

Rooms roomsPlan() {
  late Plan plan;
  late Handle a, b;
  final json = planWith((d) {
    plan = buildPlan(d, twoRoomWalls,
        seps: const [(6250.5, 100, 6250.5, 3900)], place: corpusGroups);
    attachPage(d, PageComponent(gridVisible: false));
    final g = Transform2.translation(
            plan.at(1400, 1900).x, plan.at(1400, 1900).y)
        .multiply(Transform2.rotation(0.61));
    a = addRoom(d, plan.at(1500.25, 2000.5), 'Kitchen', at: g);
    b = addRoom(d, plan.at(4700.75, 1900.25), 'Room 2');
  });
  final c = architectureController(json: json);
  addTearDown(c.dispose);
  return (
    c: c,
    plan: plan,
    doc: c.document,
    a: a,
    b: b,
    sep: plan.seps.single,
    w: plan.walls[4]
  );
}
```

     (`attachPage`'s page: today's replaced the document's whole page with `PageComponent(gridVisible: false)`; the plan file's page is replaced the same way.)

```dart
// Ported from jet_cad_floor_plan/test/l10n/value_words_test.dart: VW3's
// Room-notice line (3a Task 27, Appendix A D-24; VW3's other lines are
// 2a's and 2b's), assertions unchanged. The notice is the kit's text
// `text:architecture.room-occupied` with `{name}` (spec C1.2, C1.6),
// worded in each language by `KitWords.text`.
import 'dart:ui' show Locale;

import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit/jet_cad_2d_kit.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit_architecture/jet_cad_2d_kit_architecture.dart';

final List<KitWords> languages = [
  for (final code in ['en', 'de', 'tr'])
    KitNamesWords(architectureKit.names, () => Locale(code)),
];

/// [word] in each language: never empty, holding every [parts], and
/// different in each language (value_words_test.dart:28-39).
void expectWorded(String Function(KitWords s) word,
    {List<String> parts = const [], String? english}) {
  final words = [for (final s in languages) word(s)];
  for (final (i, w) in words.indexed) {
    expect(w, isNotEmpty);
    for (final p in parts) {
      expect(w, contains(p), reason: '${languages[i].locale}: $w');
    }
  }
  expect(words.toSet(), hasLength(3), reason: '$words');
  if (english != null) expect(words.first, english);
}

void main() {
  test('VW3 the Room notice in each language', () {
    expectWorded(
        (s) => s.text('text:architecture.room-occupied', {'name': 'Mutfak'}),
        parts: ['Mutfak'],
        english: 'Already a room: Mutfak');
  });
}
```

```dart
// 3a Task 27 (Appendix A D-46; spec C1.1, C1.7, C3.3): the property
// panel over the real kit. An opening's section is titled by its kind
// (`PlanType.title`), and a door's flips are `ActionProperty`s shown for a
// door only (`visible`): a tap is one step that flips the one field. Over
// the sample flat (its doors and windows), at 1440 x 900.
import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d/jet_cad_2d.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_flutter/jet_cad_2d_flutter.dart' show SelectionKey;
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_integration/jet_cad_2d_integration.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit_architecture/jet_cad_2d_kit_architecture.dart';

import '../support/canvas_rig.dart';

/// The sample's first opening of [kind], by handle.
Handle firstOf(DraftDocument d, OpeningKind kind) =>
    (d.components.withComponent<OpeningParams>().toList()
          ..sort((a, b) => a.value.compareTo(b.value)))
        .firstWhere((o) => d.components.get<OpeningParams>(o)!.kind == kind);

void main() {
  testWidgets(
      'IP-title an opening\'s section is titled by its kind: Door for a '
      'door, Window for a window (D-46, the title hook)', (tester) async {
    final c = sampleFlatController();
    addTearDown(c.dispose);
    await pumpPlanEditor(tester, c);
    final title = byKey('section-${ArchitectureTypes.opening}');
    for (final (kind, word) in const [
      (OpeningKind.door, 'Door'),
      (OpeningKind.window, 'Window'),
    ]) {
      c.activeSelection.replace([SelectionKey.root(firstOf(c.document, kind))]);
      await tester.pump();
      expect(tester.widget<Text>(title).data, word, reason: kind.name);
    }
  });

  testWidgets(
      'IP-door-actions a door shows Flip hinge and Flip swing; a tap flips '
      'that field alone in one step; a window shows neither (D-46: '
      'ActionProperty and visible)', (tester) async {
    final c = sampleFlatController();
    addTearDown(c.dispose);
    await pumpPlanEditor(tester, c);
    final d = c.document;
    final door = firstOf(d, OpeningKind.door);
    c.activeSelection.replace([SelectionKey.root(door)]);
    await tester.pump();
    final p0 = d.components.get<OpeningParams>(door)!;
    final depth = d.commands.undoDepth;
    await tester.tap(field('flip-swing'));
    await tester.pump();
    final p1 = d.components.get<OpeningParams>(door)!;
    expect(p1.swing, isNot(p0.swing), reason: 'the swing flipped');
    expect(p1.hinge, p0.hinge, reason: 'the hinge kept');
    expect(d.commands.undoDepth, depth + 1, reason: 'one step');
    await tester.tap(field('flip-hinge'));
    await tester.pump();
    final p2 = d.components.get<OpeningParams>(door)!;
    expect(p2.hinge, isNot(p1.hinge), reason: 'the hinge flipped');
    expect(p2.swing, p1.swing, reason: 'the swing kept');
    final window = firstOf(d, OpeningKind.window);
    c.activeSelection.replace([SelectionKey.root(window)]);
    await tester.pump();
    expect(byKey('section-${ArchitectureTypes.opening}'), findsOneWidget,
        reason: 'premise: the window\'s section');
    expect(field('flip-hinge'), findsNothing);
    expect(field('flip-swing'), findsNothing);
  });
}
```

Plan rulings (the controller confirms; each a ledger `Ruling:` line; those marked **human** drop an assertion line and need the human's word, A14):
- **IA-R1 (the provider's answer as the oracle).** Where today's integration-level test computed its expected transform with `attachToWall(runs, box, p, capture, …)` over `faceRunsOf` (kit internals), the port asks the kit's provider through the contract, the road `plan.symbol` and `plan.select` take: `architectureKit.attachments.single(FakePlanServices(document: c.document, catalog: kitCatalog(), scale: s)).attach(AttachmentQuery(...))` with the query 2a pins (AT-8, `jet_cad_2d_plan/test/tools/plan_symbol_tool_test.dart:1385-1423`: the footprint `footprintOf(boxOfEntry(entry))`, the free placement as `current`, the raw pointer, `capture: kAttachPixels / s`, `edgeCapture: kSnapAperturePixels / s`, the mirror, `mayRotate`). `WallAttachment.q` (the face point) is `Attachment.marker`; `want.run` (`same(outside)`) is replaced by the marker lying on that face's line (`plans.dart`'s `faceOf` over the wall's world ends, distance below 1e-6). The values compared do not change. `attachments` is `List<AttachmentProvider Function(PlanServices)>`, public on `PlanKit`.
- **IA-R2 (MV1-MV3, MV5, MV6 through `plan.select`).** Today these called `SymbolMoveResolver.resolveMove(ctx, instance, delta)` and asserted its answer; the plan's `PlanMoveResolver` is internal. Each becomes the same move dragged on the canvas (body press, eight moves, release; F3 as the case needs), its assertion read on the committed instance: MV4 (ported as is) pins that the drop commits the resolver's answer verbatim, so the committed transform is the answer (and a plain move `delta · T` where the answer was null). The values asserted do not change.
- **IA-R3 (human: three MV lines).** Not portable through public behaviour: MV1's marker line (`(back - r.marker).length < 1e-6`, `symbol_move_test.dart:165`: the marker is a painted overlay, no public read; 2a's MR tests pin the marker's computation over the test provider); MV3's "before the library is ready" (`:194-197`: the plan's resolver reads the placed definition's own `SymbolComponent`, never a library, `jet_cad_2d_plan/lib/src/tools/move_resolver.dart:55-60`, so the premise cannot be built: C7's "premise impossible"); MV6's `await Future.delayed(Duration.zero)` premise comment stays, its assertion ported.
- **IA-R4 (D-02 through `plan.symbol`).** Today's group drove `SymbolPlaceTool` with `ToolPointerEvent`s and read its private ghost (`ghostAttachment`, `ghostPlacement`, `ghostAt`, `quarterTurns`, `notifications`, `faces`, `paintOverlay`); the plan's `plan.symbol` is internal. Each case is driven on the canvas (`armSymbol`, mouse hover and click, the keys R, M, Shift+R, F3), with: a ghost's transform read as the placement the next click commits at the same pointer (2a's AT-9 pins that the release uses the ghost's attachment, `plan_symbol_tool_test.dart:1424-1451`); the oracle per IA-R1. **Human:** the lines with no committed counterpart are not ported, each named in Step 9 (the repaint count `rig.notifications`, the marker glyph's paint calls in "the marker is the nearest glyph", `rig.tool.faces` being null): 2a's AT-8 to AT-13 pin them over the test provider, Task 24's provider tests over the real faces.
- **IA-R5 (D-03, D-04, D-05: the view's internals).** `view.grips!` (O13a, O13b premises) → `gripsOf(tester)` (Task 26's IT-R12, public); the SS/WE apps' `viewOf(tester).tools`, `armBySymbolsTab` → the editor's Symbols tab and `activeTool(tester)`; WE1's save round trip → `c.save()` and a second controller's `load`; WE1's hover ghost (`bedAt.hovered`) → **human**, as IA-R4's ghost lines.
- **IA-R6 (R-16 without the plan's internals; human for the table halves).** The 2b ports TF1, TF3, TF7, EX2, EX3, EX5 and the zone fixture drive the plan's internals (`UnitStatusPainter` built by hand with its notifiers, `ServicePaintLayers`, `UnitColour`, `frameUnits`: `jet_cad_2d_plan/test/service/paint/unit_fill_test.dart:339-375`, `test/support/service_paint.dart`), which the integration package cannot import (R-P1), and the plan library's tests may not name a room. Full copies cannot run anywhere; their table halves stay 2b's, unchanged. Task 28 restores the **room's lines** as whole tests in the integration package through public roads: the fixture is the 2b fill fixture plus today's teal room and R (`table_fill_test.dart:185-186, 208-252`), its tables placed and labelled by hand (`units.dart`) and their colours written as the plan file stores them (`"jetcad.unit_colour": {"<handle>": {"color": "<name>"}}`, `unit_components.dart:178-200`); the design canvas's colour layer is read as the `CustomPainter` of the `CustomPaint` keyed `unit-colour-layer` (`plan_canvas.dart:395-399`) and recorded by the source's `FillSpy`; pixels through `PlanEditor`/`PlanCanvas` and `export`.
```dart
// Today's wall-attachment scenes (jet_cad_floor_plan/test/support/
// wall_attach_fixture.dart, plan P-2) as plan files for the integration
// tests (3a Task 28), and the oracle of ruling IA-R1: the kit's own
// wall-face provider asked through the contract, as plan.symbol and
// plan.select ask it.
import 'dart:io';

import 'package:jet_cad_2d/jet_cad_2d.dart'; // kSnapAperturePixels is the engine's (drag_snap.dart:14)
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit/jet_cad_2d_kit.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit/testing.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit_architecture/jet_cad_2d_kit_architecture.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_plan/jet_cad_2d_plan.dart'
    show PlanController, PlanSymbol;
import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
import 'package:vector_math/vector_math_64.dart' show Vector2;

import 'plans.dart';

/// The attach capture in pixels (plan.symbol's `kAttachPixels`,
/// jet_cad_2d_plan/lib/src/tools/plan_symbol_tool.dart, not exported).
const double kAttachPixels = 16;

/// The kit's furniture library, read from its committed asset.
final SymbolLibrary furniture = SymbolLibrary.decode(File(
        '../jet_cad_2d_kit_architecture/assets/library/furniture.jetlib')
    .readAsBytesSync());

/// The library's entry of today's [key] (`bath.toilet`), under the kit.
SymbolEntry furnitureEntry(String key) =>
    furniture.entries.singleWhere((e) => e.key == 'architecture.$key');

/// [c]'s loaded symbol of today's [key].
PlanSymbol armable(PlanController c, String key) =>
    c.symbols.singleWhere((s) => s.component.key == 'architecture.$key');

/// The kit's wall-face provider over [doc] at [scale] px/mm (IA-R1).
AttachmentProvider wallFaces(DraftDocument doc, double scale) {
  final services =
      FakePlanServices(document: doc, catalog: kitCatalog(), scale: scale);
  addTearDown(services.dispose);
  return architectureKit.attachments.single(services);
}

/// The provider's answer for [entry] at the raw [pointer], its free
/// placement [current], at [scale] (the query AT-8 pins).
Attachment? attachOf(DraftDocument doc, SymbolEntry entry, Vector2 pointer,
    Transform2 current, double scale,
    {bool mirrored = false, bool mayRotate = true, Attachment? keep}) {
  final box = boxOfEntry(entry)!;
  return wallFaces(doc, scale).attach(AttachmentQuery(
      footprint: footprintOf(box),
      current: current,
      pointer: pointer,
      capture: kAttachPixels / scale,
      edgeCapture: kSnapAperturePixels / scale,
      mirrored: mirrored,
      mayRotate: mayRotate,
      keep: keep));
}

/// The distance from [p] to the face line of wall [h] on its [left] side
/// (or right), from its stored parameters (IA-R1's face test).
double faceDistance(DraftDocument doc, Handle h, Vector2 p, {required bool left}) {
  final w = doc.components.get<WallParams>(h)!;
  final (l, r) = facesOf(w);
  final ends = worldEndsOf(doc, h);
  final (a, b) = faceOf(ends.s, ends.e, left ? l : r);
  final d = b - a;
  return ((p - a).x * d.y - (p - a).y * d.x).abs() / d.length;
}
```

  then copy `jet_cad_floor_plan/test/support/wall_attach_fixture.dart`'s `attachX`, `attachY`, `farAt`, `attachAngles`, `attachGroup`, `SceneWall` (`:16-44`) unchanged, and write the scenes as plan files:

```dart
/// Today's `attachScene` (wall_attach_fixture.dart:46-63) as a plan file:
/// [walls] each one command in its own [attachGroup], handles ascending.
({String json, List<Handle> walls}) attachPlan(List<SceneWall> walls,
    {bool mirrored = false,
    double scale = 1,
    List<double?> rotations = const [],
    void Function(DraftDocument d)? extra}) {
  late List<Handle> hs;
  final json = planWith((doc) {
    hs = [for (final _ in walls) doc.handleSeed.next()];
    for (final (i, (s, e, t, j)) in walls.indexed) {
      doc.commands.execute(addWall(doc, hs[i], s, e, t, j,
          at: attachGroup(hs[i].value,
              mirrored: mirrored,
              scale: scale,
              rotation: i < rotations.length ? rotations[i] : null)));
    }
    extra?.call(doc);
  });
  return (json: json, walls: hs);
}

/// Today's `freeWallScene` (:65-71): 3600 long, 150 thick, from
/// `farAt(1234.5, 678.25)` along [deg].
({String json, List<Handle> walls}) freeWallPlan(double deg, Justification j,
    {bool mirrored = false, double scale = 1}) {
  final s = farAt(1234.5, 678.25);
  return attachPlan([(s, polar(s, deg, 3600), 150, j)],
      mirrored: mirrored, scale: scale);
}
```

- [ ] **Step 10: The paint-allocation invariant over the sample flat (new: IA-alloc).** Create `I/test/invariants/paint_allocation_test.dart`:

```dart
// The plan library's paint-allocation invariant (CLAUDE.md: the frame path
// allocates nothing per entity in steady state, and O(1) per flush) with
// the architecture kit loaded, over the sample flat (spec C6, Tests "The
// non-negotiables"). The harness is jet_cad_2d_plan/test/invariants/
// canvas_paint_allocation_test.dart's CV-alloc (3a Task 28): ten rebuilt
// frames of PlanCanvas, the camera moving one pixel, 50 root entities
// selected so the overlay draws outlines and grips; the same canvas state,
// painter, sink and Paint, and a capacity that holds still.
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d/jet_cad_2d.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_flutter/jet_cad_2d_flutter.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_integration/jet_cad_2d_integration.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_plan/jet_cad_2d_plan.dart';

void main() {
  testWidgets(
      'IA-alloc a rebuilt steady-state PlanCanvas frame over the sample flat '
      'allocates O(1) per flush, the kit loaded (M-IA-alloc)', (tester) async {
    final c = sampleFlatController();
    addTearDown(c.dispose);
    await tester.binding.setSurfaceSize(const Size(1440, 900));
    addTearDown(() => tester.binding.setSurfaceSize(null));
    await tester.pumpWidget(
        MaterialApp(home: Scaffold(body: PlanCanvas(controller: c))));
    await tester.pump();

    final doc = c.document;
    final roots = [
      for (final slot in doc.entities.liveSlots)
        if (doc.entities.ownerAt(slot) == doc.rootHandle)
          doc.entities.handleAt(slot),
    ].take(50).toList();
    expect(roots, hasLength(50), reason: 'premise: root entities to select');
    c.activeSelection.replace([for (final h in roots) SelectionKey.root(h)]);

    final size = tester.getSize(find.byType(InteractionLayer));
    final a = ViewportTransform.fit(doc.extents, size);
    final b = ViewportTransform(
        worldToScreenMatrix:
            Transform2.translation(1, -1).multiply(a.worldToScreenMatrix));
    Future<void> frames(int n) async {
      for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        c.camera.value = i.isEven ? a : b;
        tester.element(find.byType(PlanCanvas)).markNeedsBuild();
        await tester.pump();
      }
    }

    await frames(6);
    final state = tester.state<DraftCanvasState>(find.byType(DraftCanvas));
    final painter = state.painter;
    final sink = state.vertices!;
    final capacity = sink.debugCapacityVertices;
    final paint = sink.debugPaint;
    sink.resetCounters();

    await frames(10);

    expect(
        identical(
            tester.state<DraftCanvasState>(find.byType(DraftCanvas)), state),
        isTrue,
        reason: 'a rebuild remounted DraftCanvas');
    expect(identical(state.painter, painter), isTrue,
        reason: 'a rebuild handed DraftCanvas a new resolver');
    expect(identical(state.vertices, sink), isTrue);
    expect(sink.totalFlushCount, greaterThan(0),
        reason: 'nothing was flushed, so nothing was measured');
    expect(sink.frameTriangleCount, greaterThan(1000),
        reason: 'a degenerate plan would make the bound meaningless');
    expect(sink.debugCapacityVertices, capacity,
        reason: 'the buffer grew in a steady-state frame: O(entities)');
    expect(identical(sink.debugPaint, paint), isTrue,
        reason: 'flush() must reuse the one Paint of the sink\'s life');
  });
}
```

  (The source's comment and assertions, `canvas_paint_allocation_test.dart:41-128`, with the corpus replaced by the sample flat and `c.selection` by `c.activeSelection`. If the sample's frame draws 1,000 triangles or fewer, the premise fails: report the count; the bound is the plan's and is not lowered.)

## Appendix: rulings made while planning (2026-10-15)

Nine writers drafted the tasks in parallel; one reconcile pass and five pre-flight passes checked them against the code and each other (scratch logs, not committed). The rulings below bind the tasks.

### The controller's rulings (R-P1 to R-P19)

- **R-P1 (public libraries only).** `jet_cad_2d_integration` imports only public libraries (`implementation_imports`). So C7's rule reads: a ported case runs **in the kit** when it uses kit internals, the contract, the engine or the Flutter layer — and a plan-library *internal* helper it needs (e.g. `placeSymbol`, `symbol_placer.dart:169`) is reproduced as a **test-local fixture in the kit** (`test/support/place_entry.dart`: `placeEntry(doc, entry, {at, quarterTurns, mirrored, transform})`, `copyOfEntry`; a fixture change, A12). A case runs **in the integration package** only when it needs the plan library's public widgets or controller (`PlanCanvas`, `PlanEditor`, `PlanPropertyPanel`, `PlanController`, the public tools) and no kit internal. A case needing both a plan widget and a kit internal is rewritten to reach the kit internal through public behaviour (a ruling in the task) or split.
- **R-P2.** `furnitureSource` joins `architectureKit.symbols` in Task 24 with the provider (else `attachmentKindUnoffered` fires).
- **R-P3.** Kit test support shared across tasks: `test/support/place_entry.dart` (Task 23 creates it), `test/support/wall_attach_fixture.dart` (Task 24). Kit-internal readers with today's signatures plus a `LiveTypeOf` parameter: `faceRunsOf(doc, wall, LiveTypeOf live, {accept})`, `WallFaces(bands, live, {accept})`.
- **R-P4.** `PlanObject` gains `KitWords get words`; `DocumentPlanObject(document, handle, words)`; `PlanType.fieldsOf(document, group, words)` and `commitField(document, group, field, input, words)`. (Writer 7: `TextDisplay.read` needs the decimal separator and `text:` words.)
- **R-P5.** Dimension cases on the sample flat (`dimension_paint_test` RR1-RR3, `dimension_shell_test` SL1, SL2, TL9) are Task 26's.
- **R-P6.** The kit's test catalog: `test/support/wall_fixture.dart` (Task 11) gives `testCatalog()` and `installParametric(doc)` registering the kit's raw types in today's order; each type task appends its line. `wallsInDocument` (Task 13) gains `{required LiveTypeOf live}`. The kit pubspec lists `vector_math`; the integration pubspec lists `jet_cad_2d`, `jet_cad_2d_flutter`, `jet_cad_2d_kit`, `vector_math` directly (Task 9).
- **R-P7.** A pure `PlanWords` (contract model: `word`, `maybe`, `text`, `decimalSeparator`); `KitWords implements PlanWords` adds `locale`. `PlanObject.words` is a `PlanWords`, so `properties.dart` stays pure (2a's P9 unchanged).
- **R-P8 (the wall/opening/room split).** Today's `wall.dart`/`wall_grips.dart` use `opening_geometry.dart` and `room_inputs.dart`. Split: Task 11's `WallType.generate` has **no opening cut** and **no place hooks** (`contributesPlace`/`placeBox`/`placeInput`); `wallsInView` and `wallsInDocument(doc, host, LiveTypeOf live, {moved})` live in `wall_geometry.dart` (Task 11). Task 12's `WallGrips({required LiveTypeOf live})` has no 08 D13 `_keptPut`/`_seated`. Task 13 adds the wall's cut; Task 14 adds `_keptPut` and `_seated`; Task 16 adds the wall's place hooks. Wall tests whose cases need openings or rooms move to the task that adds the code they need (say so in both tasks).
- **R-P9.** Integration test files that read `@internal` members of the plan library's public classes (`selection`, `grips`, `toolContext`, `servicesOf`, `toolFor`, `frozen`, `fill`) start with `// ignore_for_file: invalid_use_of_internal_member` (precedent: `apps/restaurant_demo/test`). A Global Constraint.
- **R-P10.** Sample-flat cases are Task 26's in the integration package over `sampleFlatController()`: besides R-P5, `room_cost_test` LZ3 and `room_paint_test`'s six cases.
- **R-P11.** The kit's pubspec lists `meta` and `vector_math` besides the Global Constraints' list.
- **R-P12.** `FakePlanServices.settingsOf` reads the map it was given at each call (no copy), so a test can change a tool's settings between events.
- **R-P13 (kit test catalog).** One file, `packages/jet_cad_2d_kit_architecture/test/support/catalog.dart`, created by Task 10 with `ParametricCatalog testCatalog()` and `ParametricSystem installParametric(DraftDocument doc)`; each type task appends its registration in today's order (`jet_cad_floor_plan/lib/src/parametric/catalog.dart:27-39`). Domain fixtures (`wall_fixture.dart`, `room_fixture.dart`, `opening_fixture.dart`) import and re-export it; no other names (`architectureCatalog`, `installArchitecture`) are used.
- **R-P14 (integration test support).** One shared rig, `packages/jet_cad_2d_integration/test/support/editor_rig.dart` (Task 9/10: `pumpEditor`, `globalOf`, `status`, `press`, `activeTool`, `pagePlanJson`, `kitCatalog`, `liveOf`); domain support files (`opening_support.dart`, `room_plans.dart`, ...) import it and add only domain fixtures, never a second copy of a rig helper. The reconcile pass merges duplicates.
- **R-P15 (Review Focus 3, corrected to today's).** A grip drag at a refused point: the preview keeps the last accepted state, nothing is reported; a **drop at the refused point commits nothing** (today: `GripDrag.command` asks the provider at the drop point, `grip_drag.dart:303-313`; wall grips return null there, `wall_grips.dart:60-63, 198`); the grips stay usable. C1.8(2) is done through one private refusal rule shared by `execute` and `plan.select`'s `GuardedTool` (Task 7), since `ToolContext.execute` is the Flutter layer's.
- **R-P16.** 2b's renames (`SeatingComponent` → `UnitComponent(kind: table, capacity: n)`, table → unit) count as C7 class 1 (ids). Task 5 does not port ND2 (the plan library has no page-less set-up).
- **R-P17.** R-P15 corrected: at a refused point today's preview is empty (`wall_grips.dart:137-138`, `grip_drag.dart:262-263`), not the last accepted state. `wallsInDocument(doc, host, LiveTypeOf live, {moved})` takes `live` positionally (R-P6's named form struck). The kit test helper for a live reader is `liveOf(doc, {frozen})` in `wall_fixture.dart`; Task 16's `liveIn` is replaced by it.
- **R-P18.** R-16 (spec C6): the table halves of TF1/TF3/TF7, EX2/EX3/EX5 and CZ1 stay in the plan's 2b tests (they use plan internals); the integration package carries their room lines over public routes (Task 28). Spec C6's "full copies" is amended by this ruling.
- **R-P19.** R14-1 accepted: the opening's position range decides "is the host a wall" by the engine's naming rule over a catalog the kit builds lazily from its own raw type registrations (a kit-internal list in `lib/src/`, not from `architectureKit`, so no import cycle). EG8-k/EG9-k/EG10-k's test-local grip dispatch follows DM-R1/R14-7 (a fixture standing in for the plan's dispatch).
